comments: The flat was bright, comfortable and clean and Adriano was pleasant and gracious about accommodating us at the last minute. The Brixton tube was a very short walk away and there were plenty of buses. There are lots of fast food restaurants, banks, and shops along the main street.

We stayed with Adriano and Valerio for a week when first moving to London. The apartment is great and very clean compared to a lot of places we've seen in London. Situated very close to Brixton tube and good bus links to central London. Thanks guys!

Adriano was a fantastic host. We felt very at home while staying there. Our first morning we woke up and saw the dining table set for breakfast which was much appreciated. His flat is conveniently located a block from the tube station, with a number of shops and restaurants in the area as well. His place was very clean and tidy, overall just a fantastic experience.

We had a most wonderful stay with Adriano and Valerio.  They are both interesting and interested hosts who serve a delicious cappuccino with breakfast in the morninig.  Their place is small but clean and comfy.  Central London is a short bus or tube ride ... very convenient.  We look forward to returning to London and staying with them again.

I'm not sure which of us misunderstood the situation, but I was not aware that Adriano and his cousin would be in residence...I thought I was renting the apartment to myself. Nonetheless, he was a very gracious host. The neighborhood is not a good one, and anyone renting here should be aware of that. I would not walk in that area at night under any circumstances. The apartment is spotlessly clean though.

5***** Stars for Adriano & Valerio
If you are looking for a nice, cosy and super clean room in London, you will be happy to stay at Adrianos and Valerios place. The both are friendly and welcoming hosts. They serve you a good breakfast with italian cappuccino in the morning. And if you are interested you can also have a nice discussion with Adriano and learn a lot about European culture and history. Thanks again for that!:) We just stayed one night at their appartment, but if we come back we will definitely try to stay at this place.
Thanks again and best regards from Cologne
// Steffi & Nino

the place is in a quiet side road, very convenient (a 2 minute slow walk) to the tube on Victoria line. The room is a bit small but very comfortable, clean and well organized, including wireless internet! The bathroom is spacious and clean. Adriano is a wonderful host, very kind and ready to help. Also he prepares a fantastic cappuccino at breakfast!
My daughter and I felt this was a great place, we stayed there 3 nights and felt safe and welcomed. We warmly recommend Adriano's place. Grazie Adriano e ciao!
Giusi & Elena
The room was as shown. Didn't have access to the living room much. I'd pick another place to stay closer to downtown I think next time. London was a great experience.

I had a great stay with Adriano! He was very friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. The flat was clean, and the room was very nice. The area/neighbourhood is very multicultural - making it interesting yet safe. I had no problems going there alone at night, and neither should anyone else, provided they don't mind the smells and sounds from the big Afro-Caribbean community - which is far more exciting than the blandness of the regular tourist places.

adriano is a sweet and totally gentle guy. his house is tiny, but SUPER clean and cozy--he keeps his bathroom cleaner than any hotel i have ever been in! the bed is very comfortable with a really nice comforter, his cappuccino is excellent, and the conversation is interesting and friendly. the house is all the way at the end of the victoria line, but it's a really easy ride from central london and only a two block walk from the tube stop. he really goes out of his way to make you feel welcome and comfortable. i would stay there again, without hesitation.

We stayed with Adriano for 5 nights on our visit to London. His apartment is small but spotless and the bed in the bedroom you stay in is comfortable, perfect for two people (and our backpacks!).

We didn't spend a lot of time at the apartment, but Adriano was a great, friendly host with fantastic recommendations on the area and even set out breakfast and made us cappuccino the first morning of our stay!

The apartment is three blocks from the Brixton tube station, about 10 minutes into the city center by train so the location was great. Brixton itself is a lively neighborhood with an outdoor market, a movie theatre and a few pubs close to the apartment.


If you are looking only for a bedroom to crash, and a clean, safe and centrally located place to stay while in London, I'd highly recommend staying with Adriano!

Staying with Adriano & Valerio was a plasure, I felt just like at home. Adriano is a very intereting man to have a conversation with, exchane expiriences and opinions. He keeps the apratment very clean with an unbelievable amount of fresh clean towles.
The location is within 2-3 min walk from a tube station, many bus lines & many many shops of all kinds.
I enjoyed my stay very much and very likely to stay with them again on my next trip to London.
Clean, tidy, close to the underground and bus. Adriano is friendly and trustful. I had a good time.

If you want a cheap and super clean accomodation in London you should book your room at Adriano's place.
Adriano is extremely friendly and he put me at ease since I arrived at his flat.
I enjoyed so much his neighborhood, Brixton is amazing and I don't share the opinion of Monique that said it's not a good one.
Probably she didn't like the multicultural aspect of Brixton, while I chose that district intentionally.
As other people wrote Adriano's flat is really close to Brixton Tube Station and there are many bus connections through useful stops and to the City (some of them operate a 24h service)
If you're planning to spend few days in London don't hesitate to contact Adriano!

This was my first stop in an "All-AirBNB" Trip and let me tell you that it was a great place to start. Adriano was not only helpful but he offers a beautiful room with all the amenities you'll need if you're traveling to London.

Location is key and he's right next to the Brixton Station which means that in about 20 minutes or so you can be anywhere you want to be. Beware though that the London Underground is undergoing construction on the weekends and some lines are shut down, nothing that a little bit of planning can solve.

The bed was comfortable, warm and I slept like a baby. Everything was spotless and I couldn't have felt more safe and secure. I'd stay there any time.

Three cheers to Adriano and his beautiful London Flat.

G

Super perfect 5 star place to stay.

Clean and tidy flatt with a real good feeling to it and privacy. Adriano made me feel very safe and welcome.

The flat is only 5 minutes walking distance to the Brixton underground so it was real easy for me to get to my destinations rather quickly.

Thank you Adriano you made my stay extra nice.

All the best, Berit Reaver

My boyfriend and I just came back from London where we stayed a couple of days at Adriano's place.
We really enjoyed this experience!
First of all, the house is located in zone 2, 2 mins walk to Brixton tube station (victoria line) and buses to the city centre 24/24 which is very practical. There is everything one need in the area: shops, bars, restaurants, supermarkets.
Then, the house is as shown, our bedroom was cozy and absolutely comfy, and we really appreciated that everything was tidy and super clean including the bathroom which is very important. Moreover, the area was quiet and we slept very well :)
Adriano was so nice and gentle, it was a pleasure to stay at his place. He welcomed us and made us feel home right away. He is a very friendly person and we appreciated nice and interesting conversations with him!
We will definitely go back to his place for our next trip to London and we obviously highly recommend everyone to go to Adriano's.
Thank you so much, we had an amazing stay!

Adriano was a thoughtful host, offering touristic suggestions as well as a splendid cappuccino. The room's easy proximity to the Brixton tube station is a plus.  It was a friendly and hassle-free stay.

This place was perfect to stay in London. Very near the tube, very clean and tidy. Adriano is a very nice guy, polite, clever and very helpful with us. Valerio is also a very ice room mate. Definitely recommended
The host canceled my reservation 4 days before arrival.

Adriano has many good reviews,so i m gonna  to say same things that other people already said.Adriano is a very good host,friendly,he has a great sense of hospitality.Very nice home,clean and bright,close to Underground station.5 Stars!
Adriano was quick to help me rent on a couple of hours notice. Clean and lovely reception.

Adriano was out ot town. I stayed with his cousin Valerio, who was
very nice, clean and kept the place tidy. I felt safe there. The flat is 2 minute walk to the tube station. I had a good time and would recommend Adriano's flat to Airbnb travellers.

I spent 2 nights at Adriano's flat and enjoyed my experience there very much.  Adriano and his cousin Val were friendly, pleasant and easy to get along with. The flat and my room were both very clean, tidy and organised, yet I also felt very much at home too.  The neighbourhood was interesting and colourful; and I really enjoyed walking along the street - the vibe was fantastic!  I had a wonderful experience staying at A's flat.  Antony :)

We really enjoyed our stay with Adriano. He is a great host, very welcoming, thoughtful and molto simpatico. We felt very much at home staying in his cosy apartment.

His apartment is also in a good position for visitors to London, close to a variety of shops, to buses and the tube station. Brixton Market and the Village have great food and are fun to explore.

We definitely hope to be returning to stay with Adriano when we are next in London.

Andriano is a great host. Very sociable, nice and friendly talks. the Flat is clean, very clean. Bed is confortable and bathroom, very clean one, is quite big. The place is very close to Brixton tube and it's really convenient to get to central London.

My stay with Adriano, at his bright London flat, was my first through airbnb and it couldn't have been better! I stayed for four nights and will recommend this place to my friends. The flat is well connected with public transport and there are nice places to eat and drink nearby. Brixton/Lambeth are safe and pleasant areas. 
The flat itself is very comfortable and cleaner than many hostels and hotels I've stayed in during my travels through Europe. The bed is comfortable and warm, and the bathroom adequate and large. 
Both Adriano and Valerio are genuinely kind and caring people and we had some interesting conversations together. Adriano's experience in the hospitality industry shines through in his home and in his service. He even put me in contact with another host when my other accommodation plans fell through later in the week. Although it was not at all Adriano's problem he went out of his way to find me a place. 

Thank you Adriano!

Adriano was a very friendly and helpful host. He greeted me with a short walk through Brixton and showed me around that made me feel right at home. I stayed for three nights and I spent a fantastic time in Brixton. Would definetly recommend staying there!!!

I could not have asked for a better host for my first airbnb experience and my first trip to London. Adriano is a genuinely warm, generous and welcoming host, an experienced traveler and city guide. The apartment is clean, cosy and very conveniently located to transport options. Overall, a truely lovely experience!
Adriano is a great host with a lovely flat.  I wish I could've stayed longer!
The host is very accomodating and the place is very neat.  the location is easy access to public transportation and restaurant.

Adiano's rented room was fine for my needs...eonomical and near a tube stop.  I especially enjoyed our conversations and views on world events.  The room is small, and the double bed was more than `I needed.  The area was quiet, with plenty of restaurants and shopping for fresh items at the local vendors.   Wifi is available at McDonalds and the local library.  It is a mixed race area, vibrant at rush hour.  I prefer accomodcations like this instead of big chain hotels.

Adriano's place is just a three minute walk from Brixton Tube, very tidy and comfortable too. Adriano is very helpful - he confirmed the booking within 5 minutes and gave me lots of information about what to do locally. Looking forward to staying there next time I'm in London.

We had a great stay in London at Adriano's place. His apartment is very well located though absolutely quiet. Very comfortable bed and big bathroom were ok. Adriano offered us breakfast but we picked from the great variety of the Brixton area. We would definitely book his place again! Thanks again, Adriano.

Adriano is like one of the London sighseeing destinations, you gotta visit, no matter how many times you have before. His flat is very well-located, a few steps from the Brixton underground station, which can take you directly on Victoria Line to anywhere you want in London in few minutes.

Not to mention he is a friendly host who is always trying to help out and give recommendations. A very spacious and cozy bathroom with good essense smells, comfortable bed included. We ended up wandering around the city the next day, for some exhibitions due to the London Design Festival. Definitely recommended.

Hi everyone. Adriano was an amazing guest. Very nice and with tons of info. Whenever I come back to Europe I would love to stay here again. Very nice and clean sheets. Kind of small flat for an american standards but great location just couple of blocks from Brixton underground station that gats u anywhere in town. I love London and our stay. I recommend you to stay there too. Xoxo

Cissa

I stayed with Adriano for two nights to attend a concert at the Brixton Academy. The place was lovely and very clean. The private room had a large bed and more than enough room for my backpack and clothes. The apartment was very close to the Underground Tube (>5 minute walk) and the Brixton Academy (5 minute walk). Adriano was a great host and it was lovely to talk to him during the mornings and evenings. He was able to recommend some great local restaurants and things to do in town. Overall I had a great experience!

Adriano's flat is comfortable and very clean. A good bed where i slept as my home. The flat is very near the metro station. Adriano is also a good person to talk and he is very kind and helpful.
Five stars!

It was a very nice weekend in London.
Adriano ist ein sehr guter Gastgeber und wir haben uns wohl gefühlt.
Die U Bahnstation ist ganz in der Nähe und das Stadtzentrum gut zu erreichen. In Brixton pulsiert das Leben. Wir wurden The Bright Londoner Wohnung wieder wählen.
Margot und Ursel

Adriano's place was in a perfect location, literally 2 min walk from Brixton Tube in Zone 2. His place is super clean not only your bedroom but the entire Flat. The bed is very comfortable & he is devoted to ensuring that you have the best possible experience in his cozy Brixton flat. I have no problem in recommending you stay at Adriano's place when in London.

Adriano's flat is warm and cosy, convenient and well-appointed. And Adriano is a fantastic host--very friendly and knowledgeable, kind and engaging. By staying here you not only have a marvellous experience, you also make a great new friend!

it was absolutly wonderful time in this nice flat and exakt what I was wating for. Nice clean comfort room and badroom , cоmfortable cаrefully relations of Adrianо, flat with very good taste. The view from the roof was delight!
He helpt me to bay ticket to musical "Wicked"! I am very touched of his good attitude and welcoming.
Neхt summer I will come agane to his flat with my doghter))))

The flat is situated in a nice victorian house in a nice and central district and close to the underground station Elena was abroad while we stayed in the flat but she was helpfull.

The flat is clear, spacious and clean. Although, there are many constraints. For example : the living room and the second bedroom are noisy because of the street, Elena recommanded not to open one of the curtains in the living room because of the piano, the dining room table is not practical (lamps, plants and frames on and under it), the windows open and close very badly, the bed in the second bedroom is not comfortable at all, the host recommanded not to evacuate the paper in the toilets, the ground in the kitchen is torn (a bit dangerous), the radiators seem in poor condition...
The appartement would have needeed to be ventilated before our arrival. More generally, everything is old, worn and not always in good condition.

Elena was very welcoming,  extremely kind, communitive and helpful.  Her home felt like our home away from home and in an excellent location.  Thank you Elena.  We would definately like to stay again on our next trip to London.

We have had a great time in London.
The apartment is very close to the Piccadilly Line which arrives everywhere in London.
The apt was full furnished, and after a couple of days we were perfectly acclimatized.
Thank you Elena for the hospitality and the kindness.

Nice centrally located flat in great neighborhood within close walking distant to at least 3 tube stations and several favorite restaurants.  Elena is very helpful, responding quickly to our emails with questions and had a friend greet us and help with transportation to Heathrow since we had to leave early am.  We also arrived before noon so it was wonderful to have our place available rather than waiting for afternoon check in time.  Traffic noises are a little loud, front bedroom bed is not comfortable, and carpet is worn but flat is clean and has well stocked kitchen & bath.  Good value & savings over hotel, smaller flats.

Lovely apartment in a great location and environment. Did not get to meet Elena, but was helped by the lovely Mirka. Furnishings a little old/dated, and could do with a little more maintenance. But overall comfortable and nice. Too bad none of us know how to play the grand piano!

Elena's flat is very well situated in a nice and quiet district. Very convenient place, with good connections by tube and buses and many shops around to buy food. We really appreciated our stay there despite the beds are not comfortable at all, especially the one in the front bedroom. Also, there was a very bad smell in the appartment when we came in and we could not get rid of it during our all stay (5 nights). A renewed carpet would be a must.

It was lovely to stay at Eleonor's place. It's not far from underground and few steps from bus stop. More over - it is just 10 mins by walks to V&A!
Our pick for breakfast - Balance cafe at the cross roads.

The apartment is cozy and well located. You can walk to Victoria and Albert Museum, Hyde Park and other places. Tube is close to flat as well.
Since the first day we had an issue with the heating system, It was not possible to have a hot shower, so we "split" our bath in the cold London to keep clean. It was very frustrating. We had to send several messages and call a few times, but unfortunately problem was not solved.

Nice location near Earl's Court Station with plenty of restaurants, supermarkets, etc. We had plenty of room to stay with two teenagers. Internet worked well, that's a must nowadays. Kitchen was okay. Reading previous reviews some comments about a bad smell raised our concerns. Eleonor assured us that there was not such a situation and we were pleased to see that our stay was pleasant enough to recommend it. Would just mention that they still have a carpet in the bathroom that's not the best solution for a flat that is rented very often.

I spent 5 days my my sister at Elena's place and we had a very great time. The house is very spacious: the two bedrooms, a treat bathroom mith shower and tub (the bathroom has no window), a huge dining room with sofa and piano and a confortable kitchen. The location and the building is pleasant and close to the tube. There are many shops (supermarcket included) and pubs in the near area. We really feel at home, and it is really important for us. I do recommed Elena's Place.

Elena's apartment is in an excellent location. It is walking distance to the museums and Hyde Park or there are plenty of easy transport links. Her apartment was spacious and comfortable. Elena was very welcoming. Her own travel arrangements had glitched so rather than shunt us off to a hotel she stayed at a friends place. She also was very flexible about our departure and we were able to leave our bags at the apartment till late. That was a real boon to us and allowed us to fully enjoy a last day in a London 'heatwave'. It is a good base for exploring London and we enjoyed it. Thanks Elena and friends.

We were a little worried when we started our walk to the flat from the West Brompton tube station and walked right past an old cemetery, but we were then pleasantly surprised to enter into a very nice neighborhood with shops, restaurants, and a Starbucks. I highly recommend going to the Earl's Court station; there are more restaurants and shops plus a supermarket. It's also shorter and avoids the cemetery altogether.

We did not meet Eleonor since she was on vacation herself, but we were met by her friend Kevin who showed us around. He helpfully pointed out that there is no dryer; there is a clothes rack in the hallway. Since we arrived when the previous tenants had not yet left, the towels were hang drying (this was not pointed out to us, and I had to search to find them).

The two bedrooms were ok, and the leather couches were also very comfortable. The grand piano certainly added a nice touch. The flat, for European standards, was spacious and well appointed. The entrance to the building was also very nice.

Now to the shortcomings: the shower is an open tub with a folding window/screen that doesn't stay in place. Taking a shower was extremely annoying because of that. Sleeping on the bed was like sleeping on a trampoline; the slightest movement rippled throughout the bed. The kitchen flooring is soft and felt like it would crumble.

That said, it was overall a very pleasant stay. I would definitely recommend it.

We have passed a very good time in Eleonor's flat. It´s very good located from all the places to visit. 5 minutes by walk to earl's court station, and Mark and Spencer to buy food until 23 pm. The flat is perfect for a family with children. Eleonor spent her time for looking after us. Thanks to Rosie for her presence at our arrival, and for her avalability at our departure!
A very good first experience with AirB&B!

Elena apartment is lovely. The location is one of my favourite in London, there is a lot of place for eating, including a convenient 24h open store, and is very near to Earl's court underground, with the Piccadilly and District line. Yes, maybe the apartment need some renovation (above all, ruined carpet and windows that can't open properly), but actually this didn't bothered me at all, as everything worked properly, the house was clean, and fully equipped with everything we could need. As an advice, I would offer some extra pillow (there only was one, and with no pillowcase), as the ones in the bedroom are very tiny.
Thanks Elena, I will certainly save your house for my future vacations!

Like all previous reviews have mentioned, Eleonor's flat is perfectly located in the lovely borough of Kensington and Chelsea with easy access to most locations in Central London via tube, overground and bus. The flat itself is very homely and well equipped with everything. Although we encountered a few problems with the flat during our stay but Eleonor has made her best effort to solve the problems and sending over her friends to come along to help us when she couldn't possibly come along personally. Overall a very high standard experience.

Was like staying at a relative's home (but we had to pay!). Pros: Great pre-arrival instructions, and communication with Elena. Very good value for the location, and spacious rooms. Lots of hot water.
Cons: Very noisy in front rooms, and construction across street didn't help. Plumber came while we were out, and I was a bit uncomfortable with that. Bathroom had pesky bath door issues, and no exhaust. Leaving soiled toilet tissue in the bin was offputting. No hair dryer. Mold in tub very apparent. Yes, carpet is tattered and holes in kitchen floor weird. We knew this was an occupied apartment, but there is NO space to hang clothes in master bedroom, and only two tiny drawers. All other drawers were taped shut. The beds were horribly hard, although linens clean, as was rest of flat. Door to the building was often left unlocked. Would have liked two sets of keys.

Great location, nice clean flat. excellent value and felf like staying in a friends appartment.
would definitely recommend.
Enjoyed our stay, well worth it, facilities al fine, great location. Induction good. Would come again.

The flat suites 4 people very well - there are two separate bedrooms and a cosy living room to spend the evenings. It is great that the hot water never runs out so it is possible for everybody to use the shower. The kitchen is very well equipped - it is not a problem to cook at home.

We location is simply superb - the tube station is only 5 minutes away and all the places of interests in Chelsea are easy to reach on foot (I'd recommend Carlyle's house and Physic Garden).

There are a few drawbacks: complicated heating system, carpet in the bathroom, holes in the kitchen floor. However they have not made out stay any less enjoyable. I'd certainly recommend this flat.

It was a pleasure to stay at Eleonor apartment. It was nice and clean and the location was perfect to do sightseeing around London. It is very well located for touristic purpose.
Everything was perfect except the new shower. It wasn't working during our stay.
We didn't get to meet Eleonor personally but communication was excellent before and during our stay.
I look forward to staying there again the next time we are in London.

Appartement très agréable dans un très bel immeuble situé dans le quartier à la fois animé - beaucoup de restaurants à proximité - et tranquille de Earl's Court.
Bus à 1 minute à pied et métro (Earl's Court) à 5 minutes à pied.
Seul petit bémol, une des chambres est située côté rue et on entend la circulation car il n'y a pas de double vitrage.
L'autre chambre est parfaite.

Our trip to London was for for an audition and we needed a piano in the apartment.  Eleonor's flat was perfect.  The flat has lots of space, is in a fantastic location AND a gorgeous grand piano that allowed my son to prepare for his important day.  The internet connection was superfast and it was an unexpected pleasure to have the Olympics to watch on TV at the end of the day.  You hardly have to leave the neighborhood for great food and sights.
Perfect location, between Earl's Court and Gloucester tube stations ! Eleonor was very friendly and efficient for both the reservation and the reception/accommodation.

Elena's flat is the absolute best! It is in the loveliest neighborhood, has been so tastefully decorated and was the perfect fit for our stay. Check-in and check-out with her assistant Rosie was a breeze and she could not have been nicer. The apartment was very clean and it's easy to see a lot of TLC goes into keeping it nice. We were 5 women (2 in each bed and one on the sofa) and we had a super stay in this apartment. The kitchen we very convenient for the odd meal in and slept soundly in the two bedrooms (also on the sofa). We would definitely recommend Elena's flat to others looking for a super London AirB&B experience. Thank you Elena!

This flat is an excellent value in Central london. The flat is bright and spacious and very convenient to the tube. We didn't notice that the place was noisy at all, especially given the great location.  Yes there are some quirks - for example a bumpy floor in the kitchen, but nothing that takes away from the comfort of the flat. The place was kept clean and Eleonor's assistant Rosie, was helpful in setting us up in the flat. There are two double beds and very comfortable couches in the living area.  The heating system worked well, as did the shower. One warning to families with small children - there are a lot of knick knacks around the house, so if you have small children that run around, this flat may not work for you.  For us, with older kids, the  place was comfortable, convenient and spacious.

Travelling to London for the first time with our two little boys, we were a little nervous about how it would work out. But we needn't have worried – we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Eleonor's apartment. The apartment had everything required for our weekend and ample space – my husband, me and the boys (aged 3 and 18 months) stayed. Eleonor was readily contactable and answered any queries we had before arrival. Arrangements for check in and out were excellent - extremely hassle free. The location of the apartment was first class - easy access from Earl's Court tube station, supermarket stores within walking distance, and beautiful walks to be had in and around the area. The lift also meant good access with prams and suit cases, which was great. There are a few steps from the street to gain access to the building but we were able to lift the prams up these and found it manageable.

The only thing I would say is that with two toddlers we were extra vigilant about the piano. Our boys didn't realise, and we didn't point out, that it was a piano, but it might be something to bear in mind if staying with little ones.

We would definitely recommend the apartment... and thank you Eleonor for such a lovely stay.

Wonderful location, close to Earl's Court and Gloucester tube locations. On the whole the apartment was a great size for our family of 4 with two boys aged 3 and 6. Could use some updating for this price, but within the right range for this location.
Adriano takes care of the details and was very helpful during my stay.

Went to a couple shows at the Brixton Academy and could not have stayed in a more convenient location.  The flat was clean, the host was friendly and reliable, overall a good experience.  Highly recommend.

WONDERFUL STAY!
I had a chance that others didn't! Met Adriano in his first apartment of Brixton, charming one bedroom very well located with all possible transports (bus, tube) going to the center in few minutes, i stayed there the first night and got upgraded to the other apartment for my second night!
Clapham is an amazing neighborhood which I didn't know at all. Clapham road (5mns walking from the apartment) is a living street, restaurants, clubs, markets...
The apartment is extremely well done. Two totally separated bedrooms with a charming living room and it chimney full of charm.
Adriano is a great host who has been in guests’ contacts for years and as soon as you meet him you can feel the professionalism and the sense of hospitality he has, available, helpful, smiling and generous!
I would definitely recommend Adriano's apartments and will be looking forward to being there again.
Adriano is a great and helpful host. We realy enjoyed staying there and highly recommend this place
Perfect!!!

Adriano is a great, caring person.
The suite is a bit small and crowded, but very clean. The location is good and close to transportation.

The room is cozy and comfortable, even though it is small. The neighborhood has a vibrant life.
We had little time with Adriano, but even so we could enjoy his company and know his other house. He's very polite, caring and respectful.

My mates and I needed a place to stay over the holiday's and Adriano's seemed like a great deal. We found the place very easily and it's about a two block stop from the Victoria line at the Brixton stop. Adriano had the flat looking exactly like the pictures and it was perfect, even with three people staying for a week. The Lambeth/Brixton area is quite nice and there are many hip restaurants and pubs in walking distance that are worth checking out. Adriano is a wonderful host and was very easy to deal with.I highly recommend this flat for anyone who wishes to stay in the London area, but not in the midst of the hustle of the big city.

Adriano's is a very good accommodation for people seeking good location and a flexible stay. It was by far the best option on the market! Adriano is very nice and flexible himself (we checked in at 11 pm!). The bed was a bit too fluffy, but we stayed there for three weeks, you wouldn't notice before that or if you're used to it. Brixton is great, very lively and with all things handy, including the tube and rail stations, which are just at the corner. Enjoy!

Great place - well worth the value. Brixton is an interesting neighborhood and the tube stop is close to the apartment. The apartment itself is cozy and has everything one would need. Not only that - after we met our very generous host Adriano, he upgraded us to his other property! A really great person who I'm glad to have met.

My friend and I stayed in this flat on two occasions for over a month's time and were very happy. Adriano is very friendly and helpful and the flat looks exactly like it does in the pictures. It is also in a great location less than 5 minutes walk to Brixton tube. Would definitely stay here again.

Nice flat, bright host and very very good location.
Highly recommended!
We really enjoyed our stay at Adriano'place. His flat is very nice and he knows very well how to welcome people !

Trovare un'appartamento pulito, confortevole, adatto a 5 persone, non è cosa facile a Londra. Fortunatamente Adriano ci ha dato la possibilità di soggiornare nel suo appartamento a Clapham North, e,  salvo la paura di aver saputo la sera prima di questo cambiamento, il soggiorno è stato FANTASTICO: bella zona, a pochi minuti dalla metro, con caffè, pub ed un "alimentari", casa ordinata e soprattutto pulita. Son stato in vacanza con 4 donne, figuratevi che anche loro son state soddisfatte e non han avuto nulla da ridire!!!

We got upgraded to Adriano's Northern Clapham apartment, which was in a better location than Brixton. We found it easy to get around on the tube, which was less than 5 minutes walk away. The area near the tube station was pretty lively till at least 8pm, with restaurants and grocery shops.

The apartment was tastefully decorated and everything was thoughtfully planned. There were beautiful flowers around the house, scented candles in the bedroom and bathroom. My boyfriend and I stayed in the double room. Towels were provided, and there was ample shelf and dresser space although the room itself was pretty cosy. The bed was really comfortable, we had great rest during our trip to London. In the morning when we drew up the blinds, the sunlight streaming in from the huge window made for an uplifting experience.

Adriano is an attentive, caring host who was there to welcome us when we arrived. He recommended us a good deal for sightseeing in London that was provided by the rail pass. He is genuine, friendly, and nice to chat with. Overall, Adriano made our first Airbnb experience a pleasant one.

Adriano is such a welcoming host. We were taken aback by his incredible hospitality. We were upgraded to his home in the lovely South London neighborhood of Clapham and enjoyed being surrounded by his cozy dwelling. There were offers of porridge and tea and coffee but we didn't have a chance to take wonderful Adriano up on these offers because we were so busy in the great city of London. He had many reccomendations for things to do in the area and in greater London. Great accommodation, great host!

Nice place, good location.
Adriano is so nice and friendly.
Thank you very much,
Sincerely,
Burcin

I sent my language student and her boyfriend to stay at Adrian's for a few nights, so this is not a direct review. However, I know she had a great time, felt very welcome and found the flat very comfortable. I will be recommending the place again.
This is a cute little flat in a great neighborhood. Adriana was a great host and told us where to find the fun shops and restaurants in Brixton! We can't wait to go back!
Adriano was an excellent host.  The flat is very well maintained, convenient location - perfect flat for a weekend getaway.  Could not have been any happier with my experience!
Adriano is a good guy!  His place is really close to the underground and very convenient.  It has everything you need for a great London experience.

We had an amazing week end to this place! it was warm, in a comfortable flat, very welcoming, with people so nice that we wish we stayed longer!
We recommend it to anyone that is looking for a pleasant place, with a good geography, with very nice people.
Thank you for everything again!

We enjoyed our stay in Brixton. The flat was warm, comfortable, it has everything you need. The tube and thereby London center are very close.  Adriano was an attentive host, he welcome us when we arrived late in the evening. He is good accessible.  I read inattentive the flat information and was unpleasant surprised, only breakfast is allowed in the flat. But the hosts were flexible. Many thanks!

The flat is very well located - extremely close to Brixton Subway Station and very clean. Adriano is an attentive and flexible host. He can also give you good tips on places to eat in the neighbourhood and on how to save some money in a wise way during your stay in London.

Incredible experience. The sweet Geraldine was a perfect hostess  and guarantee 100% all that she promised on description at airbnb. The Apartment has a wonderful skyline view during the day and night, sunny and stylish. I hope to return as soon as possible.

Geraldine's place was great. Close to the city (about 15 min to City by Metro, 30 min by bike), great views from the balcony and a couple of grocery shops just outside of the building. The apartment offered good cooking facilities, a washer a decent bathroom and great space. A perfect flat for semi long stays. Geraldine was a great host and the stay went on without any complications.

My parents stayed at Geraldine's lovely flat for 2 weeks and they had a fantastic time! It is lovely designed, functional, warm and has the most stunning view of London you could imagine. Geraldine was very helpful when we had an issue with the internet connection and came to sort it all out as soon as she could.
I highly recommend this property

great location & transport links. easy check-in. spacious apartment with everything you might need available. very light & airy with amazing views.

geraldine was quick to respond to any queries prior to our arrival and very welcoming and helpful once we arrived. she'd prepared a handy info sheet for us and checked-in during our stay to make sure everything was ok. couldn't have asked for anything more.

We stayed at Geraldine’s apartment for more than a week. The location is cool and very close to transport links (underground and buses). There are many grocery stores and pubs nearby. The apartment have all cooking facilities, for us with 2 children it was very helpful. The apartment is very sunny and have good panoramic view of London.
The check-in was easy and Geraldine prepared sheet with all info we needed for our stay. We also get bottle of wine. Also the late check-out was very convenient. We will recommend this property for our friends.
Geraldine has big library with many interesting books. You should also take in account that this is 2 floor apartment. Our children (8 and 12) enjoy to run up and down. BTW there is old Macintosh computer there.

We had a great family vacation in London!! Many thanks to Geraldine for opening her beautiful home for the four of us.

Location Highlights: Listening to Big Ben every hour, the sunsets, (oh the amazing sunsets.....), wide view of London from balcony, two different "Northern" lines from Kennington tube station, much larger living space than hotel room, safe neighborhood.

Host Highlights: Provided document describing neighborhood, communicated to us two weeks in advance that workers were performing building repairs (so noise was not a surprise), arranged for friend to welcome us into flat in her absence, wireless internet, stereo for iPods.

The location is a bit tricky - there is no unique address of the building, and the map on airbnb web site was a little off. But a quick phone call was helpful to iron this out and a few remaining logistics.

This is our fourth trip to Europe since 2004, and first with our kids. Geraldine has two bedrooms so we were all very comfortable.

We stayed for a week but I wish we could have stayed longer.... When we return, Geraldine and her place will be our first on our list!

-Chris

Geraldine was a great host. She met up with my friend in London to give him the key and to explain the things, since we were arriving a bit late and she was due to travel out. The location of the apartment was great - perfect for what we needed- sighseeing and walking around London. I stayed in Geraldine's apartment with two kids, there was plenty of space for all of us.

We were warned of the construction work in the building, so the noise was not a surprise. However, it's a huge building - 19 floors if I'm not mistaken, and there is always something going on (extremely noisy construction works), so I guess this is not the place for peaceful and quiet stay.

A downside when you're staying with two children is the fact that there is no TV set in the apartment. Maybe this is something to consider.

We had a very good experience in London, and with Geraldine's apartment. When we go back we would deffinitely consider it again.

Geraldine was very nice, she explained to us all the details we neededto know.
Also she was very kind, she was very flexible at the times of arriving and departing from the apartment.
The location of the apartment is great, few minuts of walk from the underground and from a mini market.

This is a large, bright flat in a big estate in Kennington. We were 3 people so one slept in the lounge on the sofa bed which was very comfortable but no curtains in the morning. The location could not be better- Kennington was really at the centre of many things we wanted to do. Seeing the London Eye and Big Ben from the balcony was cool too.
The apartment has everything you'll need ( no tv ) and has a casual retro vibe. I liked staying here. Wifi fantastic.
Didn't get to meet the host but by all accounts she is charming.

Geraldine e Simon foram muito atenciosos, acesso muito fácil e ágil em suas respostas. Muito simpáticos!
O apartamento é extremamente bem localizado! Pertíssimo de estação central do metro, com restaurantes e mercearias próximos.
A vista do apartamento é simplesmente espetacular, principalmente para nós que passamos a noite do Reveillon.
Skyline de cartão postal!
Vimos o show de fogos de artificio na London Eye da varanda!!
O apartamento é muito iluminado! Estava um pouco empoeirado, mas com banheiros limpos. A mobília um pouco desgastada.
O balanço é positivo! Indicaríamos para amigos.
loved the place, close to the tube station, and we found a couple of cute close by pubs!

Geraldine hat uns pünktlich empfangen und war sehr freundlich. Hilfe zur Orientierung und Tips sowie das Gefühl sich "wie zuhause" fühlen zu können, haben uns sehr gut gefallen. Der Blick aus dem Appartement ist wirklich toll, die Nachbarschaft freundlich. Für Business-Reisende waren aber leider Sauberkeit und effektiv verfügbare Ablage- und Stauraum-Fläche nicht optimal. Hier sehen wir (ich bin im Team gereist) eine Reinigung vor und nach dem Besuch als hilfreich an.
Ansonsten, wie gesagt, sehr nette Gastgeber und sehr gute Anbindung/ Ausblick!

We had a nice stay at Geraldine's flat. The location is quite convenient, being very close to Kennington tube station (3-4 minutes walk).
The layout of the flat is good, the kitchen and the living-room well suited to us.
Nice view from the balcony.
We slept well in the two rooms too.
As a bonus the internet connection is really fast (it is a cable-internet connection, probably. 50 Mb/s at least).
Geraldine's flat is very nice, i had a great time there also it in a very lovely location. On New Year celebration, i took a lot of photo of firework, you can enjoy perfect view at her balcony.

We had a great stay at Geraldine's flat. It was comfortable and had everything we needed to feel at home. The location is really excellent for getting anywhere around London. The view is really great! We had several lovely sunsets.

The flat was super convenient to the tube and bus lines. There were a lot of grocery stores, bars and restaurants close to the flat. Geraldine was very helpful when we checked in. We enjoyed her hospitality and all the amenities of the flat, especially the balcony. Thank you for a great stay!

This place has a great location. It is very conveniently located just 5 minutes walk from the closest tube and from there you can reach anything quite fast.
We had some minor issues: the shower was very hot and hard to regulate, and it seems the heater in one of the rooms didn't work.
However, this was minor and our stay here was beautiful. The flat itself is charming and has a great view from the balcony. I can only recommend this place and would happily stay here again.

The location of this AirBnB and the proximity to public transport makes it ideal for tourists.  We were also impressed with the very fast internet speeds.  There is a small balcony on this 9th floor unit and the views of London city skyline (and even the Big Ben clock tower) are spectacular.   Geraldine showed us all fittings and features of the flat and left detailed instructions for us, which was a great help.  The flat is in a modern highrise building that has good elevators and good security. The furniture is getting on a bit but more importantly, the linen and towels are fresh and clean The wardrobes were a quite cluttered and we didn't have space to hang our clothes however it is a spacious flat and because we were there of an evening only, there was room enough for our belongings.  We have no reservations in thoroughly recommending Geraldine's place and will try to secure a reservation if we travel to London again.

Geraldine's place is only a few minutes away from Kennington Station. We found it very convenient. Her home was very lovely and clean when we arrived. She greeted us at the the front of her home and explained what lift to take and what building was hers. She also gave us a tour of her home and showed us how to use the washer and stove. The reference sheet that she gives you is very helpful too. She gave great suggestions, and was very responsive and helpful to any questions we had.
Btw, there is a place nearby called The Dog House which has an amazing portion of Sunday Roast!!
Lovely view, It is a very easy spot to access public transport from to explore London.
Nice location not far from transport. A bit dusty but with a nice view.

Geraldine was super nice and helpful!
the location is great. 5 minutes walk to the underground, bus station right outside the building, 10 minutes walk from a huge Tesco, close to nice pubs.
the building has a concierge, which is always nice.
the apartment was nice and it had everything we needed and more.
however, the building itself is not properly maintained, the lifts were very dirty and we encountered a rat at the entrance - i think it kind of staind our overall feeling of the place.

We had a really nice and convenient stay at Geraldine`s flat. It was just like we had seen on the pictures before booking it. The view from the balcony on the skyline is really spectacular! Also it is very bright and the layout of the flat is very good. The wlan was really fast. Geraldine already left London before we arrived. However she gave us all the information and details that we needed. And she was very fast in answering our questions and concerned that we have a good time in her flat. We can definitely recommend this accodation and would take it again when we are in London next time.

We rented this apartment for a five day stay in London with our son. The apartment had some pros and cons that I will list here.
Pros:
Centrally located.
Very near the underground/subway.
Has an elevator.
Beautiful view of the city.
Very spacious for an apartment in a large city.
Bed in the master bedroom was very comfortable.
Considering it was in the city it was fairly quiet even with the windows open.
It was cool at night so no airconditioning is required.
Living room furniture was comfortable with plenty of space for us to gather at night and in the morning.
The owners left behind some outlet converters which were very much appreciated since the ones we brought do not work in the UK.
We had plenty of nice towels for the three of us.
Large refrigerator with plenty of space for our shopping.
Cons:
The apartment is older and well lived-in.
It was a bit run down and in the case of the bathroom a bit dirty.
I believe this is an apartment that is normally occupied, and like many of us, they have too many things for the storage space available. So, the cabinets in the kitchen were very full with an assortment of odds and ends in addition to the usual kitchen items.
The kitchen has a beautiful wooden counter but it is in bad shape around the sink area.
Balcony was cluttered with old weathered/broken furniture.

We were a party of 5 and found the aparment perfect and spacious enough for all of us. The seperate toilet and shower worked well for us. The common area was cozy and the view was spectaculiar. While 3 of us had tickets to see the freworks at the London Eye, 2 stayed behind and watched it from the balcony. Fantastic view. Location is awesome as well and Geraldine left suggestions for the neighborhood which we enjoyed and checked out a few pubs. It was a fantastic stay in London for us! Highly recommend the apartment.
Nice stay, great location.

Geraldine’s place was perfect for me. As far as the location: Staying in South London was peaceful and less chaotic than being right in the hustle and bustle of the city, but from her place it's just a quick tube ride into the center of it all so you don't feel too removed. There are plenty of pubs and coffee shops within a 10 minute walking distance of the apartment, as well as a Tesco. Plus, she left out wonderful suggestions too.  The space itself is large and was sparkling clean. I will admit I didn't cook but there's a full kitchen that looked fully equipped for any cooking you'd want to do. The view from the balcony is spectacular.  The process to get into the apartment makes it feel very safe (not that there was anything that made me feel unsafe about the neighborhood but as a solo-traveler having the doorman and FOB for all the doors was comforting.) If you are looking to feel like less of a tourist and get a "local" experience while in London, I definitely recommend Geraldine's place. No, it's not a hotel or one of those Airbnb's that basically operates as a hotel so it looks and feels lived in...because it is! And that gives it the charm and warmth you'd want when you're away from your own home. South London Forever! xx
A delightful centrally located apartment with incredible views across London.

El piso y las opiniones no engañan. Está lleno de cosas de la propietaria y eso implica acúmulo de polvo, salvo eso el piso está muy bien, la localización es extraordinaria y los medios de transporte a diversas zonas son muy fáciles. Sin duda las vistas desde el balcón son magníficas. Ojo las personas con cierta movilidad reducida ya que es tipo dúplex estando el baño y las camas en la planta de arriba

Siendo nuestra primera experiencia en Airbnb sentiamos un poco de desconfianza, pero el mejor inicio que pudimos tener fue alojarnos en el apartamento de Adriano, bien localizado, con acceso facil por metro desde y hacia el aeropuerto y a todos los atractivos de Londres.
Contrario a otros comentarios, nosotros si tuvimos contacto frecuente con Adriano pues siempre estuvo al pendiente de nuestras actividades. Buen conversador, comentabamos lo que habiamos hecho y nos recomendaba como movernos de la manera mas facil y economica e hizo nuestra estancia muy agradable.
Si regresamos a Londres nos alojaremos nuevamente en su apartamento y recomendamos que si tienen oportunidad lo hagan.

Being our first experience in Airbnb we felt a little suspicious, but the best start that we could have been was to stay at the Adriano's apartment, well located, with easy access by subway to and from the airport and all the attractions of London.
Contrary to other comments, we had frequent contact with Adriano because he was always watch for our activities. Good conversationalist, we talked about what we had done and advised us how to move in the most easy and cheap way. Adriano made our stay very pleasant.
If we return to London we will stay in her apartment again and recommend that if you have the opportunity to do so.
Adriano was there waiting for us even though we were late arriving.  He took us around the neighborhood and recommended places for us to eat.  He was very hospitable.

The apartment was just as described - beautiful and conveniently located.  It was also surprisingly spacious.  Eleonor's assistant was there to welcome us on arrival and to explain everything about the apartment.  Really a beautiful place to stay.  Eleonor's communication by e-mail was always clear and detailed.

We're a family of four who stayed for three nights in August.
The area is very nice and only fifteen or twenty minutes' walk from the big London museums (and a pleasant walk, too). Not a lot of noise at the front of the building, considering it's at the front of the road. Earl's Court tube station is just around the corner and there are several pleasant restaurants and handy late- opening shops only minutes away.
Elena was away, so we were checked in by Rosi, who was very nice and pleasant.
Be aware, this is an old building and the photos on the site make it look bigger and brighter than it actually is (Elena likes to have one set of curtains kept closed to protect the piano from light- damage, which I understand completely). It's not a problem, though- the flat is pleasant to stay in and you'll have more room than you'd get at a hotel in the area (I priced a few for the same booking, and we'd have paid much more for two bedrooms in a hotel round the corner). Also, Elena was arranging for maintenance work to be done while we were there and the builders were due in after we left.
I'd have no hesitation staying here again, or dealing with Elena or Rosi on another property.
Great place to stay in London, good location and had everything we needed.

We really enjoyed our stay at Eleonor's flat.  You could not ask for a better location in London.  Eleonor met us and walked us through everything we would need to know.  She was warm and accommodating.  We would definitely stay there again!

We, a family of four found the flat perfect with enough room and nice surroundings. Walking distance from museums and tube round the corner. Eleonor was very efficient and got things perfectly organised and was always available for anything we needed. I would definitely book with her again.

My family and I had such a great time visiting London and Eleonor's flat was great to come "home" to each night.  The location of the flat is perfect.  A 10 minute walk to the Earl's Court Tube Station, many pubs/restaurants/cafes, grocery stores, and convenience markets.  The flat was appointed with everything one could need.  We stayed 6 nights and would have loved to stay longer.  The kitchen was fully stocked with plates/glasses/flatware, pots and pans; the family room was spacious for our group of three adults.  The bedrooms were large with comfortable beds and linens.  Plenty of hot water and great water pressure in the shower.  We even did a load of laundry!  We will definitely be back and would love to stay here again!
Lovely flat.  Great location.  No extra charge for 5th person.

The check in and check out process were made really easy by Eleonor and she was very accommodating of our short stay period. The flat was perfectly located for us to hit the museums and to see the sites. It was clean and well presented and was everything we needed it to be and made for a very enjoyable weekend.

Eleonor was very welcoming and helpful, I met her at the flat where she showed me round, gave me instructions on locking the door, using appliances etc. We loved the flat, very clean and in a really good location. Eleanor was kind enough to allow five people to stay, providing sheets for the sofa for the fifth person (still comfy).
It was a brilliant stay and a perfect introduction to airbnb stays for my family. Would definitely stay again!
The apartment was great -- great location, well equipped, and nice welcome from Eleonor.  Would definitely recommend!
A Estadia em Londres foi muito boa. A localização do apartamento é ótima. O bairro é bem gostoso e Fica a algumas quadras do metrô.

The apartment is in an excellent location, very convenient to Earl's Court tube station and numerous bus routes. It is also possible to walk to South Kensington - including the museums in the area.
The apartment itself is very comfortable with all reasonable facilities, including washing machine, microwave, fridge and cook top. The kitchen is well equipped with everything you should need to prepare your own meals/breakfast. The bathroom is sizeable (for London) with carpet flooring. The beds are comfortable and linen provided is adequate. Eleonor was a charming, welcoming host - she greeted us on arrival and was there to bid us farewell when we departed. She was very friendly and obliging.

We (Family with 2 Kids aged 6 and 7) had a great time staying in Eleonors flat! She was most welcoming in hosting us, explained everything to us and was very uncomplicated and supportive when we asked to leave our bags on our departure day until the afternoon.
The flat is situated in a very nice and safe area. Even though there is some traffic on Earls Court Road and also in Old Brompton Road there is little noise during the night and we slept with windows open. House and flat are very nice and clean, even elegant. We had enough space to relax and kids had there places to play. Everything worked fine, kitchen is completely equipped. We also were very happy to use the washing machine. There is a very well working internet connection and a good Bose sound system it the flat, which we enjoyed. We can thoroughly recommend to stay in Eleonors flat and would be happy to stay with her again!

Our choice of where to stay in the capital proved to be a good one.
Eleonor was very welcoming and helpful, the property beautiful and spacious. A perfect location to visit a major exhibition at the V & A.
The nearby restaurants are a must with an excellent choice of cuisine.
Thanks so much Eleonor, our singing host!
Eleonor's flat is ideally situated in central London close to the underground and we enjoyed our stay there. It was perfect on the day of a tube strike as we could walk to the museums.

We (family of four adults and one 3 year old) had a wonderful time staying at Eleonor's. The place was exactly as described and photos were accurate. The kitchen was large and well-equipped, and the beds were comfortable. I found the sofa in the living room a little too soft to sleep on, but obviously it's a personal preference. The bathroom is carpeted as well so we took extra care not to wet the floor. Also, we forgot to check if there was a dryer prior to booking; there is no dryer but Eleonor does provide a drying rack.

Eleonor was excellent in communicating with us prior to our trip, and along with her assistant she was very accommodating with our schedule. At one point we thought the microwave wasn't working and Eleonor was quick to respond to our message.

The apartment is situated in a great area, walking distance to the Earls Court tube station as well as many restaurants and supermarkets. The street is also quiet and from our experience, safe to walk along even at night.

Would definitely recommend Eleonor's apartment to any friends who are planning to visit London.

Great flat, lovely location and Eleonor was a great host. Clear instructions, easy to find the keys, drop them off etc. Flat is exactly as described and it really is a great location. Everything you need in the kitchen and very easy to work. Lovely bathroom with great bath! I will try and stay here again if its available next time I'm coming up.

Eleonor non era a Londra e ha mandato Natalie ad accoglierci ed è stata gentile e ci ha mostrato le funzionalità dell'appartamento. la posizione dell'appartamento è ottima (un po rumorosa la camera che ha la finestra che da su old Brompton road ed ha un materasso un po scomodo, meglio invece il confort dell'altra camera). Se vuoi girare Londra a piedi e il tempo lo permette, partire dalla casa di Eleonor è bellissimo perchè in pochi minuti raggiungi la zona dei musei e dei parchi e passeggiare per quelle vie e in mezzo ai parchi è bellissimo. Se invece preferisci la metro, la fermata di Earls Court è a tre minuti a piedi e da li puoi prendere direttamente la linea blu che ti porta a Piaccadilly in circa 10 minuti. Ringrazio Eleonor anche per aver lasciato la sua bici a disposizione e così sono riuscito anche a fare due pedalate in hyde park e nelle vie del centro.

Eleanor was a great host, replied quick to all of my enquiries and all the procedure was very smooth. The flat is in a great area very convenient for public transport with many amenities and nicely cleaned.
However the flat would benefit from a redecoration especially the bathroom. Also a dryer would be convenient to have.
Otherwise we had a great time. Thank you Eleanor.

Eleonor's house is located near Earl's Court station which is very close to walk to Museums and Hide Park and also very convenient to go to central London or railway stations like Paddington or King's Cross. Rooms, kitchens and bed rooms are very clean and two bedrooms are good to stay for 3 persons. I haven't met Eleonor but she was good to answer all my questions properly.

Absolutely Loved the Flat. Beautiful, Excellent Location. Right near the tube that can take you anywhere you want to go in London very easily. Eleonor made our first trip to London the most memorable. She is very kind and  was very attentive in every way. I have the most highest respect for her. You won't regret staying here.
Eleanor was very helpful host. The property was exactly as described and very tidy. Thank you for putting us up for the day :)
Had a very nice stay

Flat was ok, big a spacious. One of the beds was good, the other horrendous and really needs changing if renting out to guests but I'm sure Eleonor is on the case. We agreed a fee of £160.00 and then were asked for additional cash funds on arrival, not sure if this is standard with AirBnB so watch out for that just in case. Overall 7/10 Enjoy your stay!

The flat is in a nice area and convenient for public transport, and the photos give a pretty good idea of its layout. Note, though, that Eleonor requests the curtains next to the piano to remain shut.
As a previous review pointed out the second bed is not the most comfortable, but padding it with some blankets alleviated that problem. Neither Eleonor nor her assistant were in the country during our stay, nor did anyone show us the flat and its peculiarities. To Eleonor's credit, she responded quickly to our pleas for help when we were unable to locate a tripped fuse, even though it was 2 o'clock in the morning for her.

The check-in and out was really smooth as one would expect, there was a lady waiting for us both the time. Though i was asked to pay an additional £60 for check-in and out which i am not certain was ideal.
The Location was good.
One of the bedrooms were not properly lit including the toilet. The microwave snapped out the very next day we checked in. There was a used soap kept in the toilet sink for us to use; The extra duvet given had holes in them with multiple blood stains-these were rather disappointing.
The flat seemed rather less spacious than what was reflected in the pictures. The host had too much of her own things on the property confining us to lay out our stuff. Single beds were joined to make them into a double bed, which i must say was not comfortable at all at least in one of the rooms. Lastly, there was a fouls small at the entrance of the flat all through out our stay.
If these things are taken care of- i would definitely recommend Eleonor.
房子很棒，很舒服，干净整洁， 地理位置便利。没有看见房东本人， 但非常认真负责，入住和离开都没有问题。就是付款方式比较复杂，而且因为英文沟通的问题，对于外国人来说有些麻烦。

The flat is nice, big, tidy and clean as described. It's convenient and close to the Earls' Court station.
Although we had a small problem with the electricity on the last night, this didn't affect our recommendation to stay in Eleonor flat. and we met Eleonor when we left and she is nice.
Eleonor's flat is really nice. She is a very good host as well. She made everything easy for us. The location is also very good. I would definitely want to stay there for my next visit as well.

Eleanor was accommodating in the check-in as we were arriving on an early 5.55am flight. Location was good at Earl's Court bringing you the District and Piccadilly (from Heathrow) lines. Check-out was easy as discussed with Eleanor the day before we left. Thanks for the apartment.
Eleanor was a great host. The flat was in a lovely old building. Very London.

Location is great! Near the underground and supermarket and post office!
Very nice!!

I could not have asked for a more attentive and helpful host, even whilst Eleonor was out of the country on business, she was able to assist in every way needed.
As two couples staying in the apartment, we were very well catered for and were pleased with all the amenities. The view from the flat is gorgeous, only a few minutes walk from Earls Court tube station, eateries and shops and a gallery. The petrol station is only 5 mins down the road as well.
Being a beautiful vintage build, the windows are quite thin, but the area is so calm, noise pollution is nothing to worry about. This is really the only teeny tiny downside, otherwise, this is a wonderful property with a welcoming, relaxed and cultural feel.
I would happily recommend to staying here, as long as you don't want to book when I next come up!
Thanks for such a nice stay E!
Lovely place

Is an old classic south kensigton flat in a perfect location , 5-10 minutes walk from Earl's court Station .Is exactly what you see in photos.With Eleonor we have perfect communication for every thing and she was a perfect host .Every thing is fine. Αlthough the apartment is in a central location I found it very quiet ...I felt very Londoner
Thanks for all and I hope see you soon again.

We had a great week in London thanks to this perfect accommodation.

great guy - good conversationalist - excellent location with immediate access to all amenities

It was my first time in London and my experience at Adriano's was awesome he was very welcoming and helpful. Adriano is surely a great host! He's very helpful and friendly. He even took me and my friend to a small Brixton tour and suggested us what to see and where to eat. Nossa estadia em Londres foi fantástica, e ficamos muito bem acomodados em Brixton! Adriano foi um anfitrião muito acolhedor e prestativo. We stayed at Adriano's place at the beginning of September for a week. Adrian is a very nice and very helpful host. For my business trip to London  I had a perfect base in his fab flat in Brixton.

We had such a great time in Adriano's place. It was clean, tidy, had everything we needed and was in the perfect location. Adriano is a great host, very nice and interesting! His apartment is very cozy and clean, in a typical london house. The roof terrace is wonderful! Adriano welcomed us personally and gave us many information. We love Brixton. A colorful mix of many nationalities. Thank you Adriano !!!

Die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet und sauber. sie liegt sehr verkehrsgünstig ist trotdem sehr ruhig. Adriano ist ein sehr freundlicher, aufmerksamer und hilfsbereiter Gastgeber.

Adriano is a great host. He's very helpful and friendly.
We had a pleasant stay and would highly recommend this host and location.

My Dad and I spent a week at Adriano's apartment while staying in London and couldn't of been more perfect. The apartment is well kept and comfortable. It's close to the tube and has a great neighborhood pub just two blocks away. Thanks Adriano for the hospitality!

From beginning to end, everything was wonderful in our stay at Eleonor's flat in London. Logement très bien situé. La cuisine est bien équipée.

Our stay was great. We were welcome by Eleanor's assistant and she explained everything clearly to us. All facilities stated were ample for use.
The flat is in a lovely aerea of London. Its a nice flat. It was clean at my arrival and Elena was in contact helping us with everything.

Such a lovely experience dealing with Eleonor. She was an exquisite host, helpful and always responding promptly to messages. It was a real pleasure staying at Eleonor's place. We will definitely come back and highly recommend.

Excellent location, transport for Heathrow & into city. Excellent for neighbourhood walking with good pubs & restaurants.
Had a great 3 days & would stay again

Our stay at Eleonor's flat was amazing. From the very beginning she was very accommodating. Flat itself is big enough for a family of 4, location couldn't be better - just few minutes walk to Earl's Court tube station, many restaurants and shops around. We had a fantastic stay. Thank you Eleonor!
Cosy and well located apartment. I would visit again.

From start to finish, this booking has been excellent. Eleonor was in contact whenever required, and was very helpful and flexible regarding check in and check out. The apartment is great, very clean, ideally situated and very comfortable. I would highly recommend booking to anyone!

Eleonor's house is exactly like the pictures on airbnb, very clean, quiet, comfy and tidy.
We met eleonor a few times during the stay, she is super friendly and replies really quickly. She gave us a very detail house manual, showing how to use tv, and everything which is really nice.
I think the best thing of this house is that there is a lift in the building (which is quite rare in london) and the house locates very close to the earl's court station (which also has lifts too) . Thank you very much for giving us an amazing stay Eleonor :) xx
Terrific place, well located, clean, Eleonor was wonderful.

Beautiful apartment, great location. We were warmly welcomed and made comfortable in every way. It felt like we were visiting a friend!

the flat was much better than expected, and coordination with Eleanor was perfect

A wonderful flat (apartment for those from across the pond).

Great place, location and host. Owner was caring and prompt to attend every issue.

Appartement agréable, spacieux et très propre dans un bel immeuble bien entretenu. Quartier calme, très chouette et pratique (métro et bus à proximité immédiate). Commerces proches et ouverts très tard . Centre très facile d'accès (direct en métro). Nous y avons passé un très bon séjour !
I really had a great night in London, both for the accommodation and sight-views. The house is clean and well decorated. Several markets nearby. And it is very close to the underground station.

appartamento spazioso per una famiglia di 4 persone. Ambiente caldo e accogliente. C'è tutto quello di cui si può avere necessità oltre che comodo e vicino a stazione Earl's Court.

Квартира в типичном старом тихом спальном Лондонском квартале, Цена по мне завышена, чисто опрятно тихо, но смущает наличие вещей хозяина в квартире.

尽管没有和Eleanor见面，但是几次交流都能感觉到她人很善良友爱，我们入住提前了，退房也照顾我们推迟到我们方便的时间，非常感谢！房子和描述的一样，走路去地铁七八分钟，公交车到楼下不远处，附近有几家超市，饭馆都很方便。住了十天感觉很棒！

Great apartment in a very nice area of London, inside Zone 1. Eleonor is a responsive host and we had a great time in London.

Mucho mejor de lo que esperaba, un departamento muy lindo, bien cuidado y limpio, muy cerca de la estación Earl´s Court y de supermercados para compras, un barrio tranquilo y hermoso.

Un lugar super recomendado, volvería sin pensarlo.
Estoy muy agradecido con Eleonor, excelente persona.

We had a great time in London while staying in Eleonor's flat. Very nice flat in a beautiful part of London, Kensington. Two Undergrounds nearby, some pubs and stores just around the corner. We reached many spots in London easily from there. Eleonor is a very freindly person and very talented musician. Would love to come again.

Adriano was a very gracious host. The apartment was extremely clean and comfortable. It was a great home base for our adventures in London. The neighborhood was definitely what we wanted. The roof deck is great for viewing the city. I sincerely recommend.
Great stay, no problems whatsoever.

Great location, just 2 minutes walk to Brixton station (with a 15 min transport to Victoria via tube).
Very nice and helpful host (cheers Adriano!), we stayed in touch weeks before the stay and all worked just fine while there.
The flat is ideal for a couple or 3 people.
Very recommended!

Adriano was a great host & the flat was lovely, clean and in the perfect location. Adriano was incredibly helpful, the flat was very close to a tube station and the Brixton market was amazing. I would recommend this flat wholeheartedly.
Fantastic apartment. Checkin with Adriano was a pleasant and easy process. Great location, right at brixton tube station. Perfect for our 3 nights in London. HIghly recommend this apartment.

I am recommend Adriano flat to anyone who like a nice place and at a nice price too.
Valentin

Adriano was very responsive throughout the booking process and met us right on time to check in. The apartment was very clean with plenty of space and storage. My two sisters and I stayed 4 days in Adriano's flat and we really loved it, Adriano was very kind and he took a time to explain us a little bit of Brixton, you can go anywhere from here by bus or underground it's really well connected with everything, there's a lot of stores, supermarkets, restaurants, etc.

This is a very nice flat and Adriano is a friendly host. Everything needed is there. Good location and very easy to connect to the center of London. The Brixton Village is a dynamic place and we love it very much!

Adriano was a great host and also had a great apartment to offer! The apartment was very close to Metro as well as a range of different restaurants, supermarkets, cafes and pubs. Lovely little flat, really well equipped, nice and warm and in a brilliant location. Adriano was really helpful and accommodating - we really enjoyed our stay. Thank you!

Adriano war ein sehr guter freundlicher Gastgeber. Die Wohnung war in einem guten Zustand und sauber, mit guter Verkehrsanbindung zur Innenstadt und in einem interessanten Viertel gelegen. Empfehlenswert!

Adriano is a lovely fellow and his flat is very clean and comfortable. We had a late flight which was delayed causing poor Adriano to have to wait for us until about 1.30am. He was very gracious about our late arrival, especially as he must have been very tired.

Thanks Adriano.

Großartig auch für einen längeren Aufenthalt. Ruhig gelegen und doch nur wenige Minuten von der U-Bahn-Station Brixton entfernt. Bien accueillis à l'heure et aimablement, appartement assez pratique bien situé au point de vue bus et métro, un marché intéressant pas loin. I stayed in Adriano's flat for most of a week and it turned out to be a truly memorable experience. Another guest commented on the state of the entrance and, yes, it could be improved. But once inside the flat, its a whole different story. The accommodation is airy, comfortable and modern. I used the kitchen on a number of occasions and found it well equipped, clean and efficient. The living room is sunny and bright, the bedroom quiet and cosy. All facilities (plumbing, lighting, heating, cooking, wifi, etc.) were working as expected.
I have also to say a few words about Adriano himself. I was delayed on arrival, but Adriano didn't show the least annoyance; he greeted me warmly and spent time going over all the details of the flat. As you can see from his text, Adriano's a big fan of Brixton and he encouraged me to explore its various and colourful offerings. He even accompanied me to the Brixton market to show me some of his favorite shops.
The flat is very conveniently located a few steps away from the Victoria line tube. Getting there involves wading through crowds of people that seem to continuously swarm around the Brixton tube station and adjoining market area. In spite of all this frenetic activity however, the flat being on a quiet side street is isolated from the clamour. The only noise I heard from the flat were fire crackers on the evening of my 5 November arrival : I hadn't reckoned on Guy Fawkes! The rest of my stay was quiet and very calm.
In short, I was entirely satisfied with my choice of this Brixton flat and found my host to be a most friendly, helpful and considerate person.

Everyone else has fairly accurately summed up the experience with Adriano and his lovely flat in Brixton.  Location and convenience cannot be beat.  A hop, skip and a jump from the Underground (Metro), plus access to several buslines available on the High Street makes for easy transport to just about anywhere in London. The apartment itself is clean and well organized. The kitchen is well equipped...enough for us to prepare a small Thanksgiving feast for a few friends.  The building is quiet.  The neighborhood is well appointed with stores, restaurants, and things of interest. There is plenty of heat in the apartment, it is well lite with lots of windows for getting sunlight, fresh air and a nice view of the street and outside world.  The one problem/issue is something out of Adriano's control.  The building itself and the entrance to the building is in dire need of maintenance and upkeep.  If you're familiar with British construction and maintenance techniques, you might not be too shocked because this is standard issue.   If you come to his apartment, prepare for this.  But, once inside, you will be happy. you rented

My husband and I were very pleased to be able to use Adriano's apartment while visiting relatives in Brixton. Rather than having to stay in their small flat we were able to use this spacious and clean apartment which is so very close to the centre of Brixton.

The apartment t is fantastically conveniently situated and would be perfect for a few days in London. We would be more than happy to rent this apartment again.
Nicely decorated flat close to the station, we(me and 3 friends) enjoyed the stay at the flat. Adriano was really cool as well!!

A big thanks to Adriano. We would definitely stay there again.
