Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Londres.La maison est comme sur les photos et le centre de Londres est vraiment à 30 minutes en métro.Nous avons pu stationner la voiture juste devant la maison et le quartier est vraiment calme.Susan est une hôte charmante et disponible.Elle n'avait pas manqué de nous donner toutes les instructions concernant la maison.Je recommande vivement cette maison.

The house was very comfortable to stay in. Everything was as promised when we arrived. Only the dustbins were not emptied. But that was OK. All in all a perfect location for our short stay! We definitely recommend Susan's house.

It was our second time at Susan's house and again we had a wonderful time. The house is very spacious and offers every convenience. The neighbourhood of Wanstead is also very nice, the tube is only a short walk away and there are nice restaurants and shops also within walking distance. The only downside was that the apartment was not as clean as last year, but I'm sure the cleaner just overlooked a few things and will do it better next time.
All in all we had a great time at Susan's and would always recommend this apartment. It's one of the best places to stay for this price!

Nous étions 6 amies à visiter Londres et l'appartement était très joli, les lits confortables . L'accès aisé avec le métro . Excellente solution . A refaire !
Un seul bémol : les nettoyages mal faits mais cela sera corrigé m'a affirmé Suzanne !

Das Haus ist sehr gut gelegen, zur Haltestelle Wanstead der London Underground sind es nur wenige Minuten. Auch ist die Erreichbarkeit vom Flughafen Stansted ist gut. In unmittelbarer Umgebung befinden sich verschiedene Restaurants, Supermärkte und Geschäfte, das Stadtviertel ist gepflegt. Die Einrichtung ist geschmackvoll und modern und die Raumaufteilung eignet sich für Familien mit Kindern oder eine kleine Gruppe. Die Kommunikation mit der Gastgeberin war gut und unkompliziert. Wir würden das Haus jederzeit gerne wieder mieten.

The location is great, close to the tube and to the supermarket. Check-in was very convenient. The kitchen is well equipped. We were three couples and stayed 4 nights. The smaller room (in the front) was very bright in the morning from 5:30 - not sure we would recommend a longer stay. Apart from that, we felt very comfortable and had lots of space. Would definitely stay again when traveling with a big group.

nice flat in London, close to Wanstead metro station.
We did not see Susan, but she was very helpful and answered our emails.

House is exactly as drescribed - fully equipped and comfortable.
Spacious bedrooms and 3 bathrooms are perfect for a relaxing stay.

Tube station is just around the corner. Shops and restaurants are also nearby.

Susan was very responsive and helpful with our questions prior to the trip.

Abbiamo alloggiato in questa casa 3 gg e ci siamo trovati benissimo.la casa molto bella,grande e pulita.il quartiere carinissimo,con pub,market,ristoranti,ecc e cmq la casa e' ben collegata alla metropolitana che in 20/25 minuti porta comodamente in centri.giudizio ottimo.grazie susan per la tua cortesia,disponibilità.
Very nice house in super location. 1 minute to underground, 25 minute to London dountown. Clean and comfortable.

Hi Susan, our group had a really wonderful time in your house, which is very comfortable and is tastefully furnished. We were deeply contented about the fine weather we had. To sum up, we had a fantastic time in London and we will recommend the house to our friends.
Thank you so much!
Best regards from Austria
Renate & Jana

A real clean house with all the comfort. So close to the underground, no really, so close! Only one minor issue for non-English people: the switches for the use of the outlets and the main circuit breaker. It would have been nice that we knew this. We had to find out how to use the 'electrickery'. But once we had found out what it could be, it was a magical beautiful stay. Also the immediately response of Susan was great! Send an e-mail and few hours later you have response. Very handful information received when we made the reservation and also when we arrived at the house.
Unfortunately I haven't seen Susan (was already sleeping at 9.30pm because I was so tired) but my sisters and brother did and they all agreed that she was very friendly :-).
Yep, this is going to be our place when we will visit London again!
Thanks for everything, as said before: it was a magical stay!! :-)

nous venons de passer 4 jours très agréables à Londres. le descriptif est conforme.La maison est très propre et bien équipée. Le quartier est calme. Le métro est à proximité et nous emmène au centre de Londres en 30 minutes. Susan répond très rapidement à nos demandes. Bref, une adresse à conserver et à recommander

Susan was great from the start. Lots of info and all questions answered speedily. The house is great with a large lounge/dining area with ample seating for 6-8 in both. Good kitchen with everything you could need DVD three very good bedrooms - two with large, modern ensuites.

Location is excellent for tube and wanstead high street.

Wir (2 Familien ,7 Personen) haben das Haus für 6 Tage gemietet.
Alle waren rundum zufrieden mit den Räumlichkeiten und der Einrichtung.
Die U-Bahn ist in 3 min Fußweg zu erreichen. In 20 min ist man im Zentrum
von London.Verschiedene Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und Restaurants sind in
10 min zu Fuß zu erreichen.

Schönes, gut/modern eingerichtetes Reihenhaus für bis zu 7 Personen. Sehr dicht an der Underground Station Wanstead -> ca. 20min bis London Innenstadt. Susan sehr nett und man bekommt schnelle Antworten. Parken an der Strasse gut möglich mit Anwohnerparkscheinen (stellt Susan z.V.). In der Nähe (High Street) kann man gut Essen etc. einkaufen (Coop). Einziger Nachteil  ist die dicht vorbeiführende Schnellstrasse / Stadtautobahn, diese ist deutlich zu hören (d.h. im Hof sitzen ist nicht wirklich eine Option)   muss man aber in einer Großstadt akzeptieren...

Somos una familia con tres niños y la casa fue perfecta, amplia, todo con poco uso y limpio. Enseguida te sientes como en casa! El barrio muy tranquilo y con todo a mano, sobre todo es perfecto tener la línea Central del metro justo al lado para ir a Central London. Y tener tres dormitorios con tres baños, para las chicas fue ideal! Susan no interfiere para nada pero está dispuesta para cualquier cosa que necesites. Una auténtico hogar fuera del tuyo. Lo recomiendo.
Adriano is a most delightful person. We met him and he showed us how every thing worked. So gorgeous and happy

Brixton was great.  Loved the location of the flat.  Happy that the bedroom was at the back because the street in front of the house can be quite noisy.  We had to adjust the shower temperature at the water heater in the kitchen because the cold water isn't working in the bath - a bit awkward to run back and forth (Adriano said the council had turned it off).

Great experience with Adriano. Went out of his way to help accommodate our check in time. Great flat. Clean, tidy, all required amenities and as described.  Local area is vibrant with friendly and interesting locals!
The place was very clean, great location. Adriano was very prompt and helpful. A very good experience

Ottima esperienza.
Appartamento accogliente, è organizzato.
Collegato benissimo per raggiungere i mezzi pubblici( bus e tube ) praticamente a 2 minuti a piedi.
Bagno pulito e comodo, Camera da letto pulita, si dorme bene, non si sentono rumori, pur essendo in zona centrale.
La cucina, va a adattamento.
Le pentole Da non tenere in considerazione, Forse per gli standard londinesi va anche bene, ma dato che si paga una buona cifra, si potrebbero far trovare utensili, fornelli, e oggetti da cucina in genere, in condizioni almeno accettabili.
Per il resto ok,
Adriano sempre molto disponibile e cordiale.
Alla prossima.
Really nice flat in a great location right next to Brixton Market. Adriano was easy to communicate with and replied to all messages instantly. I would definitely stay in his flat again !
Adriano is a very nice guy who looks good after his guests. The flat was clean and everything we needed was there. Would be nice to go there again. Thanks for everything!
Great location, nice apartment,clean and quiet.
This flat is well cared for, cozy, very clean and fully equipped. Communication was smooth and easy.  I am sure you will enjoy this choice.
A home away from home. Lovely spacious and well lit flat, perfect location. Great and responsive host - thanks for having us! We will be back
The place was convenient and Adriano was very nice and very responsive. It wasn't as clean and sparkly as the pictures, but it was fine enough for the time we stayed.
Adriano's place was in a great location, really super close to Brixton tube station and only a short train ride to central London. It was well furnished and clean

因為照片中的房間採光明亮，因此吸引我下訂。但當地除了近地鐵站而交通便利之外，其它無ㄧ優點。
附近人種出沒複雜，樓梯間無燈又有臭味，每每總是讓人掩鼻而過。
綜合以上所有...並不推薦入住！

Brixton is a busy and vibrant community so it was a pleasure to be in and about the streets. The downside was that it could get too busy but many would not consider that a bad thing. Adriano was always pleasant and quick to remedy any problems that ocurred.
The flat was a little smaller than expected but otherwise comfortable and easy to manage.

The flat was so much better than expected! Bright and clean, very cozy and like home. Adriano did everything in his power to fix tiny issues coming up with our light, he was extremely friendly and helpful. The area is very safe and quiet, although it's only a few seconds away from Brixton central. There is so much to do and so much to see, amazing restaurants and the cutest cinema.
Definitely recommend it to anyone!

Very good choice for a visit to London and Brixton. Perfect location, close to underground, buses, restaurants and bars. Only 10 minutes to Oxford Circus with the underground.
The living room is bright with big windows, and the apartment suited us two very well. It was also warm and nice (some London apartments are quite cold).
The only negative is that the cleaning could have been a bit better, surfaces like floors, tables etc were ok, but a more thorough housecleaning would be good.
Brixton is a very nice part of London, with interesting restaurants and bars, especially the arcades with shops and restaurants, Brixton Brewery and POP Brixton, a market area created with containers.
We would like to stay here again.
Great place great location and great host! Adriano was so helpful in getting us set-up in his wonderful Brixton flat!

We enjoyed our stay at Adriano's place. The flat is very well situated being less than 5 minutes to the tube and very close Brixton academy and a variety of decent pubs of which Adriano gave us directions to.
The flat itself was as expected and was perfect for all our needs - we felt very comfortable during our stay.

Adrianos place was clean, comfy and had everything i needed for my stay! it was perfect for one person or a couple, right in the centre of Brixton and only 2 mins walk to the tube, surrounded by loads of bars and restaurants. Would definitely recommend and would stay again! Thanks Adriano!

Adriano's flat is a nice, bright accommodation. It offers a fair value for the area. It's steps from the Tube (on the 24/7 Victoria line!) and adjacent to a vibrant, dynamic market spanning several blocks. The flat itself offers a living space with large windows, a full scale kitchen, generous bath and quaint bedroom.
If you want to stay like a local in a vibrant, active South London neighborhood, head to Brixton and stay at Adriano's place!
We enjoyed staying in Brixton and Adriano's place suited our needs well.  Adriano was a considerate host and I would stay here again.

Great location, great value! Comfortable and cozy, steps away from main tube line and all Brixton has to offer. Adriano is charming and pleasant. He was very responsive and easy to communicate with prior to arrival. Since normal check-in is 3pm and our flight arrived around 5 am, he agreed to let us check-in early morning, for a nominal fee, which made a huge difference to us (only possible if nobody uses the flat the night before).
Cheers!

Adriano's apartment is perfect if you have a short stay in Brixton. Location wise it could not be in a better location with great proximity to Brixton village, Academy, underground etc.
The apartment itself is warm with everything you would expect. The sofa bed is surprisingly comfy and the bed is also fantastic.
Would 100% recommend Adriano's apartment and we intend on making this our place to stay for future ventures to Brixton!

A very good stay for exploring London. A few steps away from the underground central line and a few stations away from the jubilee line. We stayed with five and for us the house was spacious. It's modern, clean and the kitchen is complete. The wifi goes very fast. Within a few hundred meters there are two supermarkets and some other shops. And a nice pub too. Though we haven't seen her, it seemed possible to have a good communication with Susan.
Great place to stay.

Susan was an excellent host.  She was in touch well before we arrived with clear and specific instructions.  The house was exactly as described in the description. It was clean, comfortable and had everything we needed for our two week stay including some food basics (spices, coffee, tea etc.) that made settling in much easier.

We arrived a little early and cleaning was still in progress.
We stayed six people for three days and were very satisfied with the house which was located very close to the Wanstead tube station.
High street in Wanstead had nice shops, supermarkets, café’s and a big playground which our kids enjoyed a lot.
The house is situated very close to the Wanstead tube station so getting into the city would take about 25-30 minutes on the train and 10 minutes to Stratford where the big shopping centre is located. Buying off-peak tickets makes this a cheap and convenient way to travel in London.
The house has three nice bedrooms and three newly renovated bathrooms. The house has enough space for seven people and all in all we are very satisfied with our stay. Highly recommended.

Le logement est tel qu'il est décrit et les photos correspondent vraiment à ce que nous avons eu.
Nous sommes partis entre amis, à 7, et c'était parfait. Spacieux, confortable et assez bien situé. Le métro se trouve à 1 minute à pied de la maison et on arrive au centre de Londres en 25 minutes. Il y a également des bus de nuit qui passent tout près de la maison. Très bon rapport qualité prix.

Susan est une hôte disponible qui répond rapidement à toutes les questions. Nos échanges étaient très courtois et je vous conseille vivement d'aller passer un petit séjour chez elle.

Super séjour , merci Susan! La proximité de la station de métro est vraiment un avantage. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié d'avoir 3 salles de bain. Tout était parfait. Cuisine bien équipée également. Le quartier de Wanstead est vivant et sympa.

Very accurate, great location very close to the Tube to make getting into London a breeze. Communication by Susan was good (not having heating at home couldn't work out heaters and she sent her sister around to show us how they worked). Access instructions easy to follow and appropriate number of keys provided for the amount of guests. Lounge room and kitchen great space to hang out. We were a family group of 2 x 60's, 2 x late 30's, 1 x 21 and 1 x 4yr old.  The 21 yr old female came home late at night and felt very safe walking alone. Rooms - Number 1 - up first flight of stairs - ensuite very large, had bath and shower - bedroom very dark. Number 2 - up - first flight of stairs - no ensuite but bathroom in hall - shower and toilet only - tiny - bedroom not as dark due to street lights. Number 3 - up second flight of stairs - ensuite very large - room very light from skylights. I had room 2 and the bed was very comfortable. Washing machine was great and there is a laundry down high street to take it to dry if it is raining like it did for us for the week. Wanstead is a lovely little suburb - lots of places to eat (try the pub across from the tube and the fish and chip shop) and a Tesco in High Street which is easy to get to on foot. Very clean and food left by previous guests so check the kitchen before you shop as some good basics. Very good value for money. Take note of the black book of instructions and have a great time. Would definitely return in the future.

Ci siamo trovati molto bene a casa di Susan. Casa comoda e pulita. Anche se lontana dalla City è ben servita dai mezzi pubblici; la fermata della Central Line è dietro casa ed in circa mezz'ora ti porta in città. In una zona tranquilla, con negozi, ristoranti e pub. Per chi atterra a Stansted in quaranta minuti, con Terravision, raggiunge Redbridge che dista poco piú di  un km dalla casa, che noi abbiamo raggiunto a piedi percorrendo una pista ciclabile che costeggia una strada molto trafficata. Esperienza positiva. Grazie Susan!

The house was perfect for our needs. Spacious and clean.
Would definitely return again.

Susans house is lovely, tidy and clean. The location is very convenient within only a minute from the underground station.
There seems to be a slight water damage in the kitchen ceiling but that didn´t affect us very much and all the rest was very pleasant.
Thank you for the very nice experience!

Casa molto bella, pulita, le foto quasi non rendono.
Al piano terra c'è il soggiorno in parquet, la cucina (con lavastoviglie e lavatrice) e l'accesso al giardino; al primo piano ci sono 2 stanze e 2 bagni (1 padronale); al secondo un'altra camera con bagno padronale.
La metro (central line) dista 3 minuti, per arrivare in centro occorrono circa 25 minuti.
La zona è carina, il pub fuori dalla metro (The George) è ottimo anche per mangiare e anche piuttosto economico (circa 10 pound per 1 piatto, birra e dolce).
Per colazione c'è uno Starbucks ma io vi consiglio Nice Croissant che è poco più avanti se preferite una colazione "all'italiana".
Noi eravamo in 6 e alla fine questa sistemazione si è rilevata pure economica rispetto a un hotel...... l'unica controindicazione è che se volete fare tardi la sera in centro dovete mettere in conto il tragitto del ritorno.

Susan was heel behulpzaam en antwoordde onmiddellijk op alle vragen die wij op voorhand stelden!  Het huis was echt vlakbij de high street en vlakbij de underground gelegen dus op 1 minuutje stappen van het huis vond je alles wat je nodig had (Co-op, restaurantjes + underground)

We had a wonderful time in London. The house was lovely and we enjoyed our accommodation. The house was clean and very convienent. We were with 5 persons and we had enough space.
Getting there and leaving to the centre was really easy. After a 3 min walk we were at the tube station. Every night we ate at The George, the pub accross the tube station. Good food for a good price.
The city trip was a blast and we recommend the house to everyone who wants to visit London. The next time we visit London we will definitely go to this home for another stay.

The location is great, being just 2 mins from the Wanstead Underground Station on the Central Line. The house was very comfortable and clean, and was exactly as described. It fit our family of 6 perfectly. The neighbourhood was safe and quiet, with the shopping area within walking distance. Overall, a very good place to stay.

Het huis was lekker warm toen we aankwamen. Het was schoon. Er zijn drie ruime slaapkamers en drie mooie badkamers. De keuken is helemaal compleet, voorzien van magnetron, oven, vaatwasser, waterkoker.
Alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig.
De ligging van het huis is perfect, metrostation Wanstead is om de hoek, centrum van Londen is makkelijk te bereiken. We landden op Southend, vanaf vliegveld ongeveer 45 minuten met de trein en dan nog een paar haltes met de metro. Het huis is een echte aanrader. Wij waren met vijf personen, maar voor zeven personen is er ook ruimte genoeg.

This house is a fantastic place to stay in Wanstead. It is exactly as it looks in the photos and Susan was very helpful and responsive. The kitchen in particular is incredibly well equipped, we had family over one Sunday for lunch and easily catered for 11 people!

One of the many benefits of this house is its proximity to the tube station and all of the shops on Wanstead High Street. This house easily sleeps 7 people in comfort.

I highly recommend this accommodation.
Très bonne communication avec l'hôtesse avant notre séjour. Logement conforme au descriptif, spacieux et très bien équipé. Situation très centrale, idéale pour un court sejour à Londres.

My sister and I with our teenage children thoroughly enjoyed our stay in Susan's home in Wanstead.    It was a perfect base to explore the sights of London and very comfortable, warm & cosy to relax in the evening after busy days sightseeing.  The house was very well equipped and having 3 bathrooms was a huge bonus with teenagers! Wanstead has a lovely village feel despite being so close to London city and has supermarket, coffee shops, hairdressers etc.  The one small issue we had with a beeping smoke alarm (due to low battery) was dealt with promptly & efficiently by Susan.  We are very happy to recommend Susan and her lovely home to other visitors to London.  This was our first AirBnB experience and we are looking forward to our next adventure.

Susan was very accommodating with our booking, particularly as we had to make a small change. We appreciated her supplying parking permits as we had a car for the first  day there. Our family of 5 were very comfortable as the flat is very clean, spacious, light and warm. Its close to Wanstead tube station and local shops.

Superb place - even though it looks fantastic in the pictures, even better when you get there and a lovely neighbourhood too. Will definitely be our first port of call next time we're staying in that region - thanks Susan!
Beautiful, spacious apartment. Everything worked smoothly. Could not have hoped more from our first airbnb experience. Nice area and good restaurants nearby.

I just wanted to say we had a great time in your house it was very clean when we arrived
It is located in a very good place 1 min walk from the tube and 3-4 min from grocery store and other restaurants
We had all we needed in the house at it was very convenient that every room has private shower and toilet
We will come back again !
Thx and Best Regards

Great house, good for three couples with 3 baths. Not perfectly provided (no possibility to have a fresh coffee)  but spacious and easy to reach via tube. Near kind of city-highway is audible when sleeping with open window.

Great place to stay for a family holiday in London. Extra handy for the Tube and shops. Wanstead is unexpectedly pleasant, like a small town really, with a couple of green spaces and a high street. The house itself is as described, clean, comfortable and quiet, with good bedding. Susan was very responsive when we discovered we only had one set of keys and popped round that same day to drop another one off.
5 of us stayed comfortably and felt it was a real luxury to have one spacious bathroom per bedroom!

Wij hebben met ons gezin van 6 (2 volwassenen en 4 zonen) hier enkele dagen doorgebracht tijdens de paasvakantie. Het rijhuis is erg gerieflijk en heeft drie ruime badkamers. Het is uitstekend gelegen, op wandelafstand van een metrostation (Wanstead) zodat je in 20 minuten in het centrum van Londen staat. Er zijn enkele restaurants in de onmiddellijke nabijheid alsook een buurtwinkel en bakker. Kortom, voor ons een ideale uitvalsbasis !
L hôte A été parfaite , elle a été très présente pour répondre à mes questions .
Todo estaba impecable, en muy bien estado. El barrio es muy bueno, se puede pasear a cualquier hora y el metro se encuentra muy cerca asi como el supermercado.

Great location. Really is only minutes from the tube station and Wanstead High Street and just 30 mins to central London.
The house had a 'good feel' about it, very cosy, but with plenty of space and with a good kitchen. (We had 7 people staying)
The host Susan was very easy to deal with and extra requests were dealt with simply and promptly.

Great house.
Good location.
Accommodating host.

Logement correspond parfaitement aux photos. Les chambres sont confortables et les salles de bains (3) modernes. La cuisine très fonctionnelle. Le livre de bord simple et instructif, infos supermarchés et plans pratiques. Appartement à 200m. du métro Wanstead. Le check-in se fait de façon très pratique.

Everything was perfect. We found the keys, house was exactly like in description. The location is great, some 150 m from the Underground station. The restaurant in neighbourhood, the George offers good food (and bear or wine also) in very attractive prices. Everything, in fact, even exceeded our expactations (we were 3 couples travelling for visiting and sightseeing London).
Wir waren mit allem rundum sehr zufrieden. Susan hat sich liebevoll um alles gekümmert und alles war genau so, wie es versprochen war.

My family enjoyed staying in this modern, spacious apartment. There was plenty of room for 5 of us to spread out comfortably. We also enjoyed walking around the small suburb of Wanstead and the convenience of the Underground station- just 2 blocks away. Susan was very helpful when I emailed her for assistance after we arrived.

Accoglienza perfetta e l'alloggio ha superato le aspettative, tutti noi siamo rimasti molto soddisfatti. Il quartiere è molto comodo da tutti i punti di vista: vicino alla metropolitana, a supermercati e ristoranti/pub, inoltre è tranquilissimo.

The house was vacant and the host had arranged for the key to be available. It was clean and had a very welcoming feel to it. Everything needed was provided. An adequate information book was available re details for the house and also about the area.
Proximity to the train station and shops was very close and easy to manage. In all we enjoyed our time and feel it contributed pleasure to our whole experience in London.

This is a lovely place to stay with 2 kids and 4 adults.  Close to a pub, tube stop, and restaurants.  It is only a few stops away from a Westfield Stratford City mall (which was an added bonus for our guests who live in Switzerland.)

This flat is perfect for a stay in Brixton. The village, Ritzy and everything else is within easy walking distance and yet is quiet and slightly tucked away. The church tower and clock is just far enough away to hear the time! The local pub The Trinity Arms is a really good traditional London boozer. The flat is clean, modern, warm and comfortable with everything you need and more. Adriano is very helpful and kind - the perfect host.

I had a great stay in Adriano's flat.  Fantastic location (literally 2 minutes walk to Brixton Station), a very nice and well equipped space and Adriano is an excellent and very friendly host.  I would definitely recommend this flat to anyone coming to London wanting to stay close to Central, but away from the tourist area.  Everything you could need is within an easy walk on the rainy days when you don't want to venture far, and at the same time, it's just minutes on the tube to get to central London. If you enjoy Brixton life, you will love Adriano's flat.  I would definitely stay here again.

Adriano is a very friendly host, with clear communication and an easy check-in / check-out process. The apartment is adorable and well equipped with lots of character in a fantastic location. Highly recommended. Many thanks for a fantastic stay, Adriano!
I was looking for a place to host my sisters
Fantastic location, clean flat, very cozy ! thanks !
Great spot, very close to the Brixton tube stop, market, etc. That being said, was also a quiet sleep with courtyard facing room. Would stay here again. Adriano was a communicative and gracious host

Adriano was very friendly, easy to deal with and accommodating.  The apartment was an easy walk to the Underground and bus-stop.  Tesco (grocery store) was also right around the block, which was convenient since we visited it 3 times during our short stay.  Visiting central London was only about a 15-20 minute ride by the Underground, and slightly longer by double-decker bus.  If it is your first time visiting London (as it was mine), I would recommend researching the public transportation options if that will be your means of transportation.  I had not done so, and Adriano was helpful in discussing some options, but we would have had more options with advance planning.  I would recommend the apartment to someone looking for a good deal and willing to be slightly outside of central London.  We saved about half vs. the hotel I had booked in Victoria; and had more room, a full kitchen, etc.
Great neighbourhood, apartment ideally located near great restaurants and the Tube. Adriano was a lovely host. Recommended

Adriano is wonderful host. He is very accommodating and thoughtful. I informed him that this trip was for celebrating my birthday and he sent me a wonderful message wishing me Happy Birthday. He ensured that I was aware of everything in the flat and he also made sure I knew where the key places were in the neighborhood. Wonderful place to stay with a wonderful host.

Adriano was a fantastic host, with quick and easy communication before and during the stay. The apartment is central in that it's a 15 minute trip into London, including walking to the station. Little noise at nights throughout the week, but on weekends there was plenty of noise, so just be prepared for that on Friday and Saturday nights (yet it is London). Well stocked kitchen made preparing meals easy, with a large supermarket 5 minutes walk away. Main bed was comfy and the bathroom spacious for the size of the apartment. Only thing was the TV connection was very poor, but didn't use it much so not a big deal. Would definitely recommend for a more spacious, yet still central base when in London :)
A nice and spacious that gets a lot of light. Well situated on a quiet street in lively Brixton with excellent transport connections. Adriano is a friendly, communicative and helpful host.
Amazing flat, perfect location and amazing host! Will definitely book again when in London! Thank you!!
Nice place close to Brixton station.
it is a great place to live and in good location. the host is very nice. i recommend this house.

Adriano was a fantastic host, went above and and beyond to make sure I was comfortable. The apartment is easy to get to, great tube station access, nearby grocery and pubs. Was in London for a month and this was home base. Absolutely loved Brixton. Would recommend this space.

El alojamiento es como se ve en las fotos. Adriano es de lo mas atento y agradable. Si bien el barrio es alejado de la city de Londes lo cierto es que el metro esta a una cuadra y es de lo mejor para trasladarse

Small but perfectly formed, this is a lovely, quiet flat just a few minutes from Brixton tube. Very homely & comfy. Hair dryer, iron, well equipped kitchen. Adriano is always informative, available & quick to respond to any question. I had a very easy & agreeable stay at his flat.

Lovely apartment in the heart of Brixton and close to the tube station so access to the city is great. As a host Adriano was very communicative and hospitable for self check-in service. Would very much recommend booking this place for short or long stays in South West London.

Repeat stay at Adriano’s apartment. Highly recommend for many reasons, including: welcoming, comfortable apartment, with thoughtful supply of needed amenities; and wonderful location: nearby transport (Tube, buses, train; a mere 10-15 minutes to heart of the city); Brixton Market, shopping, eateries. And it’s readily accessed from Heathrow via Express and Tube system. Thoroughly enjoyed the stay.
Great place to stay. Convenient for transportation, calm and comfortable
Fantastic appartment in an amazing location. Adriano is a great host and very easy to contact. We will definitely stay here again
Great location very close to Brixton tube. Compact, clean, and easy-to-manage flat good for work trips. Nice host.  Thanks Adriano

Il soggiorno è stato molto gradevole; l'appartamento è perfettamente corrispondente all'annuncio, grazioso, confortevole, attrezzato, vicinissimo alla metro. il quartiere è tranquillo e vi si trova di tutto. L'host ci ha fornito i chiarimenti e le informazioni necessarie per il nostro soggiorno. Lo consigliamo vivamente
Everything what was described was true, very nice, clean and spacious home. Quiet neighborhood and good location.

Yes, it was just like the listing. It was fantastic. So very clean and welcoming. The neighbourhood was great -- safe, friendly and accessible. Getting to the flat was easy. Getting into the flat and getting settled was no problem whatsoever.

Everything was as expected. Susan gave us immediate responses to our questions and doubts. The house was excellent, the neighbourhood quiet,  the underground nearby was of a great help. We were there with four teenagers and they simply loved it!!

Eine perfekte Wohnung für einen mehrtägigen Stadtbesuch, gut ausgestattet (für jedes Bad ein Föhn wäre allerdings wünschenswert),
super Anbindung an Bus und U-Bahn (150 m zur Central-Line), sehr gute Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Nähe, eine Vielfalt an Pubs und Restaurants in der näheren Umgebung. Zusammen gefasst:
GROSSARTIG!!!!

This was the perfect house for our stay in London. The house was exactly as advertised and just two short blocks to the Underground with the High street just past it. The village itself was very charming, with great restaurant choices and groceries nearby. The Underground station had an escalator, which was wonderful for my step-mother who unexpectedly needed a wheelchair for this trip. Once we figured out how to get the heat to turn on (the mid-September weather was just starting to require it at night), we couldn't have been happier.

11 Camden Rd is an absolute gem. Wanstead is so convenient to everything in London, the Tube is a 1min walk from house & then 20mins to Liverpool St. The lovely village has every service required and the George Pub is amazing - 2 steak meals & bottle wine for only £18 and bar prices very affordable.
The house is spotlessly clean and exactly as described. The hostesses were very helpful making sure our stay was enjoyable. The only minor issue was new tenant's arriving with luggage at 10 30 am when there is a 12 pm checkout. It wasn't a drama though as we planned on leaving at approx 11pm anyway.
We rate it one of the best places we have ever stayed -if not the best?
Gordon & Betty New Zealand

Appartamento molto grande, spazioso, pulito e ben curato. Ogni camera ha il proprio bagno riservato. Tutto perfetto come da descrizione. Si trova in una zona molto carina anche se un po' lontana dal centro (la stazione della metro è a 100 metri e servono circa 20 minuti per raggiungere il centro).
Insomma, tutto perfetto e come da descrizione.
We never met our host, the listing was ver accurate and the neighbourhood seemed nice.

La estadia resultó excelente. Realmente la casa es muy cómoda y está muy bien ubicada a sólo 5 minutos a pié de la estación Wanstead.
Los 3 dormitorios son comfortables, lo mismo que la sala de estar con TV y wifi.
La cocina tiene todo lo necesario (horno,hornallas,microondas,heladera,freezer,lavavajilla,lavarropas,tostadora,etc) en perfecto estado.
El pequeño jardín del fondo es agradable como para tomar un trago al atardecer.
La anfitriona estuvo en contacto con nosotros y nos ofreció sin cargo una limpieza con cambio de sábanas y toallas a mitad de la semana.
El barrio es sumamente agradable,el pub que se encuentra a 2 cuadras es excelente y el supermercado Coop es magnífico con sus bajos precios.
En rsumen es altamente recomendable.

Deze eerste airbnb-ervaring vergeten we niet snel. De foto's op de site waren zó mooi en de beschrijving zo veelbelovend, dat we met spanning het weekend tegemoet gingen. Susan heeft ons niet teleurgesteld: op zijn Nederlands gezegd 'wysiwyg': what you see is what you get. Geen beeld of woord gelogen. Een heerlijk huis met ieder stel (3x2) een eigen slaap/badkamer. De woonkamer ruim genoeg, maar weinig gebruikt, want een weekendje Londen moet je buiten beleven. De metro op 2 minuten lopen, de supermarkt op 5 minuten... meer heb je niet nodig.

The House was perfect. Everything was as described. We would always come back and stay again.
The House easily fits up to seven people. The house (especially the kitchen) is very well furnished. We found everything we needed.
Wanstead is a lovely town, there are supermarkets and small cafes on the main street. The underground station Wanstead is just one minute walk from the house. Susan is a very good host.

Wir hatten einen großartigen Aufenthalt in London, das Haus war einfach perfekt, sauber und sehr gemütlich. Es hat genau die richtige Größe für 7 Personen. Alles war fein. Die U-Bahnstation ist um die Ecke und in 20 Minuten ist man Mitten in London.
Wanstead bietet alles was man braucht und da es uns Erwachsenen und den Kindern bei „George“ nicht nur gut gefallen, sondern auch gut geschmeckt hat, haben wir die gut bestückte Küche gar nicht in Anspruch genommen.
Kurz: alles war wunderbar und wir würden uns sofort wieder für Susans Haus entscheiden!!

The accommodation was excellent, well furnished and stocked for a number of guests staying. It is really convenient to Wanstead and, despite it's central location, really quiet and peaceful.

Picking up the keys etc. was really easy also. All very well set up.

Total zufrieden, alles war super! Nur paar meter entfernt von wansted station ! wir waren zu siebt im alten von 18-21 und es hat sich super gelohnt ! 3 duschen mit 3 zimmern purer luxus, und die küche war bestens ausgestattet:)
danke susan!

Really beautiful house - exactly as promised in the photos! Located just near the Underground station in a quiet road, it's really convenient for getting into central London, but also feels like a real treat to stay in. Susan was very organised and helpful in the run-up to the stay, and the whole experience was really great.

L'alloggio è perfetto ampio e pulito, abbiamo soggiornato comodamente in 7. Comodissimo rispetto alla fermata della metro e in una zona tranquilla ma con supermercato aperto fino alle 23 e locali dove poter mangiare. Direi quindi un'ottima soluzione per visitare Londra!
El anfitrión fue fantástico y la casa también
La casa appare proprio come da foto, la posizione comoda sebbene distante dal centro, l'unico neo il bagno all ultimo piano con riscaldamento non funzionante.

Die Verkehrsverbindungen sind perfekt, allerdings muss man dafür auch die sich hiermit verbindenden Geräusche akzeptieren. Die Versorgungsmöglichkeiten in der Nachbarschaft, einschließlich des Pubs sind hervorragend. Das Haus bietet sieben Personen eine vollständige und gute Ausstattung. Dies gilt für die Übernachtung und die Zubereitung von Mahlzeiten.

It was a good experience to live a few days at Susan's house in Wanstead. My family and me (6 People) felt fine all the time. We had enough space and three bathrooms. It's a short walk to the subway and to the nice pub "the george's" - good beer and food for small money. Susan is a friendly host

Thank you Susan! London was really great.

Cheers Dennis

Alle wunderbar. Haus wie beschrieben. Sehr günstig gelegen.
Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und nette Kneipen und Restaurants direkt vor Ort. Immer wieder gern.

The house is really large and rooms and baths are top !!! We stayed so well and we found all part of the house very clean :) the owner, Susan, was always available for us and helpful and kindful ;) congratulations for the house ! I feel to advice u all this rent ! Thx for all, Susan :)
Excellent. Slight mixup on arrival which was promptly resolved. Excellent location. Some very nice places to eat nearby.

Wir fanden alles wie beschrieben vor und haben uns rundherum wohl gefühlt - im Haus (schöne Einrichtung, sauber und zweckmäßig), in der Nachbarschaft und in der nahe gelegenen High Street von Wanstead, wo wir sehr gut frühstücken und am Abend Sushi gegessen haben. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten waren auch gut, so daß wir einmal auch die gut ausgestattete Küche von Susan zum Kochen nutzen konnten. Es war auch sehr erholsam, am Abend aus dem wundervollen, aber irgendwann auch anstrengenden Innenbereich von London herauskommen konnten - wie beschrieben mit der Tube in ca. 15 Minuten.

La casa es tal cual aparece en el anuncio. Es perfecta para viajar en familia y grandes grupos.
Tiene una parada de metro a un par de minutos andando. Desde ese metro estás en el centro de Londres en unos 30 min.
El barrio es muy tranquilo, con grandes parques alrededor.
La relación con Susan fue muy fluida. Lo puso todo muy fácil. Y se esforzó mucho para que la casa estuviera en perfectas condiciones.
Nuestra estancia ha sido perfecta.
Hegh dhhvg ghb

Wir waren zu sechst in Susans Haus und haben uns dort sehr wohl gefühlt. Die zentrale Lage ermöglichte es uns, mit der Tube in kurzer Zeit in der Londoner City zu sein, Wanstead selber bot einige nette Lokale, Supermärkte und andere kleine Geschäfte, um alles für den täglichen Bedarf zu besorgen.
Die drei Schlafzimmer mit jeweils eigenem Bad liessen den Tag auch mit Teenies ganz entspannt beginnen. In der komplett ausgestatteten Küche war vom Frühstück bis zum Abendessen alles möglich.
Der Kontakt zu Susan verlief absolut reibungslos, sie war sehr nett und hat Fragen ganz unkompliziert und schnell beantwortet. Vielen Dank für die Hilfe! Absolut empfehlenswert, wir würden es jederzeit wieder buchen.

We had an amazing weekend in London. There was just enough room for 7 persons, in the kitchen and living room as well. House was clean, and really beautiful, and it was perfect for our weekend in London! I really recommend renting from Susan. Thank you!

Nous n avons malheureusement eu aucun contact avec notre hôte, à part un seul coup de téléphone, non suivi d effets.
L appartement est grand, suffisant pour 6 personnes, bien équipé. L absence de contact à rendu la prise en main des différents équipements ménagers assez difficile pour des étrangers.

The house was very nice. Perfect location and very well equipped kitchen.
Excellent communication with host

La Casa rispetta fedelmente quanto descritto, bella pulita accogliente e con tutto quello che serve.
Vicinissima alla metropolitana, a un supermarket e un pud.
Ottima per famiglie con bambini.
Susan è stata sempre disponibile e gentile.
Lo consiglio e ci ritornerò.

This house was a godsend! Being heavily pregnant my family wanted to travel from multiple countries to be with me for Christmas, but I couldn't accommodate everyone. We decided to base ourselves at this house...we were 8 for Christmas dinner and the kitchen and dining/living space was fully stocked to fit us all and cater for a full Christmas dinner. Because the tube station is a 2minute walk friends were able to pop over to visit too. And the high street with shops, food and drink options is also a 2minute walk so there was something for everyone! It made our family Christmas possible!
Very comfortable, practical, well equipped flat, close to transportation and restaurants. Great choice cor a family vacation!

We had a great time. Susan was such a nice host,friendly and ready to help with everything. The house looked just as it did in pictures. It is clean and well kept,
2-3 minutes to the central line, 30 minutes to central London.
Very nice and well equipped house, near the underground and in a calm area. Great choice for a family.

Wir können all die positiven Bewertungen bestätigen! Für uns war die Lage super, da wir in Wanstead einen Familienanlass hatten. So konnten wir Stadtbesuche und Quartierleben gleichermassen geniessen.
Great location in a nice area. A nice house with 3 large bedrooms.

Casa molto carina e confortevole pulita e in ordine .Comoda per un soggiorno di 7 persone. Situata in un quartiere tranquillo e ben servito da vari negozi, vicinissima alla fermata della metro (30 minuti dal centro) Susan sempre disponibile pronta per ogni richiesta

La casa è come nelle foto,bella e tranquilla la zona vicinissima la stazione della metro però mi dispiace dirlo
con noi non ci ha dato tutta l'attenzione dovuta ad un ospite.

Susans house was just a perfect choice for us for several reasons:
Location - 2 minutes from the underground station, 30 minutes by underground to the very centre of London. The location is peaceful, safe and quiet area after a busy day in the centre of London. Wanstead is basically a village with all the infrastructure you need and a very local and friendly atmosphere as a bonus.
The house - very clean, with central heating, enough bathrooms and well distributed space. Kitchen well equipped for all our needs.
We really enjoyed our stay.
Martina

Great house in a great location. Short walk to the tube and a good assortment of restaurants and shops.
Caution. Do not allow Google maps to mislead you. There are two locations for 11 Camden Road. You do NOT want the one in Camden Town.

Susan is a very friendly and helpful host.  Transport is really convenient as Wanstead station is 1 min away. The flat is neat, clean and tidy when we arrived. There are a lot of kitchenware in the flat which is suitable for family meal preparation. The rooms are in reasonable size and the beds are comfortable which is ideal for resting after a long day. There are three washrooms in the house where all shower taps function properly with good pressure. The broadband speed is also quick. However, one thing is that it is hard to find assist through Air bnb when you come across any difficulties.
the place looks just like at pictures. only downside is the host went inside the apartment without telling us before hand.
Adriano's place is great. I can't overstate how useful it is to be so close to the tube! It really is only 2 minutes away. And it's a lovely, warm space.
It was a good stay - would recommend it

Perfect place to stay. Clean and well
Placed. Adriano was a perfect host. Thanks for everything.

I couldn’t recommend this place enough to someone who is looking for a ‘homely’ place to stay in such a great location!
More than enough room for a couple wishing to stay here with a separate living room, kitchen and bedroom. Adriano was very responsive and answered any questions that I had with great clarity.
I had access to all facilities with no problems at all during my 4-week stay. I would definitely book again!
Really bad Accomodaton. Quite small and urgently needs refurbishing.  I definitely wouldn’t stay again. Not many positives, except location is really good.

I had an absolutely wonderful stay! The property was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had everything I needed for a comfortable visit. The location was perfect close tube. Communication with the host was seamless; he was friendly, responsive, and made sure every detail was taken care of. I genuinely felt right at home and would 100% stay here again. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a hassle free getaway!
I had a lovely comfortable stay. Perfect for 2 people.
Really well kept apartment and host was very responsive. Would recommend
Exactly what I asked for, clear instructions.
He is very informative however it was smaller than expected and shouldn’t be advertising as 5 bed

Beautiful flat and really homely and perfect location for Brixton 02. Great bathroom and kitchen facilities.
Great host highly recommend. ☺️ Thank you

My girlfriend and I hadn't known Alina before we took the leap of faith to rent her flat. Alina just couldn't be nicer! Her flat is comfortable, homey, very sunny, and quiet at night. Her diverse neighborhood rocks! It's full of excellent eateries of varying ethnicities, good supermarkets, etc., etc. Her place is about a 10-minute walk to the Finsbury Park tube stop, and there are also several buses that ply Stroud Green Road. The Piccadilly and Victoria tube lines that serve Finsbury Park are very dependable and come frequently. My only caveat is if you are unwilling to take 20- to 40-minute commutes to downtown London attractions and money is no object, you will prefer to stay downtown. But for anyone else, you will love your experience of living in a real, untouristy neighborhood and dealing with a generous, warm-hearted woman I'm happy to call a new friend.
Alina was a really good host. The flat is clean and tidy - and really close to Finsbury Park station which is quite close to Central London. I recommend Alina to everyone.

Alina is an amazing host. She made me feel right at home. It was more like hanging out with a friend than a complete stranger. She's very sweet and makes a mean espresso. There are tons of places right around flat to eat and market is close in case you want to cook. I would definitely stay here again if I was in London. Thanks Alina you're awesome.

Alina's place is so nice, the room is big and clean, and the bed is huge. Alina is a great host, and she made sure I had everything I needed, for instance she had put clean towels on the bed for me:) I felt very at home in her place. Aside from that she really helped me out with a lot of things, and even helped me find a permanent place to live in London. So overall a great place to stay with a great girl.
Nice location in Islington area, good for short business trip. House is OK, host is very friendly.

I'm very happy to have been Alina's guest! We've had great time in London and enjoyed our stay. Alina is a great host, we felt us so welcomed by her!
Alina's house location is very convenient, it's only 5 min walk to Finsbury Park tube station and also a direct (Picadilly) line to Heathrow Airport (in case yu have an early departure you can use the opportunity to sleep a bit in the train :)
The flat itself is very nice and clean and comfortable, especially the double-bed with new mattress, I slept like a newborn :) And also the red sofa on the small roof terrace is great, I enjoyed the last night London sky!
To all who is going to visit London I highly reccomend Alina and her beautiful house to stay in. Alina, thank you so much and I hope to see you one day again!

I stayed with Alina in her flat in London for a week. It's a wonderful home with a warm feeling and everything you need. Alina went out of her way to make sure I was comfortable and we shared some great chats and meals. I recommend Alina's place to anyone looking for a home for a while in London, and look forward to seeing Alina again.
Alina was a perfect guest and her flat is absolutely wonderful. Highly recommended.

Alina's flat is exceptional one.
I have to say i have never been to such an atmospheric place like her flat.
Plenty of stunning art items around and all of these pictures and drawings are magnificent and inspirational.
The kitchen is AMAZING. Huge window, very bright and cozy furnished with great equipment.

I would highly recommend this flat,
i have had numerous short term rent in rent
and this one is number one to me.

We had an amazing stay at Eleonor's place. It was close to the public transportation and had everything we needed (family of 4 with 2 teens). Her place is nicely equipped with everything we needed for our stay. She was very prompt in responding to any questions and went out of our way to make our stay comfortable. We would definitely consider staying here again if/when we are back to visit.

Thanks for the great stay in this comfy and genuinely British apartment. Many intriguing details (including a piano- seriously out of tune 😜), two spacious beds, a power shower a fully equipped kitchen combined with a quiet yet central location will make us visit again. Thanks to Eleonore for arranging a warm welcome despite a last minute train cancellation!

L'appartement est très bien situé, bien desservi par les transports (bus et métro). Eleonore est très disponible et son appartement est charmant et très bien adapté à une famille. L'nedroit idéal pour un séjour londonien.

Eleonor was a wonderful host, very accommodating to all our needs. Her place was very nice as well as the area. There were many great restaurants and shops near by and metro was only 5 minutes away. Would stay there again!

Bonjour, l'appartement est globalement bien et bien placé dans un très bon quartier mais il demanderait à être rafraichit par quelques travaux d'entretiens (cuisine, fenêtre chambre d'amis, . Peu de contacts avec Eleonor, seulement par téléphone. Et l'accueil s'est fait en bas de l'immeuble par la femme de chambre, sans beaucoup d'informations. L'ascenseur n'a pas fonctionné de toute la semaine, ni la télévision.
Il y a une station de métro proche, à 5 minutes, ce qui permet d'aller vite dans le centre de Londres.
Pas de place de parking mais avec l'application JustPark j'ai trouvé un partcilier louant sa place à 15 minutes, sinon il y a l'hôtel Ibis qui propose son parking dans la rue à environ 10 minutes à pieds, vous pouvez vous garer directement et passer à l'accueil ensuite.

Loved staying here! Eleonor made the check-in very easy and clear with instructions. Such a quaint and quiet place. The only noise was the traffic outside when sleeping in the front room while the back room was very quiet. It is on a quiet street with other flats and a library next door so you don't have any noise of people walking home loud from bars or music from a venue. We loved the neighborhood! It has such a great variety of restaurants and bakeries/coffee shops for morning breakfasts. We took a walk to Orée on Fulham for croissants (raspberry-filled ones were a hit with the kids) and amazing coffee. So many places to explore in all directions. Getting to central London was easy with Earl's Court station so close. We loved all the personal touches Eleoner has in the unit. We stayed for five nights so using the washer and drying racks came in handy. Would love to stay here again when our travels take us back to London.

Great place in a great location. Walking distance to some of the major museums (we particularly liked the Design Museum) and lots of restaurants and cafes in the area. Easy access to the Underground. Nice detail: Lady Diana used to live across the street before she married this certain guy.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour en famille chez Eleonor.
L’appartement est très agréable, lumineux, confortable et très bien placé, bien desservi par les lignes de bus ou de métro.
Eleonor est une hôte très sympathique, la communication était excellente.Eleonor a été très arrangeante malgré notre arrivée tardive.
Nous conseillons vivement son appartement !

The apartment is a little jewel in Earl’s court. Perfectly located few blocks from Tube, walk distance from many many restaurants, but private enough to feel a local person. Perfect for 4 people, with tons of space. Elena is among the best host we have ever had - she coordinated everything, prepared everything and always responsive. Thanks for having us

My wife and two daughters had the most splendid time at Eleanor's flat in Kensington Gardens last week for 5 nights.  The flat is beautifully located just minutes from the Earl's Court Tube station and very walkable with many restaurants and stores minutes away.  The flat was very comfortable with a spacious living room for the 4 of us to feel at home and two bedrooms, full kitchen and a full bath.  Minutes from all the sights we saw shows on the west end, Hyde Park, and were able to train down to Brighton. Eleanor was very communicative and attentive and we felt so at home and enjoyed our stay immensely.  We are already planning our next stay and look forward to spending time at Eleanor's home.  Don't hesitate to book it!

The flat is very convenient to the Tube, making our daily jaunts into the city easy and accessible. The space is very airy and bright. Eleonor was one of the most communicative hosts I have had - very pleasant and responsive. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone coming to the city.

The apartment is very convenient and close to everything. Landlord is very responsive and friendly.
Would love to come back again if visit London again.

Eleonor's place is ideally located for a visit to London.  Close to the tube and plenty of buses make it easy to get around.  Eleonor was a great host who promptly answered messages and provided lots of information.  You are staying in Eleonor's house so be prepared for lots of personal belongings and clutter which may not suit everyone.  Overall a good value place to stay in an awesome London location.

Overall it was a good stay. We had a lot of luggage so the space and the lift was really helpful. The flat is close to the tube stations. S&M and Tesco express are all nearby and many cafe and restaurants for your choices. Eleanor was quite responsive and gave clear instructions. She also accommodated to our arrival time. The only little problem was the dish washer was broken and the electricity and heat caused some trouble. Eleanor guided us to fix the electricity but the heat was not working at the last day. Otherwise I would say it is valued for the money.
Great place, great hosts.  :-)

I came over on a business trip  and I found the ideal hosts in Leo and Veneranda, who instantly made me feel welcome and at home, and were always eager to help when I asked. The house is kept spotlessly clean and each room has everything that you would need.  The location itself is situated in real London with some typical East London pubs nearby, and would recommend if you want  an authentic London experience, and is situated just 5 mins bus ride from Canning Town DLR which is a quick and scenic ride into central London. In  short I would not hesitate to recommend this place for any one wishing to stay in London.

I had a wonderful time at Leo and Venere's. They made me feel at home in their beautiful house. We had a dinner party which was a lot of fun and many great talks. I was staying in the most amazing room London has to offer and I definitely recommend anyone to do the same!!

The loft was a really beautiful and cozy place to stay while on a  short trip to London! Just 30 minutes away from the main places of interest with night buses running through the night back to the loft from the city center. Location is really good! There is a place for breakfast within 3 minutes of walking time which is cheap and really good! In addition, the hosts are very friendly and hospitable always helping us whenever we need help. I would definitely recommend this place to stay in when visiting London.

A gorgeous loving couple, living in a lovely house down a quiet lane.
The loft room was all we could've wanted, and quite quirky to boot, plus Leo and Venere were most friendly welcoming hosts. Recommended.

I realy love  the stade in Veranda Carbutti. They recomended places to us, and they are very kind with us !! It´s like live for few days in a family !! The house is very clean , and the beds are confortable !!!! =) I recomended it !!

Very clean, tidy & cosy house.  Very welcoming hosts - you can tell they really enjoy what they do & having guests in their home.  I'd strongly advise staying here just to experience Venere's amazing (authentic Italian) cooking!  It was a wonderful surprise to be invited to a little dinner party, with the other guests - with the most delicious homemade pizza ever!  House is secure, in a quiet street, off the main road (easy access by bus to Stratford, or Jubilee line at Canning Town station).  The loft room is very nice & comfortable.  Amazing value for money. Would highly recommend booking with Venere & Leo!

Our stay with Leo and Vereranda was wonderful; they really wanted us to feel at home during the week we stayed with them. The loft was quiet and a nice place to sleep (especially because we had a different sleeping schedule from everyone else in the house), and there was always tea downstairs in the kitchen. The location was really, really great: the bus stop is only a very short walk from the house, and buses run to and from the metro station (which gets you into London) until about 1 am. With an Oyster week-pass, travel was extremely easy. There are also great restaurants all around the house that are much cheaper than what you would find in London, so we really appreciated that as well. Overall, a fantastic stay!

Staying in Leo was great and friendly.
We've been there four nights and have only good mood and positive emotions. Perfect morning capucino, maps, oyster card etc was given to us by him. Venere also help us with some information.

Amazing week in London with amazing people Leo and Venere. Thank you very much for your kindness and care. I feel like I was with my relatives in your house talking about psychology with Leo and drinking morning Venere's cappuccino.
Same story, same time, next year.. will see you guys! Take care!
With kind wishes,
Aleksei

Our stay with Veneranda and Leo was fantastic and much more like staying with friends than being guests in a stranger's house. Our hosts were very friendly and approachable and we were well looked after during our stay. The house was clean, tidy and comfortable. In casa ci sono tutti gli elettrodomestici (lavastoviglie, lavatrice, forno, forno a microonde, bollitore, ecc.); vi consiglio di fornirvi di adattatori di presa di corrente, prechè le prese sono diverse da quelle europee. Scaricatevi la APP della Metro, è comoda, oppure potete utilizzare in alternativa le indicazioni di Google Map. Noi siamo stati benissimo e lo consigliamo anche agli amici. Londra è stupenda ed è piena di gente di ogni parte del mondo (nei luoghi affollati fate attenzione alle borsette, tenetele a tracolla e non poggiatele sulle spalliere delle sedie quando vi fermate nei bar o locali, ve lo consiglio per esperienza negativa). Per il resto....godetevela...

I am a little late reviewing this but it is important to me that I do. Look, the place is in a great location and the neighbor was very friendly. The place was perfectly comfortable and Philippa gave a lot of helpful information prior to our arrival in England.

However, me and my girlfriend were robbed the second night we were there. We went out to meet friends and by the time we got back, all of our valuables were taken (computers, iPods, camera equipment, jewelry, etc). It was upon the arrival of the police that we learned two things:
1) Rooms here are rented out very, very frequently. There are always people in and out so it is very obvious that there are tourists coming in and out of here.
2) The locks, as explained by the police, are very inadequate at this location and can be circumvented with extremely simple tactics.

The most aggravating part of this was how we were treated. We followed all instructions exactly as they were laid out and were very deliberate in making sure everything was perfectly secure as we went in and out of the place. However, all correspondence with Philippa (through email or through her neighbor) indicated nothing other than it somehow being our fault. There was very little sympathy and all the commentary centered around what WE did. Additionally, Philippa basically just stopped replying to emails after we expressed how frustrated we were from her responses and the lack of security and safety in the building.

So, it is a nice place and a convenient location, but the threat of robbery (or God forbid attacks) is just simply too high here.

Lovely shop stores around on King's road, the Saatchi gallery is at 10 minutes walking, the grocery store is literally around the corner.

The apartment itself is very quiet at night a little less in the morning because it is located next to a store delivery parking. No worries then close the windows turn on the air conditioner or put some ear plugs if you are like me (light sleeper) it only lasts an hour.

It is exactly as indicated in the add. Beautiful natural light that makes it very bright. Comfortable bed, clean bathroom with fresh towels and toilet paper (seems silly to point it but very useful when you arrive late and haven't got time to go to the market) and an equipped kitchen. Everything you need for your stay as a true Londoner!

Philippa is a very lovely and warm lady. I am sure she will make your stay as comfortable as ours.
I am glad I've met her and I hope next time I'll go to London her appartment will be free for me to rent it!

Thank you again for everything Philippa!! :)

Wonderful location! 10min stroll to the tube and as we found out, fantastic bus connections to lots of sightseeing spots of London.
Having a well equipped kitchen and waitrose supermarket next door helps to whip up a good meal in pricy London.
Apartment is clean and cozy.
Philippa is very helpful and very welcoming.
Highly recommend her apartment to all visitors looking to enjoy London for short and long stays.

Located in a convenient and central area of London, this flat is the perfect place for tourists looking for an affordable home base. Close to 2 tube stops and several bus lines, the flat is close to great shops and in a nice residential area. You'll have to be respectful of your neighbors if coming in late at night or early in the morning but it also means a peaceful time for yourself. The amenities and apartment are just as the photos and description indicate. The host is very helpful and accommodating. I'd love to stay here again on a return trip to London!

Delightful, charming hostess.  Very clean, and wonderful neighborhood.  Only one bus to the city, lots of amenities nearby, very safe area, great pubs nearby, went for evening walks, great coffee shop in the morning....Thanks Philippa!

The flat is exactly as it is shown in the photographs.
My flight in was very late; but Philippa was there to meet me at the flat; and seems a very good hostess.
As I was traveling alone, it was nice to know that she lives nearby for added security.
The building is quite secure, and the flat itself has very good locks; and also locking windows with a little separate key.
Even being on the ground floor, I felt very safe there.
I didn't mind the street noise at all, as we live on a busy street at home.
The bedroom has lovely thick curtains, so you can get a great sleep in the very comfy bed ,and not be woken up by light in the mornings.
The flat is spotless throughout, and has lots of hot water for showers.
It's got absolutely everything you would need; from hairdryer to iron, to all the kitchen equipment needed for cooking.
It's really easy to get around London from there :
I recommend buying an Oyster Transport pass for the Tube and buses.
I was even able to use it on a couple of regular trains.
Lots of great shops right nearby, including a wonderful large grocery store.
This was my first experience with AirBnB, though I always rent apartments when I travel; and I was VERY pleased with it all.
Thanks, Philippa ; for sharing your cosy home with others!
I would love to stay there on another visit!

Philippa is a wonderful host and a most charming woman - the apartment was lovely, the location perfect, the stay was completely hassle and problem free and I look forward to returning as soon as I can.

My parents came to London and needed a place to stay. I booked Philippa's apartment because I loved the position and the pictures on Airbnb.
I arrived a day before my parents and went to Philippa to do the check in. She was amazing! So kind!
The flat was super clean and tidy and very welcoming. I loved it at first glance!
I recommend the flat because has an extraordinary position ( it's in the heart of Chelsea, in Kings road!!!) and Philippa is an amazing host.
I definitely will rent again the flat in future!

Нам очень понравилось у Венеранды и Лео. Дом очень чистый и уютный. Хозяева - приветливые, гостеприимные, готовые помочь в туристических трудностях. Проживание в старинном доме, приятное общение с хозяевами дополнили хорошое впечатление от нашего путешествия. Лео и Венеранда, большое спасибо!

We were four people staying at Ven and Leo's and we absolutely enjoyed it! They were so sweet and helped us with everything and let us take over their tv so that we could watch Doctor Who. The loft isn't that big but it is so nice and just the right space if you're just going to use it for sleeping. We are definitely coming back and we are looking forward to it! Thanks for everything!

Venere e Leo sono fantastici; simpatici e disponibili.
Per la prima esperienaza con Airbnb non potevamo trovare Host migliori.
Ci siamo portati dietro "il mondo" (asciugamani, asciugapiatti,ecc) non sapendo come comportarci ma non abbiamo usato niente!
La casa è completa di tutto e se mancasse qualcosa, basta chiedere.
Abbiamo soggiornato nel Loft, una stanza "piccola" e accogliente, per 4 è un pò strettima ma visto che bisogna solo dormirci è l'ideale.
Che dire, se ricapitassi ancora a Londra la prenoterei di nuovo!

I was visiting the British Educational Training and Technology show (BETT) at Excel and, as is my habit now, I turned to Airbnb. I picked out Leo and Venere's property because the reviews all seemed to focus on their hospitality and I enjoy the social element of Airbnb. I was not disappointed. Leo and Venere are both very easygoing, chatty and fun. Not only was it easy to be there but I made some new friends in them and their guests. The property is clean, tidy and well connected with buses to nearby areas including Excel. I'm more than happy to recommend them and I hope I will see them again for BETT 2015!

Leo & Venere were the most wonderful hosts. There are truly kind and open-minded people and they make you feel home immediately. And so does their nice and cosy house. My friends and I stayed in the loft-room - we could find privacy after a long day of working but as soon as we wanted to have a nice chat ( or an interesting long conversation)  with Leo & Venere we'd just go downstairs, perfect! We had a great time!!

Nous avons trouvé un accueil très chaleureux et impliqué. Tous les matins, Veneranda et Léo passaient du temps à élaborer avec nous le meilleur trajet de la journée en fonction de ce que nous voulions voir. Ils nous ont énormément guidé, leurs conseils nous ont fait gagner beaucoup de temps  et ont contribué à rendre notre séjour agréable. Je recommande cet hébergement.

There's only one word I can use to describe our stay with Leo and Venere! FANTASTIC!! :) Great hosts..and not only hosts..true friends! We really enjoyed spending time with them :) Thanks a lot!! And be sure that we will come back!

I and my two friends had a lovely stay with Verene and Leo. It's not very big and sharing the bathroom with several guests was a bit of a challenge but the kindness and the great cappuccino's Leo made for us made that we had a very pleasant stay!!!

We are a couple who had the pleasure to stay at Leo and Veneranda's house this past weekend and we have to confess they are wonderful hosts!

They have an amazing house, are experienced when it comes to weary and curious travelers and captured our hears instantly.

Surely being hosted by them is one of the ups of our stay in London and we will never forget the cozy home, the conversations, the cookies, the tea and the happy cappuccino.

We will be back for sure.

The house is very clean and tidy. The neighbourhood is very quiet.
The area is well connected with the city by public transport.
The best tourist attractions of the city can be reached within a maximum of 30/40 minutes.
Westfield, the largest shopping center in Europe, can be reached in 15 minutes.
For those who love sports, there is a greenway near where you can go running for miles.
The hosts, Leo and Veneranda, they are wonderful people.
This is the perfect place to visit London!
We will be back very soon to stay with them!

It was a great stay. The room is small but really cozy. Leo and Venere are lovely and help you with everything. They give great adivce on how to discover London in the best way. Overall...GREAT STAY!!!!

We stayed with our two children at Leo and Venere's place for 3 nights ( loft and green room, clean! )
It is clear that Leo and Venere love having people around, they really want you to feel at home. They were very helpfull and had lots of tips regarding finding our way and exploring the city.
Bedankt! Thanks!

This is one of the nicest AirBnB places and hosts to stay with you can find (at least in London!), I'd want to argue. The loft was a pure calm oasis of coziness, feeling far away from the bustling city, which just felt great after a day at work. For some socializing and perhaps even dinner (into Italian food? You've come just right…) together with Leo, Veneranda and some other guests, the living room and kitchen (well-equipped as well as orderly) were just a short ladder descent away. Although I didn't spend much time there, the backyard patio is just as nice as the loft – Leo claims he doesn't have green fingers, but I'd like to think otherwise.

As for connections, you're in luck. Stratford, with its Westfield shopping centre, is 15 minutes away. Buses frequent the stop just up the road, quickly taking you to Canning Town station, where the central parts of town (or Stratford in the other direction) are a simple Jubilee line tube or DLR ride away. Also very close to London City airport, as well as the O2.

Veneranda and Leo were lovely hosts who ensured you felt right at home. They were warm and welcoming, gave helpful insights to the area and how to get around. The room was well equipped and very comfortable.
Transport and connections were so easy and very quick making this an ideal spot for any visitor.
Fantastic hosts. The loft is lovely and exactly as described :)

Leo and Venere are so warm and welcoming, and they made us feel at home as soon as we arrived! We only stayed for a short time (3 nights), but we had our own cupboard, our own shelf in the fridge and our own shelf in the bathroom. The house is clean, the area is perfect if you're planning on travelling to the Excel center like we were, and all in all, we had an amazing stay!

My parents said you couples are so nice let them know the British living style and give us many advices. If we have chance to come again we still like to come to you. :) you are so warm hearted and patient thank you!  only the loft is not very convenient

Veneranda and Leo are lovely hosts! They made me feel completely welcome, and like a part of their ever-changing family of travellers. I hadn't mentioned to them that it would be my birthday while I was there, but they figured it out and surprised me with strudel! It was nice to have a real home base to go back to, after a few weeks of travelling solo and staying in hostels. The loft is great and just as pictured, sunny and bright from the sky light. If you're taking transit, the bus from the station to their place is very frequent, I don't think I ever waited more than 5 minutes.  I had a fantastic week in London and would happily stay with Veneranda and Leo again.

Staying here was our pleasure. Also we are missing Leo and Venere. They are very kind and like family. Also, we are given their care and consideration. Thanks to them, we felt time fly very fast. We were first time Air BnB. Then, we met very lovely hosts. We appreciate it. It is lovely time. We specially recommend to not only using English people but also Koreans. Our friends having together trip also want to visit again because of them. Thank you.

Venere et Leo sont des personnes adorables, très soucieuses du bien être de ses hôtes. Les consignes et conseils sont donnés dès le début, on se sent donc très libre de faire ce que l'on veut dans la maison étant donné que l'on sait ce qu'on peut faire, doit faire et ce qu'on ne peut pas faire, cela rend le séjour très agréable. La maison est très propre et bien entretenue, ce qui est très appréciable dans la salle de bain et la cuisine.
Leo et Venere nous ont accueilli comme des membres de la famille, ils ont pris soin de répondre à nos interrogations, nous conseiller sur le quartier, les magasins, où aller à Londres... Nous avons beaucoup rigolé avec eux et à notre demande ils nous ont aidé avec notre anglais.
La maison est à moins d'une minute à pied de l'arrêt de bus (qui est très bien desservi) et le bus ne mets que quelques minutes pour aller à Canning Town, la station de métro.
Pour résumé, nous sommes vraiment senti chez nous, Venere et Leo sont des hôtes très généreux, un séjour chez eux ne peut être qu'agréable !

Lea and Veneranda are great hosts. I can only wish that I can find similar host in every city. I am sure to come back whenever I will go to London. House is in East London but with Venerande awareness of all London transport you can save money and time for all location you wish to visit.
If it be possible I will give six star.

Accoglienza molto calorosa, leo mi è venuto a prendere alla fermata dell'autobus e appena arrivati a casa mi è stato subito offerto un caffè...mi sono sentito in famiglia in piena londra. Venere e Leo sono due persone fantastiche che fanno di tutto per far sentire a loro agio gli ospiti. La casa è stata sempre pulita e attrezzata. C'erano molti prodotti che i padroni di casa mettevano a disposizione di tutti. Di sera si creava sempre un'atmosfera famigliare e ci raccoglievamo a guardare la tv tutti insieme. La casa è molto vicina a Canning town (5 min) e a Stratford.In zona ci sono dei supermercati molto economici. Consiglio a chi voglia fare un viaggio a Londra di alloggiare qui... Non ve ne pentirete, anzi!

Leo and Veneranda are wonderful hosts. Very warm, welcoming and always happy to help and give advice. They made me feel right at home, from the moment I arrived.

The house itself is cosy and clean, the loft nice and spacious and the back garden is absolutely beautiful. Everything looks exactly as it does in the pictures here. The neighbourhood is in East London, nice and quiet, and it only takes 5 minutes by bus to get to the nearest Tube station on the Jubilee line. This way you don't have to worry about being too far from the city center, if you have come here to visit the sights.

I was only planning to stay with them for two weeks before I found something more permanent, but I like it so much here that I decided to stay for a lot longer. Sorry, people, looks like the loft is going to be occupied for a while :)

Acabamos de pasar 8 días en casa de Veneranda y Leo, eramos 3 personas. Y la valoración general es positiva. Leo fué muy amable, vino a recibirnos a la estación de autobuses a pesar de que llegamos a las 11 de la noche. Veneranda prepara unos tomates en conserva riquísimos.
Su casa es muy acogedora, limpia y ordenada. Nuestra habitación tambien, pero aunque está anunciada para 4 personas, creemos que con 3 es suficiente. Está en un barrio tranquilo y muy bien comunicado. Y ellos están siempre pendientes por si necesitas ayuda para usar el transporte o sugerencias sobre que visitar.

I loved staying at Leo's and Venere's home. The couple are extremely hospitable and go out of their way to make you extra comfortable. I got delayed in transit, but Leo held my hand and gave me directions to their home. Venere was there in the cold of night to receive me at the bus stop. The loft is very spacious, accessible through the ladder and has a big desk with a window to the sky for sunlight and stargazing. The Westfield mall at Stratford is easily accessible through bus and tube.
Thank you Leo and Venere for giving me a home away from home.
