Veneranda and Leo очень гостеприимные хозяева! Описание полностью соответствовало  действительности и даже лучше.Ребёнок был в восторге от комнаты на чердаке с окном в звёздное небо.Veneranda and Leo помогали советами по поводу достопримечательностей и передвижения по Лондону.В доме было чисто и уютно.Спасибо большое за то что разделили свой дом с нами.

Ottima accoglienza da parte di Veneranda e Leo, cordiali e amichevoli, sempre disponibili a prestare consigli o concreto aiuto se necessario. Ci hanno fornito ottimi dritte su come e cosa visitare a Londra e come muoverci. La casa è letteralmente a due minuti a piedi dalle tante fermate dei bus, in pochi minuti sarete anche alla fermata Canning Town da cui andare ovunque con Bus, DLR o Tube. Due minuti anche dai tanti alimentari e dai servizi come atm, posta, fotocopie, etc. La casa è molto pulita ed ordinata, in una zona molto silenziosa. Ottimo il tour iniziale su come usare la casa. Vi sentirete tra simpatici amici. Se torneremo a Londra chiederemo di nuovo di pernottare presso Veneranda e Leo.
Beautiful room
Strongly recommended. The accommodation is clean, public transportation network is easily accessible (Canary Warf door-to-door in 20 min) and Veneranda and Leo are friendly, warm and generous.

Personally the host went to fetch us from the bus stop and offered us tips on how to get around! They are friendly and made us feel comfortable at home. The location is quite near to Central London by the subway! Overall it has been a good experience!

Leo and Veneranda were such a lovely host-couple! Due to a booking error at my prior place, I had to find a new accomodation very quickly and Leo and Veneranda accepted my on the same day I asked for their loft, for a three month stay!! The loft was very lovely as well, I had enough space for everything and I especially liked the beautiful walls.
Definitely worth a stay!

this is a wonderful little bolt hole in the lovely area of Chelsea - very conveniently located near Kings Road and lots of public transport. Highly recommended for short or medium stays. Thanks Phillipa.
Nice place and Susan communicated well! Would stay here again

一行六人入住旅居八晚，入住時我們沒辦法開門經過聯絡後，很快便前來幫忙。而且主動詢問我們是否需要紙巾，十分體貼🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻
交通方面：步行1-2分鐘便到underground 十分方便。唯一是underground 的扶手梯由入住那天到離開一直都沒有修理好，每次乘搭都需要行一條長樓梯到月台對長輩來說十分不方便。但這個絕對不是旅居的問題。
屋內設備齊全，煮食方便，而且附近有三間超級市場。整體來說性價比十分高。值得推介👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Excellent place. Susan is a great host. Her place is beautiful, clean and very well equipped. Due to health reason, we requested to extend our stay, Susan was extremely helpful .
Would definitely recommend this place and would love to come back again.

Trotz kleinere Makel eine gute Unterkunft, die wir wieder buchen würden.
U-Bahn direkt um die Ecke, daher konnten wir alle Ziele sehr gut erreichen.
Zum empfehlen ist das Pub gleich um die Ecke.

Fantastic house and so close to the Wanstead Tube Station. House is exactly as it’s described and hosts are super helpful. Will definitely book again.
Wanstead is absolutely gorgeous as well and has a great high street with independent little shops, cafes and bars. Would recommend having a wonder round Wanstead.

Typisches Häuschen in der Nähe einer Bahnstation mit Einkaufsmöglichkeiten.
Sehr zu empfehlen.

This place was amazing! It’s only a 2 min walk to the tube (subway), the grocery store and lots of nice pubs and restaurants.
The place was nice and clean. Having three bathrooms is also a plus. The host is very accommodating. We would book this place again in a heartbeat. Thank you!
Lovely stay
la casa es como se describe en las fotos. Es muy amplia para una familia grande. se duerme muy bien y la parada del metro está al lado. Lla comunicación con Susan y Carol ha sido fantástica.
Mooi huis! dichtbij metro station, ideaal voor tripjes naar Londen. Wanstead is ook leuk stadje met veel restaurants en betaalbaar.

We loved our stay here. A lovely, clean house, with lots to do on the doorstep. It was easy to get into the centre of London with an underground station very close to the house. There is a street with lots of little cafes and bakeries and places to eat very close to the property and a park that the children loved playing on. The house had everything we needed and felt like home away from home. The children were comfortable and happy and we would definitely stay again in the future.
This was a great place to use for our family to get together and for my daughter to get married from.  We had a great weekend and Susan was really helpful and willing to let us do this - thank you!
We felt right at home! Susan is an excellent host! I highly recommend Susan’s place.

We had a lovely few days at Susan's house. It was much more spacious than the photos are able to show - especially the two large en suite bathrooms!
The house is super convenient for Wanstead tube station and all the great amenities that Wanstead itself offers. It was perfect for our stay.
Small touches like the handwash and shower gel were very much appreciated.
And Carol, Susan's mum, was super helpful on messaging when we got confused by the boiler, one nippy evening!
Highly recommended. We'll certainly be staying here again!
Good property, well situated near the tube. Very well equipped kitchen.  Good parking and convenient for commuting to the Olympic pool
Fantastic place! Absolutely recommend to stay!

Great host- very welcoming!
Beautiful double room in nice safe area
Bethia was a delightful host! The room was peaceful and lovely. A welcomed retreat. I really enjoyed my stay and look forward to heading back again!
Very characteristic house with a great personal atmosphere, provided by a lovely hostess.
Beautiful flat with a very accommodating host! We very much enjoyed our stay.
Bethia is a very gracious lovely host and willing to assist with any advice you may need while travelling in London. Her room is beautiful just like in the pictures and very cosy and homely.

Bethia was a fantastic host, so kind and helpful whenever I needed it. The room was gorgeous with lots of natural light and a very comfortable bed. The location was good, only a 5 minute walk to Homerton overground and had lots of cafes quite close to the flat.

I would highly recommend staying here!

Bethia is a very attentive hostess, she is really funny!! I absolutly recomended this beautiful room. We met so friendly neightbours and a very nice people in a Italian restaurant close to the flat. Very positive experience! Hope come back again!
Bethia has created a wonderful home, the flat is gorgeous, light and in a great location and she makes you feel amazingly welcome. I recommend staying here unreservedly.

Never felt more at home when abroad - a kind-hearted, generous host and an absolutely stunning, carefully decorated flat. Bethia tried everything to make my stay as pleasant as possible and absolutely succeeded in doing so! Extra plus: a tiny but most wonderful espresso bar just down the street! Hoping to come back at some point...

Bethia is a wonderful host and that's why, a month in, I have decided to extend my stay in this beautiful room and home!

If you love the bohemian hippie feel of Hackney and the relaxing and artistic vibe of a house full of vinyl records and vintage furniture, this is it!

Bethia is a warm and welcoming host, within moments I was made to feel at home. The room I chose with the bathtub, as with the rest of the flat was delightfully decorated with lots of natural light. I particularly loved having my coffee out on the terrace on a sunny morning.  Located close to Homerton station and with Chatsworth Road with its lovely shops and cafes, you have all the conviniences you need within easy access. I was sad to leave and would definitely stay again. Highly recommended.

A beautiful flat and a great location (really close to Homerton station, bus links and Chatsworth Rd market). We had a lovely stay and Bethia was incredibly welcoming and made us feel instantly at home. The bed was extremely comfortable and everything was 'hotel standard clean'. We would definitely recommend to friends and family.
Bethia is a lovly Perosn and the room is cozy and nice!

Bethia was a super friendly and accommodating host. The room looked exactly like the picture, and was spacious enough for 2 guests. It's a quick hop on the commuter rail. While it is a bit of a trip (about 50 minutes) to get to center city London, I would recommend to anyone visiting London.
Great place to stay, easy to get into London  and there's nice local restaurants and shops too. The room is very pretty and tastefully decorated.
Bethia's place is a very comfortable funky flat in a lovely part of East London close to Hackney and London Fields, surrounded by nice bars and restaurants. Bethia herself is a charming friendly host
I enjoyed staying at Bethia's place. The room was cozy and comfortable and the location was perfect!

I stayed three months at Bethia’s place and it felt like home right away. The flat is well connected with all the important spots in London. The interior was very stylish and in high quality. Bethia is a very lovely host with a lot of experience. She was always eager to help. I highly recommend this accommodation!

A truly curated, boutique experience for an amazing price. Great host, close to great local restaurants and transit and idk, every single inch of that house is put together with thought and artistic vision. Amazing for a getaway, especially if you're planning to stay long.

Absolutely loved my stay in Bethia’s apartment. Probably the most beautiful apartment I’ve ever stayed in too! The bedroom was so calm, decorated well and a really good size. The bed was also big and really comfortable. Bethia is also so lovely, made you really feel at home there. Definitely recommended!
Bethia's place was wonderful - very clean and one of the most comfortable beds I've been on in an Airbnb. Would highly recommend if you like to be in Hackney!
Good location, Nice host

Bethia is a great hostess! Very friendly, courteous and helpful. There are small, beautiful and useful details everywhere. Exactly to my taste! I felt very comfortable and would want to stay with her again anytime. Highly recommended!

Bethia is a lovely host who went above and beyond to make sure my stay was comfortable and that I got to check in and check out smoothly and safely. The place itself is cosy & gorgeous located in a great part of London so really you couldn’t ask for more! Highly recommended.

Bethia has a beautiful home and has worked hard to make it totally unique compared to other airbnbs you might find online. It’s very clean and everyone is mindful and respectful of one another’s things and space. In terms of location it’s perfect; very vibrant, lots of places to grab coffee, close to Hackney marshes, Victoria park and the lido. Bethia was also very responsive at the start of my stay putting me at ease. I am sure anyone who stays will thoroughly enjoy their time here.
A cute little room in a 3-bed flat, near Overground line with easy access to central London and so close to a number of amazing independent businesses; good space for a long-term stay.

Had a wonderful stay at Bethia's lovely flat. The location is perfect - close to public transit and in a wonderful, walkable neighborhood. The space was peaceful and very much felt like home for the month. Would recommend for anyone visiting London and looking to spend more time in the Hackney area.
Ich war für fast 20 Nächte bei Bethia und hab die Zeit dort sehr genossen. Die Umgebung war schön, das Zimmer sauber und meine Mitbewohner sehr lieb.

Located 10 minutes on foot from Stratford station (though there's also a bus), the apartment is well connected to the city, and the huge Westfield Stratford mall provides a great shopping experience nearby.
The bed is very comfortable and I liked the choice between the 2 sets of pillows of different thickness (rare on Airbnb!). 
The room was big enough that I could lay my suitcase on the floor without it getting in the way.
On top of that, Reyhana is a wonderful and caring host who actively made sure I felt at home.

Reyhana is a wonderful host, very friendly and welcoming. I didn't lack anything at all. She is also very attentive to her guests need. The room is cosy and clean,the bed is comfortable. I enjoyed my stay at Reyhana's place.

Reyhana looked after me all the time, even from such small things (emptying bin, cheking toilet paper roll, fixing the curtain when I dropped it)
Amazing host!
Tha flat is new and exactly the same as you can see in the pictures. Bus stop next to the flat, shops and close to Stratford Station. Nice and safe neighborhood.
Westfield and Olympic Park near as well, to enjoy your stay the place is perfect!

Staying at Reyhana’s was fantastic. I was there for five days for a seminar at the Excel Centre. It was easier to get to using the DLR and I felt perfectly safe walking from the station at night.
Reyhana was so hospitable and kind and accommodated every need I had during my stay.
My room and bathroom were super clean and her apartment was very cosy.

I had a great experience staying at Reyhana 's place in London. The location is very convenient, with a short walk to the station that can get you to central or anywhere in London easily. There are also plenty of buses by the flat for ease of transportation. The booking process was seamless and easy. When I arrived I was pleasantly greeted by Reyhana who I quickly discovered is a warm and friendly soul who instantly puts you at ease and makes you feel at home. The flat is a beautiful inviting space and just as advertised. It's super clean with great amenities with the added bonus of a large spotless bathroom for private use! Reyhana gives you the space you need but also takes the time to answer any and all questions- we've had many great chats that were one of the highlights of my stay. Overall, I would highly recommend staying at Reyhans as it's the perfect stay in an ah- mazing flat! I will definetly be back. Thanks for everything!
Reyhana is a perfect host

Fantastic stay at Reyhana’s place.
She is very responsive and took time to answer all my queries. The place is absolutely clean, Spotless
The location is fantastic 5-7 minutes walk to stratford station or westfied shopping center,
The room and the toilet both are absolutely spotless, there is enough cupboards in the room. I am very very picky on where i stay and i have to admit i felt like home at Reyhana’s place
Will definitely stay again when in London.
Thanks a ton Reyhana:)

I enjoyed my stay at Phillipa's apartment. It was within easy walking distance to the underground station and was in an attractive and upmarket part of London. It was a bonus having Waitrose supermarket in the next street. Although I didn't get to meet Phillipa ( she was overseas) I had regular contact with her and she was concerned that I had a pleasant stay and everything I needed. I would recommend the apartment for both a long or short term stay in London.
Melanie Brown

We had a wonderful stay in Philippa's apartment. Comfortable, quiet and very clean. The aparment is in a very nice location with all types of restaurants and a Waitrose supermarket right around the corner. In a few minutes you can walk to the river, over the bridge and into Battersea park!

I didn't get a chance to meet Philippa in person as she was abroad, but she was very friendly and helpful over the phone and via email. We had everything we needed and it was a real pleasure to stay there. Thank you Philippa!

As a solo mature aged traveller wanting to spend some time in London, it was perfect. location  as  it is a short walk (about 12 mins) to South Kensington underground which gives you access to 3 main train lines Piccadilly, District and Circle.It is also just of Kings Roads in Chelsea giving you access to everything you need for your stay in London including supermarkets,eateries, post office and a great pub around the corner called the Builders Arms. Everything for me was perfect in the apartment. Nothing was not available that I needed. Philippa is a wonderful host and had prepared the apartment ready for easy access. Everything was explained and all easy to use. I felt very secure in the apartment which is very light and airy. For me it was my perfect choice for my stay in London, made even more enjoyable in having Philippa as your host who certainly has a great apartment for one or 2 people. Many thanks. Philippa as greatly appreciate the opportunity of staying in your Chelsea pad. It is perfect

We've been traveling to
london every year, it was our first time in Philippa's flat and it was great. Everything is perfect and the location.... We loved! Thank you Philippa!!

Very nice flat with a lot of amenities, and it's very quiet! I stayed here for a couple of days this summer and would definitely stay again.

Philippa was a bit hard to reach via phone / email at times, but I think I just caught her while she was doing some heavy traveling. Overall the trip worked out well and both she and Mary (a local tenant) were quite accommodating!

El departamento esta muy bien ubicado y equipado.
La persona que nos recibio, fue muy amable en indicarnos donde ir a comprar comida en el horario que llegamos. Y Philipa nos permitio dejar nuestras valijas mas tarde del horario de salida.
Tiene un gran defecto que es el ruido de camiones en la semana, muy temprano por la mañana, ya que hay un negocio de muebles a la vuelta y los camiones estacionan justo en la calle a la que da la habitacion y hacen mucho ruido.
El sillon cama no es muy comodo para descansar.
Me resulto algo incomodo que Philippa llegue al departamento sin aviso previo, y que revise todo, nunca me paso algo asi, no se si es algo comun en Londres, pero he alquilado mas departamentos en otras ciudades, y eso me resulto algo molesto y extraño.

What a wonderful first time London experience! From the very beginning Philippa, our host, was informative, helpful and open. Philippa was unable to meet us but Mary her friend and neighbor helped us settle iin and offered us umbrellas for our rainy stay.

The apartment was wonderfully located with a supermarket, pastry shops and so many restaurants within walking distance, ie just around the corner. Ditto for public transportation - bus stop just around the corner that served us as "tour" buses since the routes went by every known site you could wish to visit. Within walking distance the Victoria and Albert museum and the Natural history musuem, the beautiful church of St. Luke with its gardens just at the end of the street.

And the apartment itself was incredibly comfortable, with a washing machine and dishwasher and enough kitchen utensils for breakfast or any other meal you would want to prepare.

The neighborhood was exceptionally quiet in the evening with only the routine morning noise of the city of London waking in the morning.

I recommend Philippa and her home very highly and hope to return quite soon.

Ruth

Thank you for letting us stay in your beautiful flat. The location was excellent; you can almost see the bus stop from the front door! There is also plenty of shopping close by. The only tiny complaint we had was that apartment was on the first floor and it could be a little loud in the mornings. If you're a light sleeper, bring ear plugs. But I would definitely recommend this place!

Just as pictured - tidy, comfortable and quiet, with a nice bathroom, a well stocked kitchen, and a washer/dryer/ironing board/iron which is wonderful if you opt to stay a full week or more. With a Waitrose and an M&S both just around the corner, you'll be all set!

It's an incredibly convenient location - just off King's Road, only 10 min. walk to the South Kensington stop (near the V&A and within walking distance of Royal Albert Hall and Hyde Park, etc.) and ~10-15 min. walk to Sloan Square. Philippa was also an excellent host, always very helpful and responsive.

We only wish we'd been able to stay another week. A wonderful value, and I'm sure we'll try to stay again the next time we're in London!

The apartment was lovely and exactly as promised. We found the location excellent -- convenient to bus and tube, with lots of shops nearby-- and all the appliances and furnishings excellent. Phillipa made checking in and out a breeze, and kindly left us some milk in the fridge, and made certain we understood how everything worked.

The only drawbacks are things the owner really couldn't control: the noise from the trucks unloading right outside in the mornings (not too bad with windows closed), and the resulting lack of air circulation at night.

I would certainly recommend this flat to a couple looking for a clean, comfortable, well-equipped rental at a great price and in a great location!

The Bright Chelsea Apartment was just that. The flat is exactly as advertised ~ compact yet complete with everything you might need. Both of us arrived from Amsterdam a day into head colds. Philippa was kind enough to direct us to the "electric fire" she keeps tucked away so we were able to be a bit warmer on our sickest day.

Philippa is a great host making certain we knew where everything was and how it operated in the flat. We enjoyed being on the ground level for a change. Usually our accommodations away from home seem to be on the fifth and sixth floors without lifts.

Philippa will be starting a remodeling soon so it wil be interesting to stay when she has completed that to see the changes. They undoubtedly will be stunning.

Special note: I needed to fax a document back to the States and asked Philippa about businesses that provided those such as FedEx and MailBoxes Etc. There is a MBE near the South Kensington Underground however Philippa advised that her printer should do that (wouldn't connect for me as a scanner but worked fine as a copier/printer). The alternative were free services at the Town Hall across Kings Road. I ended up at the library at that building. William helped me join the library and then made an appointment for me at the computer station that would scan my document so I could send it as an attachment to an email.

Philippa was a very friendly, warm and caring host. We arrived very early - which meant that the guest before us was still in the flat, so Pilippa showed as a nice British bar/restaurant and had (very early ;) ) lunch with us - thanks for that! :) The room was very clean, big enough for the two of us and very easy to reach via bus and metro. You need about 20 minutes by bus and about 10 minutes by metro to get to the center.

We can only recommend this flat as accommodation and Philippa as a host!

Philippa's flat in Chelsea is absolutely adorable. It is warm, cosy, welcoming, and simply a delightful space. In a marvellous location; a secure building;  I had a most enjoyable stay. Thank you so much!
great flat, super location, nice and cosy, would definitely stay there again!

Every thing was fine!
Great location in Chelsea! We had no problem getting the key. We had a great time and would be very likely to recommend this flat.
Regards
Great little flat, central location, everything works.
A wonderful location. Philippa's home has everything you need & is very comfortable...feels like home. Thanks again.

Our first and very positive airbnb experience. The apt. was exactly as pictured on airbnb. No surprises and no disappointments. On arrival was clean and tidy. Key exchange went smoothly. Cozy but plenty of space for two people. Everything worked. WiFi was excellent.Communication via email with Phillipa was effortless. Location is great with easy access to stores, restaurants, buses and  underground. Neighborhood was quiet and safe. Highly recommended. Would definitely stay there again.

Wonderful location just off the Kings Rd. The flat was spotless, nicely decorated, good internet, comfy bed, plenty of hot water,small, but very well equipped kitchen. Good ground floor location so no need to lug luggage up stairs for us elderly folk. Philippa was a great host- answered all my questions promptly. Hope to stay there again.

We had a very comfortable stay in Chelsea Manor Street. Close to transport and all the things we wanted to do. Really nice to feel that we were at home. Philippa was overseas when we were there but arranged key pickup and answered our questions promptly.
It was a great two week spend at the place. Great location and everything you need to fell boom away from home.

Lovely apartment, great location, clean. Nice area, King's Road round the corner. 2 Minutes to busstop. Hardly any traffic in the street. Some noise early in the morning (Waitrose is very near), but it would be difficult to find a more quiet place so central in London. Good communication with Philippa.

This Chelsea apartment is a great place for visiting London. It is perfectly located, with King's Road shops around the corner, buses going in all directions, and half way between two tube stations.
The apartment is sunny and cosy and very easy to live in.
Philippa is just an email away. It is a secure building.
We toured all over London from here.

First time on Airbnb,

Philippa was very kind, welcoming and accomodating.
The flat is lovely, and as clean and quiet as said in the comments.
The location was perfect, next to underground station on the main lines.

We had there a wonderful time, and would be happy to stay there again !

This was my first time using Airbnb and I can only hope that future rentals are this positive.

Excellent apartment and exactly as described in the listing, down to the nice pub around the corner and the very relaxing gardens at St. Luke's. Safe, vibrant neighborhood and the location can't be beat. Bus stops right around the corner, underground stations a 3 minute bus ride or 10 minute walk away. Full service market also right around the corner. Several eating choices within a short walk. The apartment was warm and cozy and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.

Philippa was an outstanding host. Once we booked she provided us a wealth of information on the apartment and the neighborhood to get us orientated and despite the late hour of our arrival she was there to meet us and get us settled. The apartment has internet and Philippa had a number of maps and guides to help plan our London vacation. If relaxing with a good book is on the agenda, she has a nice assortment to choose from.

All-in-all a five star experience. I would not hesitate to recommend Philippa's apartment to my friends.
Nice host, tidy and well-equipped apartment, great location.

This was our first BnB experience and we were very pleased.  The apartment was clean and comfortable and the owner was very friendly and helpful.  A delightful lady from upstairs made our stay more enjoyable and managed a maintenance issue while we were out.  Location was excellent, directly on the bus lines and short walks to two tube stations.  Many food/pub choices minutes away and the Waitrose market was just around the corner.  We felt totally comfortable with the neighborhood and although we were on a first floor, it was actually very quiet and we slept well.  Starts to get a little noisy some mornings at 8, but we were well on on way to heading out for the morning.  We appreciated the absolute absence of smoke in the apartment.  I can easily recommend this apartment and location to anyone!

Philippa’s little apartment was perfect for my week’s stay in London. Very well located and very accessible to public transport, pubs and restaurants. All amenities were readily at hand. If only I had realised that there was an air conditioning unit above front door before my last days stay, especially as London probably experienced its hottest days of the summer during my stay! I would certainly recommend this apartment and hope to stay there on my next London trip. Mike

A small flat off the Kings Road in Chelsea which we took for a month.  Probably a bit small for a full month. 15-20 minutes walk from Sloane Square it is a good position save for one glaring fault.  It is on the corner of Hemus Place (see Google street view) which contains the loading docks and delivery areas for Habitat and Waitrose and the trucks can start form 6:00 AM some mornings and 7:00 AM most!  A sleep in is not an option. A minor but inconvenient matter was the dish washer was non functional when we arrived and as the owner was overseas nothing could be done.    Generally satisfactory!

A wonderful place to stay in London! It was easy to get to anywhere in London, situated between South Kensington and Sloane Square Tube stops. The first day we walked from the apartment to Westminister Abbey and Parliament. We loved the area, the walk along Kings Rd was one we did often and will miss. The flat was well appointed and Philippa gave us a thorough introduction to everything in the apartment before she left. Great food stores nearby, Waitrose and M&S.  If we go back to London we would want to stay here again.

Philippa is a lovely hostess and very accommodating. The flat was just as described, and was perfect for my 2-week venture in London. Philippa's flat is very comfortable and private, and close to all amenities. I would definitely recommend it as a great place to stay while exploring London.
Nice friendly welcome from Philippa, great compact flat in good location.

As previously arranged, we contacted Philippa when we arrived at the neighborhood Tube Station in London, and then met her in person at her flat just a few minutes later. She gave us a very thorough introduction to all aspects such as Kitchen, laundry, garbage, etc and welcomed any questions that we had. The flat and location were exactly as described in the listing, and, in fact, exceeded it.
Great flat and perfectly placed! Philippa was wonderful and explained everything in detail. We felt very welcome and safe there.
The flat is very comfortable, clean and in a wonderful area. We felt like at home. Communication with Philippa was easy and she was very helpful and accommodating. We had a great stay.

This is a perfect location for museums the V and A and the Natural History Museum. The 211 bus got me to Victoria Station in minutes; everything I needed close by - truly a comfortable, safe and pleasant venue for my solo city break.

Phillipa's apartment is clean, comfortable, well equipped, filled with natural light, and very well located. Very suitable for 1 person or a couple. As other reviewers have noted, it is behind the loading docks of two shops BUT double glazed windows throughout and heavy curtains in the bedroom minimised noise and light, with no problem for me on a morning I wished to sleep in. With a fan in the bedroom, air conditioning in the central hall and heating throughout, this would be a comfortable choice in any season. Ground floor location gives it convenient access with the Kings Rd - and buses - within 2 min. walk and tube within 12 min walk.

Philippa's apartment was wonderful!! It was cozy and charming and in the best location. Communication with her was perfect and we found the place easily. She provided detailed instructions for everything in the apartment. We felt very at home.

We booked the flat for 4 days in early July. Communication with Phillipa was excellent prior to our arrival. Unfortunately, we did not meet either Phillipa or any other person during our stay. Fortunately, we were able to get to the keys and successfully enter the apartment. The apartment itself was nice and comfortable. The location has its good and bad points. First the good - because of its location near a lot of nice shopping and restaurants (including a supermarket, Waitrose, nearby) our stay was comfortable. The number 11 bus which stops nearby takes you to within 15 minutes walking of most major sights. The bad thing about the location is it is right behind the Waitrose. ON our first morning we were woken up early by a lot of delivery truck noise. The dumpsters nearby are also a bit of an eyesore. But we kept the curtains drawn and were out most of the day so those things were soon forgotten. Overall we were pleased with our stay.

We had a wonderful stay at Philippa's cozy flat. It was perfectly located for our purposes, close to transportation, very comfortable, clean and easy to feel at home.
In terms of what matters to us, the kitchen had what we needed, the shower was strong, the bed comfortable, and the AC worked well.
Communication with Philippa was pleasant, instructions were clear, and Mary was very nice when we arrived later than expected due to tube strike.
All in all, a terrific experience. We would definitely stay again and recommend highly to others.
Thank you, Philippa!

Philippa was very responsive to all communication and very thorough in her descriptions about how everything worked. She was not in the country during our stay but it is pretty much a turn key operation and there was a neighbor who we could have contacted if necessary. The apartment is as pictured and described on the website. Great neighborhood with excellent shopping dining and lots of pubs and clubs. little bit of a walk to the subway, but there are buses, taxis and uber so we had no trouble getting around. The apartment has all of the conveniences you could need or want. Dishwasher, washer and dryer and Air conditioning unit and all worked flawlessly. We would definitely stay here again.
Our stay of 6 days in London at Philippa's apartment was very successful. The Apartment was as advised and being just off Kings Road was ideal. We would definitely use it again.

I had an excellent stay in Philippa's flat. Although she was away when we arrived, she made arrangements for us to acquire the keys and receive a tour of the apartment. The flat is so cute, perfect for 1 or a couple.

The apartment is located in a lovely neighbourhood, with many excellent bars and restaurants as well as 2 underground stations within in walking distance. We had no issues getting around the city while staying based in Chelsea.

I stayed in Philippa's apartment for a week while in London on business. The apartment was perfect for me. It had everything I wanted, it was very clean and tidy, the shower was terrific, it was handy to public transport, it was on the ground floor but very safe and secure. I will certainly try to stay here the next time I am in London.
The flat is amazing. Its close to the bus stop and just a minute walk to all the pubs. I would recommend this apartment to anyone who want to stay in Chelsea.

Good communication prior to arrival and Phillipa was there to welcome us despite late plane. Our second stay at her apt. Great location close to two tube stations, restaurants, shopping and a grocery store around the corner if you want to cook. Fully equipped. Beautiful little church park at the end of the street. Great place from which to explore London.

I cannot recommend this flat highly enough. It was lovely, clean, easy check-in and -out, excellent location; everything you could hope for. Honestly, stop your search and stay here. It's the perfect slice of London life and British hospitality provided by Philippa.
Perfectly located to explore London city at its best!

I loved my 6-night stay at this adorable apartment! It's compact but just right for just one person. It was also an extremely convenient 2-minute walk to my office along with a variety of shops, restaurants, and pubs. The ground floor location was a bit strange at first, as I felt that people on the street could see me in the apartment, but it ended up not being an issue (just make sure to close the curtains when you need to). It also can get a little noisy, but my sleep wasn't very disturbed. Overall, a tremendous value for apartment quality and location.

It was a very nice stay. The apartment is exactly as described and has everything you could possibly need. We didn't get to meet Philippa but we could communicate and arrange everything for our arrival and departure. The  shower pressure was really good, we had lots of towels and the kitchen was more than fully equiped. There's a supermarket just around the corner which is great. The street is a bit noisy sometimes early in the morning. We would definitely choose this apartment again if we visited London.

You MUST stay here! I cannot recommend this place enough. Communication with Philippa before we arrived was great, and the instructions to get into the flat were simple and clear. After we arrived, we received a welcome e-mail from her, and although she was not in London at the time, we were able to reach out to her neighbour if we needed anything (which we did not). The flat had everything we needed, and was the perfect size for a couple. It was on the ground floor, which was a bit nerve-wracking at first, but we were able to close the curtains and felt very safe and secure in the building.

Chelsea is a very posh area and we felt very safe, even when coming home at 1AM in the morning one night. It is close to so many restaurants, great shopping, and is a 10 minute walk from the tube. It was also a great home base for sightseeing - we frequently only had to take one line (Circle/District) to get where we needed to go.

I would definitely stay here again.

A wonderful find, just off the King's Road. Compact but with everything that you possibly want and more. What's more, the host kept in touch to the extent that she was mid Atlantic when she became aware of the heat wave we were enjoying and e-mailed me to remind me of the air conditioning unit. Service indeed. Would I stay there again? Yes! Would I recommend it to friends? Ofcourse!

We knew the area well, so knew how convenient the location is. Everything at your fingertips.
There was a bit of noise during the day with local construction, but we were out most of the day so it wasn't an issue. The flat is small but cute, and had everything you would need. Highly recommend.

What a great location! Super convenient, clean with a comfortable bed, luxurious linens and a super host. Our only regret is that we didn't get to meet Philippa as she was traveling- but she has a great system for check-in when she is traveling. We felt safe in the neighborhood and found a great breakfast place a few steps away... Nells. Tell them "San Diego" sent you!!

En general fue una buena experiencia, las llaves estaban donde se indicó, llegamos bien con la dirección y el lugar tiene lo que ofrece.
Excelente ubicación, tranquilo y seguro.

Un superbe séjour : l'appartement est idéalement situé car les bus passants à l'arrêt situé à quelques mètres desservent la station de métro de Sloan Square mais ont aussi un accès direct et rapide à Picadilly Circus, Victoria Station et bien d'autres lieux stratégiques. La station de métro Sloan Square étant sur la circle line est très pratique. King's Road est une rue commerçante animée, on peut manger dans des restos très sympas dans les environs proches. Le quartier chic est vraiment idéal.
L'appartement est très agréable, très coquet, la déco est jolie et la propreté est absolument impeccable. Philippa s'est montrée très réactive et prévenante dans ses messages, ainsi que de bons conseils. Elle ne nous a pas reçus à l'arrivée mais les explications étaient suffisantes pour que nous puissions nous installer confortablement. Une gentille attention nous attendait dans l'appartement. Tout a été vraiment parfait hormis un peu bruit la nuit et au petit matin (plaque de fer sur laquelle roulent les voitures à cause de travaux, service de livraison du magasin Habitat juste à coté, camions poubelles) dus au fait qu'on se situait au rdc, qui nous ont parfois réveillés. Néanmoins j'y retournerais avec plaisir et recommande grandement cet appartement. Merci Philippa.
This place is perfect for someone needing a home away from home. It is very convenient to everything in Chelsea and Kensington

Super!
Nice apartment, Chelsea is a fantastic Place to stay.
Everything close: bus, supermarket, and restaurant.
The home is lovely and very clean, there is allora inside.
Thank' for all Philippa
Beliggenhed, beliggenhed og beliggenhed. Centralt i Chelsea, med god adgang til Londons centrum via  bus eller tube.
Beautiful place, close to everything!!
Excellent host. Convenient and comfortable apartment. I will plan future trips here if possible.
Philippa was lovely and the flat's location was excellent - so close to the shops on the King's Road and an easy walk to the Tube. It's the perfect base for a solo traveler or a couple.
Philippa's flat is amazing!  So close to the bus, tube, grocery store and restaurants.  Very comfortable, fabulous amenities, and easy check in.  We would definitely stay at her place again.

We enjoyed every bit of our stay at Philippa's apartment. The location affords quick access to public transportation with a bus stop around the corner and the underground a short walk away. The apartment was cozy and warm for our stay in October. Philippa was easy to communicate with before and during our stay and left us with plenty of instructions and tips. We would stay here and highly recommend!

This is a perfect flat for exploring London. Cosy, clean, close to the tube station, with many places for a substantial breakfast or a quick pint. Philippa is a super friendly and hospitable host. Out stay was great (including no problems with hot water which is not a rare thing in London and the heating inspite of the Beast from the East). A highly recommended place!

This was a great 1 bedroom flat with all the amenities of home. A short 8-10 minute walk to two tube stations as well as around the corner from the flat was a Waitrose market which has everything you need at great prices. The flat is located in a quiet area of Chelsea and a great place to come home to after sightseeing all day. I would stay here again in this Chelsea flat.

Perfect stay! Excellent location with the bus stop within 30 sec, and the tube within a 10 min walk. Central but still very quite. Great and safe area. Very easy check in and very well equipped lovely apartment, clean. Thank you Philippa!
Location,  location, location!!!  Philippa is the greatest,  the communication is outstanding.

Philippa的房子在住宅区内，环境很好，非常的安静，房间内设施很齐全(吹风机，洗衣机，烘干机，烤箱，微波炉以及洗碗机等等)，房东回复消息也很及时很好沟通。房子在一楼，面积不太大但是采光很好，客厅2面都有窗户非常的通透，步行到最近的地铁站大约需要10分钟，但是步行到最近的公交车站只需2～3分钟，到China town坐公交车不用换乘半个小时就能到。房间内可以做饭，不过附近没有中超或者亚超，最近的超市是Waitrose。

We had a lovely and comfortable stay in Philippa’s flat. The location is great, we found several excellent restaurants nearby (favorites were Murials and the Ivy), and it’s a short walk to the Kensington Station. The flat is cozy and bright, it got a little warm with the windows closed but once you open a couple there are lovely breezes that cool it right down. The shower is amazing with fantastic water pressure! Philippa is very responsive to questions and never took more than a day to respond even while she is on her own vacation.  We traveled on our 1st anniversary and she left us a welcome card and an anniversary card also which was so sweet. Highly recommend!

Reyhana is a Stellar hostess. Far beyond expectations. She has her place well organized for guests. It is spotless! The location is very good to get just about anywhere, plane, train, underground... everything. The Westfield Shopping Center was great stop for my travel-worn hair and nails!
I highly recommend this place . Very resonable especially for private bath and location.!
Perfect host. Reyhana was very helpful prior to my stay and once there I was made to feel welcome. With an early alarm, Reyhana was very considerate during the evening. Thanks for having me.
Reyhana is not only an incredible host...she's an incredible human being.  My stay was perfect from start to finish.  Thank you for helping to make my stay so smooth!
Convenient to public transport, great space and host!
Reyhana's place is great, you'll love it!

Reyhana was very friendly, helpful and accommodating.
The location was ideal, close to a bus stop and a short walk to the train/tube station
The place was clean and tidy, spacious and comfortable.
I really felt at home and enjoyed my stay... Highly recommended
I received great hospitality from Reyhana over my three day stay, she was thoughtful, nice and accommodating. The property was very comfortable and really well located.
A great place to stay for the RideLondon sportive at the Olympic park and Reyhana was a great host. Would stay there again next time.

Rey Hama is a great host.
A couple of things to note - take a robe, as the bathroom is across the hall.
Take ear plugs as there is traffic all night.
Reyhana was Amazing. She was very friendly and communication was easy as she gladly assisted with whatever help I needed. Great location and the bathroom was very clean as well. Thanks Reyhana.
Place was clean, close to my classes, and Reyhana was always helpful.

Really nice location!
The room is warm and clean~ the bathroom is prefect. I was a master student studying in London and I’m sure if I want to come back again I’ll live in Reyhana’s place again! Thanks for everything Reyhana~~
I needed a place for my family who were visiting me from abroad. The house and location were great and the hosts were extremely helpful and friendly. I highly recommend this place!

Great house in a wonderful location. Our family of 5 thoroughly enjoyed our stay in London, staying at Rob and Tony's house for 5 nights.
The house was impeccably clean. We loved the decor and comfort of the house. Very comfortable bed! Staying at a house beats apartment rental any day - plenty of room and all the comforts and convenience of home.
It is a fantastic location to relax in after a busy day in London. Just a 5 minute walk to the metro and DLR -very easy and fast access to central London. It was closer than we expected.
Can't praise the house, location, hosts highly enough. Communication was easy, friendly, helpful. We'd be very happy to stay again.

Las fotos de la casa que aparecen en el anuncio de esta página se correspondían con la realidad de la casa. La casa es muy bonita, no le falta detalle, tiene todo lo necesario para vivir. Tiene varias paradas de autobús y dos paradas de metro a menos de 5 minutos caminando desde la casa. Los autobuses pasan cada 5 minutos y la estación de metro funciona muy bien. En general la casa esta muy bien comunicada con el centro de Londres. El barrio es muy tranquilo y tiene varias tiendas para comprar comida o cualquier otra cosa que se necesite. También hay bares y parques cercanos.
¡¡¡Si volvemos a Londres no dudaremos en alquilar otra vez esta casa porque nos dejó enamoradas!!!

Ewerything was perfect . There was four of us teo couplesand we were more than satisfied. Bus station is 2 minutes and tube and dlr are 5 minutes wall from the house. House is clean very good equiped and hosts are great. They were in vacatiin but everyday contact us asking if we need some help about house or London. Neighborohud is quiet and peacefull 20 minutes from central London by punlic transport. Definitley first choice for the stay in London. If it is possible I would give them 6 not 5.
Filip Borkovic

Nous cherchions un second "chez nous" pour notre découverte de Londres et nous n'avons pas été déçus! Après un accueil très chaleureux de Tony et Rob avec qui nous avions déjà beaucoup échangé par mail, nous nous sommes installés dans leur magnifique maison, parfaite pour notre famille de 4. Décorée avec soin, offrant toutes les commodités et située dans un quartier calme mais proche des moyens de transports pour se retrouver très vite en centre ville ou à la campagne, cette maison nous a permis de passer des vacances fabuleuses. Tony et Rob ont souvent pris de nos nouvelles, très attentifs à ce que nous ne manquions de rien : des hôtes parfaits! Nous avons trouvé l'endroit idéal où passer nos prochaines vacances à Londres. Merci Tony et Rob!

Tony and Rob's home was a good location to take the tube downtown to experience all the sites. Close to groceries and parks.

They have a lovely home with everything you need to make yourself comfortable.

Tony & Rob's place is a beautiful ancient house. It is completely equipped with all the electric and non-electric necessities for travelers. The house has 3 floors and 2 bathrooms!
The house is located in a very nice neighborhood and about 5-8 minutes walk to the Underground station and from there you can get anywhere with a relatively short ride.
Most important, Tony & Rob are the NICEST and were most responsive and attentive to all the details and needs we had.
We had a great time in Tony & Rob' s house and we definitely recommend staying there.
Thank you Tony & Rob.
Si vous n'avez pas d'aversion avec les transports communs, le logement est idéal pour visiter Londres à un tarif plus qu'abordable dans un cadre agréable.

Le logement est très bien situé pour visiter Londres à pieds et en transport en commun.
Le logement est de très belle qualité, très spacieux, bien équipé, très propre, et très calme.
A proximité des transports ,de magasin Tesco et grand centre commercial.
Merci à nos hôtes pour leur gentillesse et leur disponibilité.

Très agréable maison, située dans un quartier calme et agréable, à proximité des transports (bus et métro). Parfait pour un pied-à-terre familial. Maison typique, rénovée avec gout. Spacieuse, confortable et lumineuse, on s'y sent bien...
L'environnement est calme et super agréable.
Les hôtes sont parfaits, réactifs, ils sont joignables et répondent très rapidement... C'est très appréciable.
Séjour parfait !!!
This house is
Easy access to all attractions and easy to get to the airport. Situated in the perfect place and Tony is a perfect host.

It was a very nice and pleasure time on staying in Tony & Rob's house.
We had a chance to visit most of the London sightseeing places and everyday we felt warm to return their home.
Very comfortable and feel free when we stay there.

Parfait pour notre séjour en famille à la découverte de Londres car maison agréable, bien équipée, bien située dans un quartier authentique et bien desservie pour aller rapidement au coeur de Londres. Nous avons apprécié les commerces de proximité. Merci beaucoup Tony et Rob pour votre gentillesse et votre réactivité !

Our stay at Tony and Rob's place went perfectly. Everything was as advertised and worked well. They gave good instructions throughout and were very flexible with the check in/out. The house was warm in the middle of winter and especially the master bedroom had luxury level pillows and comforter. The wifi worked flawlessy too. No complaints from us and we're happy to recommend Tony and Rob.
Place just as advertised.  Very clean and neighborhood quiet with access to underground less than 1/2 mile.  Very good overall experience

super maison équipement irréprochable, à proximité de tous les transports et commerces , déplacement très facile avec une travecard  7 days , les lits sont  très confortables et les sanitaires  très agréable avec un bon débit d'eau chaude à volonté .on se sent comme à la maison .

Allez-y les yeux fermés ! Une veritable petite maison aux charmes anglais, à l'écart du tumulte citadin. Après de longues journées de visites, cela fait du bien, le soir venu, d'être au calme. Des commerces d'alimentation entre la station de métro et la maison permettent de préparer des repas comme chez soi!

Lovely flat, very well situated in london, close to the district of Soho.
Really great location, about 1 minute walk to the metro. The place was very clean. Astrid was always available to help us with any questions. Stay here!!

I would absolutely recommend both Astrid as a hostess and her beautiful flat.
The flat is in a wonderfully central location yet on a quiet street - perfect! Anything you could want is within walking distance. The flat itself is lovely. Warm, fully equipped and very comfortable. My father stayed there and he commented just about everyday on how comfortable the bed was! When we arrived the flat was in a perfect condition - very clean and tidy. At no time were there any concerns with anything. The flat is secure and the few stairs to the inside entrance were of no problem to my father who is in his late 70s.
Astrid is a fabulous hostess. So welcoming and friendly, she made everything very straight forward and easy for us in arranging this rental. Beforehand she was easy to get hold of and would respond right away to any queries. Her warm manor made us feel most welcome in her home.
If you want a fully equipped, lovely place to stay in the heart of the most exciting city in the world yet in a quiet and secure location, this is the perfect place for you! I really hope when either my mother or father visit again it is available! We couldn't have asked for more. Thank you Astrid!

To be honest we would love to give a bad review so that the flat would be free if we want to come back, but we can´t do this as it was a really good decision to book this flat. The flat is really cute and fully furnished so that we didn´t miss a thing. It is really central so that we could reach nearly everything by walking, even when the public transport was out of order on Christmas-day we had no problems as we could walk around without problems. The area is really nice as a lot of shopping-possibilities are around (Tesco, Sainsburry-s, Boots, Currys PC and a lot of restaurants) and it´s just a 10-14 minutes walk to Oxford Street and just 2 Minutes to the next tube-station.
Astrid herself was really friendly - she contacted us in advance and sent us necessary informations about problems with the public transport so that we were totally prepaired when we arrived. Also she introduced us in everything that´s important about the flat and gave us several information about her area, shopping-possibilities, fun-possibilities etc.
She was so kind and really helpful!!!
We can just recommend the flat and Astrid as for us it was a very good choice. We are sure that we will ask Astrid again when we are going to heading back to London next time.

Our stay at Astrid's flat was fantastic. It's lovely, artsy, and comfortable (and is so close to the Tube station!) The location was ideal for us, and central to everything. Astrid was so nice, helpful and accommodating. She went out of her way to give us the lay of the land and helpful hints when we arrived. There are places to eat and buy groceries in close proximity, as well as several pubs. I hope we can come back sometime soon.

I stayed at Astrid's app for 6 days. We emailed sometime before my arrival and she gave me all info I needed. She was so welcoming and on arrival showed me around the flat and even a small tour round the area.
The flat is in a lovely and safe area, and as a single traveller a great place to stay. 1-2 min walk to cosy coffeshops, tubestations (warren str and great portland str stations),shops and pubs. You could choose to walk downtown which doesn't take long. A 5 min walk to lovely Regents prk. Just grab a coffee on the way and relax.
The flat itself had everything you would need, working wifi in all rooms, enough hot water for a bath and more. Washingmachine was easily managed. A quiet street and no noise from neighbours. Some buildingwork going on next door, but I was aware of it before I got there. Didn't bother me as I was out all day anyway.
She lives on the 3rd floor, but no problem climbing the stairs.
Astrid is a warm and friendly person, I would recommend her and her flat to anyone. I would definately rent this place again!

La experiencia con la anfitriona fue excelente.Antes del viaje nos contactamos con Astrid y nos orientó acerca no solo de las comodidades de su hogar, sino tambien acerca de medios de transporte y lugares que podiamos conocer en Londres. Se ocupo de que no tuviéramos inconveniente en llegar a su casa, y de que un vecino nos entregara las llaves, ya que ella no podia hacerlo en el horario de nuestra llegada.El apartamento tenía todas las comodidades necesarias, y cumplió con la descripcion ofrecida en la página.El vecindario es tranquilo, y la ubicacion es excelente, ya que nos permitió acceder  a lugares de interés caminando y con todos los medios de transporte a  200 metros de distancia.Muy recomendable.

We very much enjoyed our time at Astrid's. The apartment was convenient and cosy and had everything we needed. The street was very quiet for such a central location. Being so close to the tube was great! Unfortunately we didn't have the opportunity to meet Astrid in person but the online communication was great, as well as the notes and maps left for us in the apartment. We definitely recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a comfortable and conveniently located base to explore London. Thanks so much Astrid for welcoming us into your home!
As advertised, it is a great place to stay. This was my third visit and I hope to return next year.

This was a perfect place to stay for 10 days while sightseeing in London. It was a little larger than I anticipated and was quite comfortable for two. The location is excellent — close to several bus lines and lots to do within walking distance. The construction was not very disruptive since it took place mostly when we were awake and out of the house. Overall an excellent experience. Just be sure to follow Philippa’s instructions rather than GPS in finding the address!

Квартира очень уютная, небольшая, расположена в благополучном и красивом районе Челси. Состоит из небольшого коридора, спальни с кроватью шириной примерно 140-150 см. и объединённой гостиной с кухней, в обеих комнатах по два окна на разные стороны, они очень светлые.
Автобусная остановка Chelsea Old Town Hall и большой супермаркет Waitrose, работающий с 7-30 до 22 часов, расположены в 5 минутах пешком. До станции метро прогулочным шагом минут 15. В 10 минутах пешком к центру на Кинг Роуд есть недорогие места, чтобы перекусить - Pret A Manger и Itsu, да и вся улица представляет собой сплошные магазинчики.
В квартире есть все, что может потребоваться во время проживания, включая посуду и кухонную утварь для приготовления различных блюд. Приятно, что есть капсульная кофемашина Нескафе Дольче Густо и тостер.
Wi-fi есть, работает нормально, также есть Нетфликс со всевозможными фильмами, мультфильмами и передачами (на английском, разумеется).
Хозяйка, Филиппа, отвечает на любые вопросы через связь на сайте очень любезно, оперативно и подробно.
Непосредственно рядом с домом идёт реконструкция здания, работы начинаются примерно с 7-30 в будни, заканчиваются достаточно рано, в выходные не работают. Мы в это время встаём, нам шум от стройки не мешал, но для кого-то может быть важно.

Great time in London!
Thanks to the owner of a beautiful house

The location is excellent.  Shops and cafes  a block away. The flat is located in a quiet building on a quiet street.  There is construction going on next door but it did not bother us. It was very comfortable and a relaxing place to return at the end of a long day.  We would definitely stay again.
For me a perfect place. Will come back if I can.
Great location, nice fully equipped flat, very accommodating hosts. Highly recommended.

Perfect location to enjoy Chelsea and surrounding areas.
Lovely apartment with all amenities as described, makes you want to stay indoors!

아주 깨끗합니다. 화장실, 주방, 침실이 청결에 아주 중요하다고 생각하는 사람인데, ‘super clean’ 이었습니다. 필요한 옷장은 비어있고, 표기된 시설이 모두 있었고, 관리가 아주 잘 되어있었습니다. Phillippa의 성격이 저와 잘 맞다고 생각합니다. 주변에 갈 수 있는 상점, 레스토랑, 박물관, 백화점 모두 접근성이 좋은 반면, 조용한 주택가에 있어서 집에서 휴식할 때에도 좋았습니다. 가까운 지하철역은 15분 이내인데 체감상 조금 멀다는 느낌이 있었지만 버스는 매우 가까워서 편리합니다. 무엇보다 ‘wait rose’가 가까워서 최고입니다! 런던 교통상황을 잘 몰라서, 늦은 체크인에도 기다려주고, 친절하게 안내해주어서 감사드립니다. 다음에 또 방문하고 싶습니다. 건강하게 잘 지내시길!
Another great time. This flat is perfect for me. Hope to be back next year.
As before, ideal for me and an excellent place to stay.

This was our second stay with Philippa, who once again went out of her way to accommodate our travel plans.  Communication was great, and we felt like we were visiting an old friend.  The flat was convenient to the underground and to shopping and restaurants, and the lovely gardens at St. Luke were just around the corner.
Suits me perfectly
As usual, a great place for me to stay and all very smoothly organised. I hope to be back.
Amazing location - great apartment, plenty of room for 4 - with space for more.  Well appointed rooms.  Easy to get to.  A great stay.

Great place. Less than a 5 minute walk to Warren Street Tube Station, and buses to Piccadilly Circus, Charing Cross/Trafalgar Square, King's Cross/St. Pancras.
Clean, safe neighborhood with restaurants and pubs steps away.
A Tesco, Sainsbury and Pret a Manger are really close. 3 bds and 2 bthrm were enough to comfortably house 6 adults. Full kitchen, dish washer, and washing machine were a plus. No complaints. Would stay here again. Thanks Liz.

O apartamento é muito bom e a localização ótima, perto de várias estações de metro, supermercado, restaurantes e da até para ir caminhando para a Oxford Street. Apenas tivemos dificuldade com a utilização das máquinas de lavar louça e roupa. E Liz foi pronto ao atender nosso chamado para um reparo de urgência.

The flat is very nice and great location, near several tube stations, supermarkets, restaurants, also walking up to go to Oxford Street. We only had difficulty with the use of dishwashers and the washing machine, but Liz was ready to meet our call for an urgent repair.

The apartment was very clean, easy to use and was a great temporary home for us.  We stayed here for 9 days as we did some day trips out to various other cities across the UK.  The location is absolutely fabulous.  It is within walking distance of at least 5 different tube lines and two national rail stations, so day trips are super easy.  There are a host of restaurants, pubs, grocery stores, etc. in easy walking distance.  I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone!

Amazing!

We met Astrid upon arrival, she showed us around the Fitzrovia area and answerd all of our questions about distance to this and that :)
The apartment is lovely in each and every way so personal and cozy which I really appriciated being a General Manager of a 4* Luxury Hotel in Iceland. Basically we were looking for something totally different from Design/Boutique Hotel which this apartment is!

One of the best thing is the bathtub, picture coming home after long day of sightseeing or shopping your feet are sore and your body is about to go to give up and go to Spain. Just to have the opportunity to take a long extremely cozy bath before go to sleep is priceless.

We stayed one week (7 nights) and obviously we didnt use the kitchen facilites as we prefered to dine out every night. But all the utensils were there.
Living room is small but nice, table with 3 chairs and CD player with many different Cd´s around (We got a fantastic flashback by listening to "Fugees" cd which we found)

Astrid as a host is a dream in a way. Her open personality and passion for art and life in general is something that I dont have strong enough adjectives for. She was so helpful (gave us Oyster cards, maps of the area even offered us tea!) Flexible check in/check out was not a problem as our flight departured at 21:00 - so we kept our luggage in the apartment. When we left she rang and ordered taxi for us to Victoria Station (not the black expenisve one´s).

Overall absolutely fantastic stay, great hostess, lovely atmosphere, best possible location and fair price! I would definitely stay there again no doubt about it and can highly recommand this to anyone who prefer the same as us.

Lastly, Astrid thank you for a wonderful stay - you inspired us and I can say with full confident that you are genuine and good hearted person. We love you it is as simple as that :)

Great apartment, fantastic location 10 min walk to Oxford Street, 15 min walk to Soho/Chinatown. Easy access to Warren St tube line (Victoria Line and Northern line) approximately 3 min walk.

La Vie De Bohème chez Astrid est comme de vivre sur un petit nuage au Paradis!
Elle est une hôtesse merveilleuse: elle nous a fait découvrir son quartier, nous a montré tous les points stratégiques du coin et est super arrangeante quand aux horaires d'arrivée et de départ .
Son appartement est idéalement situé par rapport aux transports (métro et bus) qui permettent d'aller au cœur de Londres.
Très propre et très calme, je recommande la Vie De Bohème à tous les globes trotters (Astrid est aussi une grande voyageuse)

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans l' appartement "vie de Bohème"!
Nous n'avons pas vu Astrid sur place car elle était en voyage, mais la préparation pour notre arrivée a été très efficace et chaleureuse . Nous avons reçu les plans , les guides de fonctionnement de l'appartement , du métro proche... Nous avons pu nous contacter très facilement et rapidement par mail et par skype
Astrid a été une interlocutrice charmante et très soucieuse de notre bien-être dans son appartement:
Celui-ci est vraiment agréable , disposant de tout ce dont nous avons besoin, "comme à la maison", situé dans une impasse très calme , prêt de la station de métro de Warren street, ce qui permet de circuler très rapidement dans Londres
Pour nous, ce fut parfait ; nous remercions Astrid et recommandons vivement cette location .

The apartment is amazing and exatally like pictures, so you have everything you need for a short or long stay. Very cozy! It is in the very city center, you have tube and lots of buses to get you everywhere you need in few minutes. Just 15 min walk to Oxford St and 10 min to British Museum. Charlotte St is less than 5 min walk and you have great options to eat! Just a few steps you have supermarkets, cafés, pubs, restaurants... but at same time you are in a quite street for a good night sleep!
I had a perfect time and felt like home since the first day. Astrid was an amazing host and friend, was always ready to help me with everything I need. Be sure you have no place better than there, I spent 1 month and it was fantastic! Thanks Astrid for taking care of me during this time! :)

This is my first AirBnB experience, my friend and I were so lucky to have Astrid as our host, she is so warm-hearted and helpful. Our flight was delayed for nearly three hours, and she welcomed us as a lovely friend, showed us around and explained everything for us clearly, she also suggested some good cafes and restaurants. That really set a wonderful start for our trip!
We stayed at the apartment for a week, the apt is clean and equipped with everything we need. and the location is wonderful, we can take a comfortable work to most of the places, and if we want to take underground train, there are 2-3 stations around within 3-8 minutes walk. We really love this apartment, it feels more like home than an apartment. We will definitely come back next time!

Astrid is a great hostess, she made everything very straight forward and easy for us in arranging this rental and delivering the keys of the flat.
She is very friendly and kind person. During the arrangements of the flat, she was very helpful and easy to reach. She gave us tips on where to go and what to do. She was so caring that she drop a message asking if everything is ok after we arrived and settled in the flat. She left us many maps, guides and magazines. Her flat was just as in the pictures, lovely well-equipped and tidy. It is in the very city center while still in a very quiet street. You have tube and lots of buses to get you everywhere you need in few minutes. We mostly preferred to walk around until we are tired so that we can feel the city more  we mostly used to walk to Soho, Oxfrord Street, Regent Street, Regent Park etc. (it feels more like Londoner :)) There are places to shop and eat around. Just on the corner you will see a “Pret a Manger” (the café/rest that you will see in almost every 250m :)) If you want a fully equipped, lovely place to stay in the heart of London yet in a quiet and secure location, this is the perfect place for you! Thank you Astrid, xx

Astrid's appartment is cosy, nice and situated very central in an enjoyable neighbourhood. Astrid took good care of us and everything was like it was described. I would totally recommend Astrid's appartement if you want to have a good time in London.

If you get to this point on your airbnb's searching place to stay in London, you are lucky! Astrid place was for sure my best airbnb experience, great location, amazing flat, full of light! Thank you Astrid

Astrid’s place is in a fantastic central location in Fitzrovia, ideal for sightseeing in London. It is close to transport, great pubs, restaurants and cafes, Regent’s Park, and very close to the British Museum. It is also a 10 minute walk to Oxford Street.

We were very comfortable in Astrid’s flat, found it clean and tidy, and it was well equipped for self-catering, with several supermarkets in close proximity.

Astrid is very flexible, and although she was away overseas, returned emails quickly and assisted us however she could. She provided some excellent recommendations and was really friendly.

I would definitely recommend Astrid’s flat and would stay there again!

Un allotjament perfecte! Ben situat, ben comunicat, a 3 minuts de l'estació de metro Warren Street. Carrer i veïnat tranquils, perfecte per a descansar.
L'Astrid és una noia molt agradable, comunicativa i que et donarà ajuda i informació en tot el que necessitis.
Si tornem a Londres segur que voldrem tornar a casa seva.

What an amazing little place! Astrid's apartment was the perfect place for our week in London. It was easy to get to her place via the Tube from the airport and it was so central; Tottenham Court Road, Oxford Street, King's Cross and the West End all within walking distance. Astrid herself was a wonderful host, always making sure we were comfortable. The place is just like the pictures and the area is very safe. I highly recommend this place to anyone staying in London!!

Nous étions comme à la maison avec possibilité de nous servir !
Appartement parfaitement équipé.
le logement est idéalement situé à à peine 10 minutes à pied de Oxford Circus et de toutes les commodités.
Il est très calme car situé dans une mew (sorte d impasse) donc pas de trafic ce qui est très appréciable à Londres.
Astrid nous a laissé plein d informations pour faciliter notre séjour

Astrid is a wonderful host: incredibly open and accommodating, especially given that I arrived a little earlier than anticipated due to an ahead-of-schedule flight. Her flat is perfectly situated in Fitzrovia, right in the heart of central London; virtually everything is walking distance. It's cozy and I never felt like I was in an area where I had to worry for my safety as a young woman traveling alone -- and this includes traveling alone at night. Her house rules are simple and easy to follow, and she was happy to walk through them all with me and answer any questions I had. More than that, Astrid was a delight in that she walked me around the neighbourhood in order to acquaint me with where I was living; though I had been to London before three years' previous, I had never been to Fitzrovia, so her tour of the area was a great help. Long story short: Astrid is a delight, her flat is perfectly lovely, and I am so grateful that she allowed me to stay there for the week. A wonderful experience.

Astrid is a very personable and thoughtful host.  She really takes the time to explain the apartment and its quirks, but is also very generous with her space.  The location of the apartment could not be better.  I had a lovely stay.

Astrid's apartment was just as described. It was perfect for the week I was there, and the host was very helpful and thorough with everything I needed to know. The location is very convenient for travelling around London and accessing grocery and restaurants.

The apartment was perfect for my two week stay in London. Really convenient to everything in central London, with underground stations nearby and many places in walking distance. Kitchen is well stocked and grocery stores are nearby. One thing to know is that the bed is on the hard side and you have to take a bath or sit to shower but I didn't find this to be a problem. Astrid was incredibly friendly and helpful. I didn't get to meet her in person but we skyped before I arrived and she was easy to communicate with during my visit. Highly recommend!

Nosso muito obrigado, Astrid. O ambiente é exatamente como descrito, as fotos mostram tudo exatamente como é. Houve facilidade em encontrar o lugar e não tivemos nenhum problema para entrar no apartamento. A localização é excelente. Fica perto de estação de trens e de metrô, há muitos restaurantes na vizinhança e supermercados. Ficamos bem satisfeitos. Recomendo o lugar e a pessoa. Astrid nos deu todas as indicações e instruções possíveis!
Nice stay!!!

Astrid was a great host! She welcomed us in and gave us all the details needed for a comfortable stay. Her apartment is conveniently located 20 min by subway from St. Pancras, and within a walking distance to Soho.

The place was apparently clean and tidy, with all the amenities needed, and is located in a quiet, inner street.

Astrid's place was great, comfortable, well-equipped, ideally located, and in a quiet area. The apartment conformed to the description and the photos give an accurate idea of the real place. Astrid was abroad but she left me all the necessary information to make my stay easy, and she was generally very helpful. Because nothing is perfect, if you're a shower person it can be bothering to take the shower sitting in the bathtub (but you get used to it after a few days), and sometimes you can hear the neighbors upstairs a little bit too much. But overall I warmly recommend this place!
Very nice flat, clean tidy and quiet.
The flat is central, and you can easily walk to Soho. The description is accurate. It's a charming place. Astrid was very helpful, which made for a smooth check in.

Astrid is friendly, helpful and a lovely hostess. I stayed roughly 20 days in her apt. and I can certainly affirm that it was an incredible time with everything I needed for my stay, besides being a charming place with an accurate description.
The location was pretty good, close to the underground and around to some of the most important places in London. For me it was even more special because my school was 15 minutes walking from Astrid's place.
In general, it was amazing and I really recommend the place :)

Great value! Hadn't stay in Fitzrovia before, and I really enjoyed it as a neighbourhood. Having Astrid's flat as a stepping off point is perfect - close to transit, and to wander the city on foot. The flat itself is clean and spacious. I'd absolutely stay again next time I'm in London.

Very nice flat. Exactly as the description. Astrid has give us all instructions, very clear to live in his flat. Very well placed, direct acces to the tube and buses lines, we recommand strongly. Now we are just hoping to can come again and meet Astrid =).

Ficamos uma semana no apartamento da Astrid e foi tudo ótimo!
Fica bem próximo ao metrô e a vários pontos de ônibus, foi bem fácil se locomover por toda a cidade. O local é silencioso e muito seguro.
Astrid realmente é uma super host, foi super atenciosa e nos ajudou bastante com o que fazer em Londres.

This has been the best Airbnb experience I've had. Astrid and her apartment deliver on the promise of what the service is meant to be. Incredible people who share their amazing places with the community.
She was very responsive once I made the reservation and all of her communications were thorough. When we met for check in she was very gracious with her time and went out of her way to show me around the neighborhood.
The apartment itself was incredibly charming and inspiring, oozing with art and culture. It was incredibly easy to get around easily accessible by bus and underground. On several nights I opted to walk home because of how close it was and how beautiful the weather was.
I hope you're as fortunate as I was to have found this spot for your stay.

Meeting Astrid and staying in her apartment in Fitzroy was such a great experience! I could definitely live there in a heartbeat including in Astrid's flat :-)
Everything went super smooth and Astrid was such a great host. Can highly recommend booking this place! I'll definitely be back soon. Thanks again for everything Astrid!

Liz was really great to accomodate our need for an apt. only ONE day before we were leaving for London.

The apt. is very cute. Liz left really detailed information about the apt. and was available in case we needed anything.

We love the neighborhood (walking distance to Soho/West End) and it was perfect for our needs.

Super situation pour un appartement tres correct
tres bien dans l'ensemble.
Everything was perfect. I woud recommend this flat.
The location is perfect and the flat is very nice for 3 couples. Nice place to spend a good week-end or holidays in London. Enjoy
Perfect location - perfect flat! Couldn't get any better! Really enjoyed our stay and hope to be back soon!

Buena estancia. A 5 minutos de dos paradas de metro, barrio tranquilo. Bien dotado de instalaciones y cómodo para seis personas en tres habitaciones dobles más salón y dos baños completos. Recomendable sin duda.

The apartment was in a great central location for the Olympics and very close to the underground and restaurants. It was a clean (except for some silver fish in one of the bathrooms) and comfortable apartment. I was not happy with the number of bathroom towels provided. There were 5 of us so we were given 5 bath towels, 2 hand towels and no wash clothes. We were there for 9 days and the washing machine broke early in our stay. Our towels got a little ripe by the end or our stay.

Liz was responsive when we emailed her, but I would have liked better communication on confirming our stay as it got closer. We paid for the flat 6 months in advance because it was for the Olympics so I started to get worried when I did not hear from her. I finally emailed her just over a week before we were to arrive to confirm our stay and find out how we were to access the flat. When she responded, she confirmed the place but said nothing about accessing it. Finally a day before we were to arrive she emailed the access info.

Lastly, The second day we were there the washing/dryer machine jammed and would not open. Liz sent someone out to fix it and told us it was a broken handle, but didn't let us know it wouldn't be fixed until after we were gone. We found this out only after sending an inquiring email. She never once talked with us about paying for the repair. When we got home we received an email from an Airbnb mediator to pay for the repair. Through Airbnb we came to a compromise and paid half of the repair though we did not break the handle. Liz is responsive and nice, but often does not initiate communication when it would be appropriate and helpful.

Overall, the stay here was pleasant and met all our needs for our time in London.

Pros:
Location is close to several tube stations making it easy to get around the city.
Lots of space where you can really spread out, bright with lots of windows.
Numerous restaurants and pubs nearby to get something to eat or drink.
Close to several grocery and pharmacy.
Liz provided a nice welcome guide with recommendations.

Cons:
Several baby silverfish in the bathrooms.
Front bedroom facing the street can be very noisy at night with pub patrons on their way home. (back two bedrooms were quiet).
Keys and check in details were sufficient without a problem, but not provided until the day prior.
