idealer Platz um in London Urlaub zu machen,
alles ist vom Appartement zu Fuss zu erreichen,
die Ausstattung des Apartments ist sehr gut, es ist sauber und hat viel Platz, die Gastgeber sind sehr nett und immer ansprechbar wenn es Probleme gibt. Sehr zu empfehlen.

Great and clean place if you need a central location in London. Great if you have couples (2 queen beds), and big and equiped kitchen. Nice place if you enjoy restaurants and pubs in central London.

Jack and Liz were great hosts - everything work perfectly.
A cozy and lovely flat in a great location. No surprises from the posting, and the owner was very responsive with questions or needs.

I went with five more friends to Liz's apartment in Fitzroy Street. Surely, the best apartment i have ever been to. Firstly, Liz couldn't have been nicer to us!The flat was even better that in the pictures. Everything was great, (two bathrooms and 3 bedrooms). Location couldn't have been better. Everything was within walking distance(british museum, candem town, oxford circuss, pica dilly) or you could get the Warren Street Tube and you arrived everywhere in less than five minutes. The house was very near to Tesco Express and Salsbury Supermarkets, Pharmacies and everything you could ever head. Furthermore, the best night clubs in London (Libertine, Maddox and Cirque du Soire) were all a 15 minute walk. We stayed four days and we didn't have to pick any taxi!. The great majority of the Buses stopped in Tottenham Court Row(less than 3 minute walk from the house).
I definitely recommend this house, as when we arrived, it couldn't be more clean. There was a dishwasher, washing machine, iron...everything you could need.
We didn't stay much on the flat as we went on a tourist trip, but it was extremely pleasant arriving to the flat,as it was great located and beds were extremely confortable.
I wont regret staying again in Liz's apartment!
Great location and great apartment !

Pictures are true to the apartment. The apartment is very well located for transports, stores and shopping. The center of london is within walking distance.
The apartment was clean, quiet and well-equipped. Only the noise in the street during the night was a little annoying.
Liz is very attentive to her guests.
I definitely recommend this apartment.
Very nice apartment and excellent location

Séjour tres agreable,confort total,facile d"acces au
transport en commun,metro,autobus.,
Pour nous l'accueuil fut tres courtois,car ce fut a la derniere minute.
A conseiller pour cinq personnes ou plus.

房子与照片相符，房间很干净，各种设施用具一应俱全。位置也特别好，很近的地方就有2个地铁站，还有汽车车站，附近有好几个餐厅，还有超市。去大英博物馆、牛津街、帕丁顿火车站、还有各大景点都很方便。
Liz特别好，一直和保持着邮件联系，各种信息都会提前发邮件给我。以后如果有机会再来伦敦，希望还有机会住Liz的公寓。

Veneranda And Leo are very nice and open people. Because I am dutch, it was very nice and handy that Leo can speak English and Dutch.

The house was clean and they gave me all the necessary information about nice places in London. I will definitely stay here again!
Leo and Veneranda were great hosts, we truly felt at home!

Хозяева очень гостеприимные, дом чистый. В доме есть кошка, но следов шерсти нет нигде! Я аллергик, но я совершенно не ощущал присутствия кошки. Удобно добираться в ExCel - пешком всего 15 минут, на автобусе ещё меньше. Район спокойный - я возвращался в 2 часа ночи и чувствовал себя в безопасности. Определенно рекомендую это жильё!

Me and two friends stayed in Veneranda and Leo's loft for three nights, and we had the most wonderful stay! They were very kind hosts and welcomed us with tea and stories about where to find the best ice cream in the world. They were quick to help us by providing us with answers to our questions and travel advice.
The loft itself is good value for money, with very comfortable mattresses and enough storage space for all your stuff. Be aware that the sloping roof isn't that high, but this isn't a problem (unless you're a very tall Dutchmen like one of my friends ;) ). Also, we were welcome to sit in the living room or in the garden if we wanted, so we were only up there to sleep. The ladder to the loft is quite steep, so not suitable for the less abled or small children, but if you don't mind this then I'd recommend staying with Veneranda and Leo. Their place is located on a quiet street but very well connected with bus stops around the corner. Canning Town tube station and the ExCel Centre are only a small bus trip away, meaning that you'll be in the centre before you know it. I would definitely come back here again in the future! :)
Leo & Veranda are such a lovely couple. So welcoming and willing to help. Their house was always clean and tidy. All necessary equipment was provided. Thank you again for your hospitality!

Venere and Leo have been very welcoming and nice from the start. Communication is really good. Loft is small and sweet. A bit careful when you are climbing the stair though. It's clean and close to bus stop and tube station so nothing to complain. Recommend to anyone solo or people of two and hope to see you again!

Splendido soggiorno e ottima accoglienza! Clima famigliare,  Leo e Venere sono molto disponibili e cercano di rendere il soggiorno gradevole e ti mettono sin da subito a tuo agio. Posto ben servito dai mezzi pubblici, bus, treno, metropolitana e facilmente raggiungibile qualsiasi metà di Londra. Grazie di tutto!
Fantastic hospitality, along with a friendly atmosphere and wonderful travel advice. The room was perfect for what we needed, and all three of us felt very welcome in the house

Veneranda and Leo were very nice and accommodating. Even though we arrived past midnight they were willing to welcome us. The place itself is very nice and cosy with our own space in the kitchen and bathroom. There are also buses direct to Excel and shops just a few minutes walk away for anything we needed. Although we weren't in the house very much it was a very enjoyable stay and would certainly recommend.

Veneranda et Leo ont été extrêmement accueillants, leurs sourires et leurs précieux conseils ont rendu notre voyage inoubliable. Nous recommandons vivement ce logement, chaleureux et très bien desservi, idéal pour découvrir cette merveilleuse ville qu'est Londres ! Nous avons hâte d'y revenir...
Francis, Rémi et Clara

My daughter and I both thoroughly recommend staying with Veneranda and Leo. They were welcoming, helpful and very interesting to talk to. They made us drinks on arrival, which was a nice touch. They live at the property and were often around to chat and give advice if needed but equally they are respectful of people’s space and privacy. The location is as described - ideally located for ExCel as well as central London. The photos and house descriptions are very accurate. It’s a Victorian house, small and cozy but with everything you need. There is only one bathroom and so you need to be prepared to share. The loft room is up a ladder safely bolted to the wall, so flexibility is key (we improved with practice)! The kitchen is equipped with everything you need, with fridge and cupboard space provided. We had our own shelf reserved in the bathroom. It’s spotlessly clean, warm and homely. We had a really great stay and will be back! Thanks Veneranda and Leo for helping to make our stay special.

If you're looking for an affordable, safe, clean, convenient location to explore London then this is it. Venera and Leo are both incredibly hospitable people and will make you feel like you're in your own home. Close to grocery stores, transport into the city, night busses and train lines it's right on the edge of central London and extremely easy to navigate to even for a first time UK traveler such as myself.
The Loft itself is spacious and warm with plenty of room for multiple people. The kitchen is well equipped and the bathroom is always very clean.
I couldn't recommend this home more and highly recommend it for any solo, business or couple travelers!
Thanks again Leo and Venera

Leo and Veneranda are excellent hosts, very kind and ready to help all the time. The house was perfectly clean. The only problems we had were the heat (something beyond their control) and the dining area, which far too small for nine people. I think their house is ideal for 6-7 people. It is very well located and full of appliances and gadgets. Thanks for help Ing us to have a good time in London.

Vous allez rencontrer des gens accueillants qui savent rester discret et ne pas interférer dans votre vie privée.
Tout est propre, nickel.
Il suffit de demander quelque chose pour que tout se fasse avec un sourire.
Les règles de vie en communauté sont claires dès le départ; Vénéré et Léo restent disponibles en permanence et toujours à l'écoute.
C'est ma première expérience R B&B, je ne suis peut être pas objectif mais je leur décerne un 10/10 sans problème !
Even before I arrived, Veneranda and Leo were very helpful and friendly. Once in London they made me feel welcome and they gave me a home away from home. Thanks you two for a fantastic stay!!!

The place was clean and very cozy. Loved the little cat we got to see for a few moments. The hosts were very welcoming and helpful. Very considerate of our needs and schedules. Was a close distance from ExCel convention center so the location was great for us. The loft was comfy. No complaints! Highly recommend.
We had a good stay at Leo's and Venere's place.
Leo and Veneranda run their house smoothly  and spotlessly. They offer lots of local tips and are always ready to help their guests.
Veneranda and Leo were wonderful hosts and they were really helpful suggesting some places to visit and how to get there. We really enjoyed our visit!
Nice people, they were really helpful. I definitely recommend! :-)

Even through messaging before we got there I knew this place would be special, but I was in for a big surprise when I realised just how welcoming the hosts were. There were 3 of us staying in the loft, which was surprisingly spacious and very comfortable. We all slept incredibly well!
The tour when we arrived was very helpful and accommodating. The hosts themselves are excellent story tellers and offered local advice, and there’s even parking for very cheap (especially for London!). I did stay up late talking to them because I was far too engaged in their stories.
When we left we had plans for the day in London but they made sure we come and say goodbye properly. If you stay here I’m sure you’ll feel like part of the family by the time you leave, even if you only stay for a couple of days!
Great, friendly hosts who are always helpful. You won't be missing anything. Location is close to the Central Line.  Would 100% recommend to anyone looking to stay in London short term or long term.

Veneranda and Leo were great hosts, very nice people who showed the place, had good tips about the surroundings. The place was also great, located next to shops and bus stops that get you fast in the underground system. Neighbourhood is also calm and quiet, no problem getting around day and night.
Great experience overall, definitely recommend!

Leo & Veneranda are great host. They were very helpfull with everything. The flat was nice and clean.  Though we were staying in the same house i felt very much at home/ease. At the corner lot's of shop's. Highly recommended.

Leo and Veneranda were very quick to respond to any queries we had before even arriving at the accommodation, including information on how to reach the accommodation and queries regarding check-in. Once we arrived we were given a tour of the accommodation and tips on how to navigate London along with local points of interest. Our hosts were always available throughout the stay for any further information we needed. As for the accommodation itself, it was very clean and comfortable, and came with all of the typical amenities you would expect and more. We would recommend this accommodation for anyone planning a stay in London.
Lovely hosts. Perfect space for what we needed and in a great location for our purposes. Would recommend.
Veneranda and Leo do not only rent you a room, they make sure to build around a warm home feeling for you. It was really nice to stay with them!
This is what an AirBnB should be like! Outstanding hosts, great location, just a perfect place to be in!

At Leo and Veneranda’s, you will not be disappointed. Their house is cozy, warm and clean, and they make sure to keep your room spotless for when you arrive.
Leo and Veneranda are fantastic hosts. Whether you’re looking for someone that’s easy and pleasant to talk to, or to give you your space, they’ll be able to accomodate. They are friendly, communicative and very helpful.
With easy transport links to central London, as well as Stratford and Docklands, Leo and Veneranda’s is a no-brainer. You will love it.
The place was sparkling clean. Leo and Venere were too friendly and gave us many local tips as well. The location is also good.

Outstanding hosts with amazing facilities! My stay here was perfect, Venere and Leo had provided me with everything I needed. The location is good (well connected to bus services, the DLR and the tube, shops are nearby), and the place is generally quiet. I'd definitely come back here again!

Venus and Leo are the most amazing hosts I have ever met.
They are super friendly and welcoming.
Their apartment is fully equipped and the loft room is super cozy and quiet.
It has a very large desk where I worked remotely even with two laptops.
Easy access to the city center.
I found it very handy to get to Canning Town station in 10 minutes by walk (or less by bus) for the DLR and Jubilee lines, so you can get anywhere and quickly.
Lots of shops on the way to go to the station or when returning to the apartment.
The neighborhood is quiet and safe, even returning late at 2-3 am.
I highly recommend them!
Amazing host. I love Airbnb because allow me to meet amazing people. Veneranda and Leo make really the difference on this platform

Venere and Leo are warm, friendly and accommodating hosts. I had just moved to London and they went out of their way to make sure that I was comfortable in my room, and in their home. They made sure I had a desk too as I was remote working at the time. I would highly recommend this space!

Leo and Veneranda are excellent hosts. They treat you like family from the start. The house is exactly how you see in the pictures, extremely clean and organised. The kitchen is well equipped and has everything I needed to cook or bake. They have a lovely garden that I regret not spending more time in it. In summary, I had a lovely time at their place and I would definitely book their place next time I need to stay in London.
Lovely place! Both Leo and Veneranda were great hosts and helped me with all my needs. Location was great and the room was perfect!

Amazing hosts! I was initially interested in this place for the loft but the reviews convinced me: the hosts really make you feel at home and are always around if you need anything. It's also in a great location near shops and restaurants, and plenty of bus routes near. Couldn't have asked for a better Airbnb experience with Leo and Veneranda, I'll be sure to stay with them again when I'm back in London!

Lovely stay - Venere & Leo are wonderful people, as you can tell from other reviews. While most private room Airbnbs are professionals/families renting spare rooms in their house/flats to get some extra income, V&L offer a more BNB-like experience - V frequently offered great food, washed my laundry x1 a week & insisted on doing my dishes half the time! You feel truly taken care of during your stay, to the point where you very quickly feel like you're staying with family. 100% stay here if it's available, it's such a unique experience & it'd be a shame to miss it!

You cannot ask for more than what you will get here. Leo and Veneranda are very friendly and helpful, and they maintain the entire house clean the whole time. They communicate very well with the guests as they have got years of experience in hosting through Airbnb. Unless you are trying to have a 3-days packed tour of London in which 3 minutes are too much to waste, otherwise the location is great, especially if you stay for long as it is close to good stores, restaurants and massive shopping malls.
You will get everything you need here, with helpful hosts answering any questions you have about London, a well-kept nice garden and maybe Veneranda's great cooking too (definitely try it if she offer you any).
A lot of guests stay for long period here, and come back again if they can - and you will understand why after you stay here.

The flat is well located, a short walk to two tubes stations (Victoria line and Northern line). There is good informational material sent in advance to help with arrival, and good reference material in the flat.
One downside of being well located is that the flat tends to be very noisy at night. Directly across the street is a 140 room LSE student residence, and with a student pub on the street corner, there is a lot of activity directly below the flat between the pub and the residence. We stayed for seven nights, and basically every night was very noisy until late.
This three bedroom flat would be a decent place to stay for the money except for one thing - two of the three beds have extremely poor quality mattresses. Before renting the flat, I specifically asked Liz about the mattress quality, and she assured me that the mattresses were of good quality. Well this was unfortunately for me and my family a blatant misrepresentation. One bed has a decent double mattress. The other two beds have really really bad mattresses, the kind where the springs are to the surface and little or no support or padding. To make matters worse, one of the beds has broken slats, so you sort of ooze downward in the middle. I reported this after our first (sleepless) night, and Liz's partner Jack came over to the flat. I showed him the two bad mattresses, and he seemed surprised at how bad they were, said he agreed that they were not of acceptable quality, and that he'd try to get them replaced immediately, but given it was a Saturday he said in all likelihood we wouldn't get new mattresses delivered until Monday. I said that was ok, and I appreciated his honesty about how bad the mattresses were, and his willingness to deal with the situation. Well, on Monday no mattresses arrived, nor any message from Jack or Liz about a change of plans. After two of my emails went unanswered, Liz finally answered to say that the existing mattresses were actually fine (!), that she's slept in the flat many times and that she's never had complaints before!!!! She didn't bother explaining how Jack could have been so wrong in his assessment. She had the nerve to tell me "different beds suit different people I guess". If the two mattresses were not of throw-away quality, why would Jack suggest replacing them immediately if they were not crappy?? The reason i'm making a big deal of this, as I've told Liz, is that the ONLY question I had of Liz before renting the flat was whether the mattresses were of decent quality. She misrepresented the facts, and then despite her partner Jack agreeing with me, she would not admit she had lied to me. So buyer beware of what Liz has to say! I would suggest looking elsewhere.

The apartment was lovely and in a perfect location near great places to eat and famous streets of London and landmarks as well so its great for exploring the city. The hosts were so helpful and even made sure to fix the lights in the living room that were damaged by a previous guest before we even got there. They also provided a helpful info pack about London which was great for exploring. I would definitely recommend the apartment and the hosts to other people and hope I can use the apartment again another time.

Very comfortable flat located in a great, central neighborhood! So many restaurants and pubs were within walking distance, as well as grocery stores and shopping. The flat itself was cozy and had everything we needed. Liz was a fantastic host and was always quickly responsive to all of our questions. A great experience in London!

Nos hemos alojado en este apartamento una familia de 6 personas, entre ellos 2 personas de mas de 70 y 2 niños y nos hemos encontrado muy a gusto. El apartamento ha sido muy comodo, super agradable y sobre todo muy bien situado en un barrio centrico y tranquilo. Muy recomendable. Liz lo tiene muy bien organizado lo que facilita enormemente la experiencia. Repetiria sin dudarlo

Newly refurbished 3 bed in central London - round the back of Tottenham Court Rd. Walking distance to a million restaurants cafes and anything else Central London. Stayed here with my wife baby and mother in law. Suited us perfectly! Good communications by Liz and Frank. Apartment is as advertised. Clean modern and well located. Would stay again!

Liz is a great host . very specific and informative.  flat is above expectation . centrally located and 5-7 mins walk to warren street . very good interior and superb cleanliness.kitchen well equipped .   overall great experience.  Shall book again .

A lovely place in a great neighborhood. I stayed here with my husband, 2 of my children and a friend. It is perfectly fit for 5 of us. Liz is very responsive and helpful in answering all my questions and giving all the informations I need to know, especially for check in and check out. We love the location, very close to restaurants and groceries as well as the tube station. All can be reached by walking distance in a couple blocks aways. The apartment is very clean and new, just as shown in pictures in airbnb. Check in and check out were super easy. Liz sent me the instructions for both in advance. The only one reason is just the water is very long to get warm and low water pressure in shower. Aside from that the apartment is just perfect. Thank you again Liz for having us and being a great host. We can’t wait to go back London and stay at your place again.
Everything was great.
Liz is a fantastic host, very attentive and full of information on local activities and things to keep the family busy.  The place was very clean, and in a great location.   Thanks Liz!

You can’t beat the location of this flat, close to restaurants, bars, tube station, British museum, Oxford street.
The front room is a bit noisy at night time but the noise of the fan will block the street noise.
Great place to stay.
Perfectly located for all sightseeing in London yet on a quiet side street :)

Great location great flat fully equiped
highly recommended
Excelente departamento, ubicación y prestaciones. Impecable estadía!

This is a spacious, modern, clean, well-equipped apartment with a courteous and responsive host. There are three underground stations within 8 mins walk, which is very convenient. The apartment is located in the shadows of the BT Tower and in the stomping grounds of the College of London. I highly recommend the apartment, but if you are looking for a quaint neighborhood, you might look elsewhere. Good value.

We really enjoyed our stay here. The apartment was very clean and had the perfect amount of space for our party of four adults. The showers had great water pressure and the linens were very nice. One of the best features was it’s central location, just a short walk to multiple tube stations. That made it easy to pop back in later in the evening to recharge phones, grab coats, etc. The building was quiet and got great light. Overall, a really great experience. The only thing we would change is how you get the keys to the place. It’s a little confusing, especially after a long day of travel. On the plus side, Liz was very helpful and answered our call immediately when we needed assistance retrieving the keys. We highly recommend and would stay here again.

Location, location, location. We just had a great stay at this apt. It’s cozy in as smaller than you might think from the pics, but it’s immaculately clean and was cozy in all the right ways for my family ( there were 3 of us). You are minutes away from everything you’ll want to do in London, and the hosts are very communicative and helpful. We will definitely book again.  Also beds are very comfortable.
清潔感があって設備も整っています。近隣にスーパーもあり、生活しやすいです。

Leo and Venera where really amazing hosts. They understood when you just needed to be left alone, but also offered good conversation and stories when you where in the mood for that. They've been doing this for many years, and you can really feel that they know what they're doing - everything is so well organized in the kitchen, you are not in doubt about what is your space and what isn't and they where always more than willing to help if you had questions. All in all I would love to come back and stay with them if they will have me!
Oh yeah, and Maia was a clear bonus. Such a sweet and reserved little lady (cat).

Highly recommended when you want to stay with 2 warmhearted, funny hosts (and their funny cat).
They made it very easy for me to feel at home from day 1 on.
Everything in the house was perfectly arranged and the communication was great!
Thank you very much for making my stay an extraordinary experience!

I had a lovely stay in this loft. I spent much of my time listening to the rain fall onto the skylight window while I read a book, which is exactly as cozy as it sounds.
Leo and Venere genuinely cared that I enjoyed my stay, and often checked in to make sure I was happy with everything.
The house was immaculate, and everyone gets a designated shelf in the pantry, fridge, and bathroom which is quite thoughtful.
Getting around was easy as there are multiple bus stops minutes away, including ones that run night buses.
The coziness of the loft and the kindness of the hosts will make anyone’s stay exceptionally enjoyable.
La gentilezza e l’accuratezza di Veneranda e Leo sono gli extra per un posto accogliente e ben collegato. Mi sono trovata benissimo.

Very friendly hosts and cat :) And the best mulled wine prepared by Vendranda!
Very convenient location. Shops and bars nearby. Buses to the tube.
So hospitable and nice

Had a wonderful time with Leo and Veneranda. They were the best hosts I've ever met. They welcomed me and made me feel like home.
They recommended a lot of places to visit and gave me helpful advices about transportation.
The house was super clean and they had everything I needed. I could even have my own shelf in the bathroom, fridge, and kitchen.
If you ask any help, they will be there for you. I would love to visit them again.

Nice accomodation in Central London with easy acces to public transport. The hosts were very nice as well and always in for a little chat. They were also very much willing to give their advice on nice spots to visit within the city.
Mooi verblijf op ongeveer een halfuur reisafstand tot locaties in het centrum. Vriendelijke hosts.

Leo and Veneranda were the most amazing hosts. So welcoming, so caring & so helpful! They were both always willing to give me advice and guidance on anything London related and made me feel at home. Not to mention how clean the place was, they are so meticulous which was very much appreciated.
The loft was so special and felt like my own personal and private hideaway from the hustle and bustle of London.
The best place for me to stay during my introduction to London.
I would seriously recommend their place to anyone considering staying 😊

It was a peaceful staying. The room is very cozy and Leo and Veneranda were the best hosts during my whole trip to the UK! (I was in 4 other houses before them). The location is accesible to different transport lines, so it’s pretty easy to go downtown. Highly recommended!

I had a beautiful stay at Leo and Veneranda's.
They are so warm and always helpful. I really enjoyed staying in the loft where I had everything I needed.
The kitchen was well really well stocked and the bathroom was very well organized.
Canning Town station was nearby from where you can access the city very easily.
Next time I come to London I hope to stay with them again. They are really lovely people

Era come essere a casa. Mi sono sentita a casa mia con persone che sembrava conoscessi da tanto.  Molto disponibili in tutto, grazie ancora per aver reso il soggiorno comfortable e per avermi insegnato qualcosina in inglese e non solo :)

I had a wonderful experience from pre check-in till check-out. Leo and Veneranda are very friendly and respectful, and always there to help if you need anything. The entire house, from bedroom to common spaces, is extremely well-maintained. This is very impressive since Leo and Veneranda have been hosting guests for over a decade. I had fun staying in the loft, which was nice and quiet, and I also managed to get some work done. Location is convenient, with many food/grocery options in the neighbourhood, and frequent buses to get around. For a solo traveler like myself, I believe this is one of the best options out there in London.

Veneranda and Leo hosted me for 3 months and in such a short time, they became like a second family to me. They are two special people because they are funny and always able to give great advices to their guests. I am happy to have spent these 3 months with them because I learnt so much.
The description on their Airbnb page is really accurate. I hope to come back soon 😊

I had a wonderful stay in Leo and Veneranda's dreamy loft—The space has a cozy vibe and a hospitable atmosphere with lightning-fast WiFi. They went above and beyond to make everything ran smoothly, offering thoughtful recommendations and practical advice that made exploring the city and planning my visit seamless. Their cat, Maya, was an absolute delight and added such charm to the experience. Highly recommend staying with them!

I had a super decent stay at this place, hosted by a very open, kind and hospitable host couple - even made delicious Tiramisu for me at one point - and always down for a fun talk. Clean and comfortable house that has most essentials, and the room/loft itself is quite spacious. Immediate surrounding area may or may not be anything too special, but is not far from everywhere that is! Canning Town station, as well as a number of bus stops are in the vicinity too, making transport to Central London and anywhere else in the city fast and all too easy! Overall a super decent stay with great hosts and fellow guests, all for a great value!
Leo and Veneranda are generous and welcoming hosts. They take great care in sharing their lovely home and garden with others and are fantastic company.

Had a lovely week here, from day one. Once we got over our rival football affiliations, I had a great time. I slept extremely well in the loft and could easily get into the city centre and the nearby locations I had sought out. Thanks again!

My first vacation in London, and the stay in Sandra's place was very nice.  Sandra was very helpful at all the times.  Her house falls in zone 2 and visit to all renowned tourist spots are close by, max 15 mins to 30 mins in tube which is great advantage.  Room is for 2 people, but extended her help to accommodate 4 of us including kids and provided with air beds which was useful.  Overall I am satisfied with the room.

sandra is very friendly and helpful all time ;-)
heartfelt recommendation on our part,
on a rating scale to max. of 10, we would smooth award an 11 ;-)
Sandra was very friendly and helpful! And the place and the room itself are as nice as shown on the pictures. Logistics to the downtown is good, as well!

We had a very nice stay thanks to Sandra.
The place is very well described by the pictures. We used the bed for 2 adults and one kid.

I booked Sandra's place for a colleague who was attending a sports program at a local facility. I had booked AIRB&B for him before so he new what to expect and he was hoping for the same quality experience as last time. I am happy to say he was not let down and Sandra's great hospitality and her convenient location worked out a treat for his course.
Both Paul and I would be more than happy to recommend Sandra to anyone looking at a cool and relaxing stay.
Thanks Sandra.
Liam

My stay at Sandra's place has been great, so much that I ended up extending it a few days longer than I had planned. She's been friendly, helpful, incredibly discreet despite me having really weird hours all week (sorry about that! I tried to be as quiet and unobtrusive as I could), and made me feel welcome. You honestly couldn't find a better host. Also her cat loves to be petted, which is always bonus if you're looking for that warm, friendly, like-home feeling. :) Highly recommended.

I can only confirm my previous review. I needed a place where to feel safe and comfortable while also being able to move around a lot, and found all that. Sandra has been wonderful, the place is well connected, and the room is just as lovely as in the photos. Couldn't have been happier with my stay.

Our experience at Frankie's home has been really great ! The flat is very nice, comfortable, very clean and well located, we have received a warm welcome from our host ,and we have spent our holidays in London in the best way.
Thank you !

Frankies place is lovely very clean and super quiet.
We had a great time! Next time I hope the weather won´t stop us from enjoying the lovely backyard!
Thanks for beeing such a lovely host.

We loved staying at Frankie's. It was the perfect place to base ourselves, so cozy and convenient. Frankie's friend let us in and she was a real treasure, bringing us coffee and snacks in anticipation that we would be absolutely trashed after a long haul flight. So thoughtful! Beautiful apartment, great shower (rare and most appreciated by us Aussies), toasty warm heating and everything we needed. We didn't even notice there is no tv or stereo as we were out and about  most of the time. So much to do in Shoreditch and surrounds. We highly recommend you stay at Frankie's too.

The flat was clean and in good condition. Frankie and Damian put great effort into making our stay comfortable and easy.

Thanks both
Tony

casa carina, pulita e confortevole. Abbastanza vicina alla fermata della metropolitana. ci sono negozi e supermercati a 5 minuti a piedi.
consigliata. ci tornerei volentieri.

We had a great stay at Frankie's apartment. The Shoreditch area was a perfect, cool, non-touristy place to call home for the week we were there. Frankie gave us great tips on places to check out. Damian was very helpful and friendly upon our arrival. The pub on the corner is great!

Frankies flat is a very cosy and quiet place. A big clean bathroom, a nice kitchen, a wonderful bedroom with a window to the backyard - we had it open during the night and it was so silent - and a charming living room with a sofa to get a rest or plan the next thing to do.

Outside is Haberdasher street with no traffic, old stonebrick houses and sycamore trees. And just around the corner you'll get into the creative and buzzing Shoreditch area with all those bars, cafés, restaurants, boutiques, street art and markets …

It's easy to get there and Old street station is just a 6 min walk away with good connections.
Frankie made it easy for us to enjoy our stay!

September 2013

Frankie heeft een erg leuk appartement in de wijk Hackney. Het ligt gunstig op 5 minuten lopen van het Old Street  metrostation. In de buurt zijn veel gezellige cafés en restaurants. Het appartement is gezellig ingericht en erg ruim. Alles was goed verzorgd. Het 2e tweepersoons bed is vrij smal maar voor ons was het goed te doen. Ik zou dit appartement zeker aanraden aan anderen.
We had a wonderful stay and it was perfectly located to discover the east end and yet very close to the center. Thanks to Frankie, who was really caring about us.

A perfect base to discover London from! In a lively neighbourhood (though the house is quiet at night), with nice restaurants, cafes and bars close at hand. Public transport (underground) at a 5 minute walk.
Frankie was really helpful with all kinds of information about public transport from the airport to the city.
In short, I recommend Frankie's place to anyone.

The stay at Frankies Apartment was my first Air BnB Experience and i am sure it won't be my last. Frankies Apartment was lovely and the communication with Frankie was very nice. I told her we wanted to go out on Saturday night and she made us a list of Bars and Restaurants to go to. Frankie wasn't there to give us the keys to the apartment but we where welcomed by a friend of her who showed us around the apartment. We fell in love with the apartment instantly and at the end of our stay we didn't want to leave.

L'appartement est très agréable et très bien plaçé pour visiter la ville. Beaucoup de petits restaurants dans le quartier très sympa. Il y a un supermarché juste à côté, arrêt bus et métro. Je recommande vivement Frankie qui est très réactive pour répondre aux messages.

We loved staying at Frankie's flat.  It is a warm, homey and well appointed. A perfect place to relax after a long day of touring! The location is perfect. Easy access to central London, and so many great places in walking distance as well.  Shoreditch is a fantastic neighborhood, full of great restaurants, markets, shops, and sites. Frankie gave us recommendations for local sites and restaurants, and nightlife--all of which were spot on.  She answered all my many questions, and was a great host.  We hope to return again.

We come to London often for business and always stay in AirBnB's.  Frankie flat was the best for us.  Juice bar right around the corner, great restaurants within blocks, the Old Street tube station is 5 minutes away.  But, the most enjoyable part is Frankie's flat.  It's super clean, well decorated and QUIET!  Finding a quiet flat is Shoreditch is not easy. You hear no traffic at night.  Frankie's brother, Ben, welcome us.  We couldn't have had a warmer welcome to the neighborhood.  Thanks Ben. We look forward to our return.

Fantastic location - really in the middle of the best area of London. Easy walk to great sites like Oxford St, Covent Garden etc. Beautiful place, found it to be quiet as well. Well appointed, has a washer/dryer which was very useful as we were on a long trip. Liz was always helpful and communicative. Would definitely stay again!
Gracias Liz, muy confortable tu casa, y en una muy buena ubicación para conocer Londres !
